// YYYY-MM-DD\n  language?: Language;\n  parentPreferences?: ParentPreferences | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsResult {\n  missions: Mission[];\n  explanation: {\n    droppedCount: number;\n    droppedMessage?: string;\n    isMinimumViableDay: boolean;\n    usedTimetableFallback: boolean;\n    totalEstimatedMinutes: number;\n    budgetMinutes: number;\n    parentOverrideApplied?: boolean;\n    parentOverrideMessage?: string;\n    needsSchoolInformation?: boolean;\n    emptyReason?: string;\n  };\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET = 45;\nconst MAX_MISSIONS_CAP = 6;\nconst MAX_MISSION_MINUTES = 20;\n\n/**\n * Maps subject strings across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject IDs.\n * Delegates to the shared canonical resolver so every engine agrees.\n */\nconst normalizeSubject = normalizeSubjectId;\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction getSubjectDisplayName(subjId: string, lang: Language): string {\n  const isAr = lang === 'ar';\n  const isFr = lang === 'fr';\n\n  switch (subjId) {\n    case 'subj_french':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة الفرنسية' : isFr ? 'Français' : 'French Language';\n    // Math/Science use canonical subject IDs even when taught in French.\n    case 'subj_arabic':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : isFr ? 'Langue Arabe' : 'Arabic Language';\n    case 'subj_math':\n      return isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : isFr ? 'Maths' : 'Mathematics';\n    case 'subj_science':\n      return isAr ? 'العلوم' : isFr ? 'Sciences' : 'Science';\n    case 'subj_social':\n      return isAr ? 'الدراسات الاجتماعية' : isFr ? 'Études Sociales' : 'Social Studies';\n    case 'subj_english':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة الإنجليزية' : isFr ? 'Anglais' : 'English Connect 5';\n    case 'subj_ict':\n      return isAr ? 'تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات' : isFr ? 'TIC' : 'ICT';\n    case 'subj_islamic':\n      return isAr ? 'التربية الدينية الإسلامية' : isFr ? 'Éducation Islamique' : 'Islamic Education';\n    case 'subj_calligraphy':\n      return isAr ? 'الخط العربي' : isFr ? 'Calligraphie' : 'Arabic Calligraphy';\n    default:\n      return isAr ? 'المادة الدراسية' : isFr ? 'Matière Scolaire' : 'School Subject';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction findConceptsForSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  topicText: string = '',\n  flatConcepts: FlatCurriculumConcept[]\n): FlatCurriculumConcept[] {\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (!topicText || subjectConcepts.length === 0) return subjectConcepts;\n\n  const words = topicText.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n  const matched = subjectConcepts.filter((c) => {\n    const textAr = (c.nameAr + ' ' + (c.descriptionAr || '')).toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = (c.nameEn + ' ' + (c.descriptionEn || '')).toLowerCase();\n    return words.some((w) => textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w));\n  });\n\n  return matched.length > 0 ? matched : subjectConcepts;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled daily mission planner.\n * Follows exact priority ordering:\n *  a. Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n *  b. Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n *  c. Concepts flagged needs_review\n *  d. Due-for-spaced-review concepts (stub)\n *  e. General practice for weakest subject\n */\nexport function planDailyMissions(params: PlanMissionsParams): PlanMissionsResult {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecord,\n    timetable,\n    masteryRecords,\n    availableMinutes,\n    fatigueSignal = false,\n    date = localDateStr(),\n    language = 'ar',\n    parentPreferences,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (!student || !student.id) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: 0,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'no_student',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لا يوجد ملف طالب نشط حالياً. يرجى إعداد الملف للبدء.'\n          : 'No active student profile found. Please complete onboarding first.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n\n  let parentOverrideApplied = false;\n  let parentOverrideMessage: string | undefined;\n\n  // 1. Determine Time Budget\n  // Default is 45 min, or student declared. If fatigue signal is high, adjust downward.\n  let declaredBudget = availableMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET;\n  if (declaredBudget < 5) declaredBudget = 10; // minimum sensible budget\n\n  // Check parent override on daily study budget\n  if (parentPreferences?.maxDailyStudyMinutes && parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes < declaredBudget) {\n    declaredBudget = parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes;\n    parentOverrideApplied = true;\n    parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n      ? `تم تعديل وقت المذاكرة اليومي إلى (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} دقيقة) وفقاً للحد المحدد مع ولي الأمر لضمان راحة متوازنة.`\n      : `Daily study time adjusted to (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} min) per parent settings to ensure healthy rest.`;\n  }\n\n  if (fatigueSignal) {\n    declaredBudget = Math.max(15, Math.floor(declaredBudget * 0.75));\n  }\n\n  // Check parent bedtime constraint\n  let nearBedtime = false;\n  if (parentPreferences?.bedtimeLimit) {\n    try {\n      const [bHour, bMin] = parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit.split(':').map(Number);\n      const now = new Date();\n      const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();\n      const bedtimeMinutes = bHour * 60 + (bMin || 0);\n      if (bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes <= 45 && bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes > -60) {\n        nearBedtime = true;\n        parentOverrideApplied = true;\n        parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n          ? `اقترب موعد النوم المحدد مع ولي الأمر (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). تم تقليص الخطة لمهمة واحدة سريعة لمساعدتك على النوم مبكراً.`\n          : `Approaching bedtime set by parent (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). Tasks limited to a single quick mission.`;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore time parse issues\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Failure path A: No time today / under 15 minutes or near bedtime → Offer \"minimum viable day\": ONE mission of 5-10 min\n  const isMinimumViableDay = declaredBudget <= 15 || nearBedtime;\n\n  const candidatePool: Array<{\n    mission: Mission;\n    priorityWeight: number; // Higher number = higher priority\n  }> = [];\n\n  const usedConceptIds = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Determine subjects active today\n  let activeSubjectIds: string[] = [];\n  let usedTimetableFallback = false;\n\n  const isConfirmedDay = Boolean(dayRecord && dayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  if (dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered && dayRecord.lessonsCovered.length > 0) {\n    // Collect from today's recorded lessons (confirmed or student-logged)\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(l.subject);\n      if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Fallback to timetable if no confirmed day record or no subjects identified\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && timetable) {\n    usedTimetableFallback = true;\n    const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n    const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n      0: 'sunday',\n      1: 'monday',\n      2: 'tuesday',\n      3: 'wednesday',\n      4: 'thursday',\n    };\n    const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n    const daySched = todayKey ? timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n    if (daySched) {\n      daySched.periods.forEach((p) => {\n        if (!p.isBreak) {\n          const sId = normalizeSubject(p.subject);\n          if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Identify subjects with due reviews or low mastery\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    const dueReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, { language });\n    for (const r of dueReviews) {\n      const c = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === r.conceptId);\n      if (c && !activeSubjectIds.includes(c.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(c.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If no reliable learning signal exists (no confirmed day record, no timetable for today, no due reviews, no mastery history):\n  // Safe fallback: Return explicit safe onboarding / needs-school-info state without fabricating priorities!\n  const hasLearningSignal =\n    (isConfirmedDay && ((dayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.length || 0) > 0 || (dayRecord?.homeworkAssigned?.length || 0) > 0)) ||\n    usedTimetableFallback ||\n    activeSubjectIds.length > 0 ||\n    Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0;\n\n  if (!hasLearningSignal) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم يتم تسجيل يوم مدرسي أو جدول حصص بعد. سجلي ما تم دراسته اليوم في المدرسة لنضع لكِ خطة مذاكرة ذكية ودقيقة!'\n          : 'No school day record or timetable yet. Please log today\\'s school lessons so we can build your personalized learning plan!',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Existing mastery is a learning signal only for the subjects represented by\n  // those authoritative concepts. Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم نتمكن من تحديد مادة دراسية موثوقة لهذا اليوم. سجلي ما تم دراسته أو جدول الحصص لنضع خطة دقيقة.'\n          : 'No reliable subject is available for today. Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY B: Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered?.length > 0) {\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((les, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(les.subject);\n      if (!sId) return;\n\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, les.topic || '', flatConcepts);\n      // Find concept with lowest mastery or unstarted\n      let candidate = matched.find((c) => !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (!candidate && matched.length > 0) candidate = matched[0];\n\n      if (candidate) {\n        usedConceptIds.add(candidate.id);\n        const mastery = masteryRecords[candidate.id];\n        const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n\n        const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n        const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'مشاهدة الشرح والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب السريع'\n              : 'Watch explanation and pass quick check',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY C: Concepts flagged needs_review (from Phase 4 mastery records)\n  flatConcepts.forEach((concept) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(concept.id)) return;\n    const rec = masteryRecords[concept.id];\n    if (!rec) return;\n\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review') {\n      usedConceptIds.add(concept.id);\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(concept.subjectId, language);\n      const conceptName = isAr ? concept.nameAr : concept.nameEn;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 600,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_review_${date}_${concept.id}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: concept.lessonId,\n          conceptId: concept.id,\n          title: isAr ? `مراجعة داعمة: ${conceptName}` : `Review: ${conceptName}`,\n          type: 'review',\n          estimatedMinutes: 8,\n          whyNow: isAr\n            ? `مفهوم علمي انخفض استيعابه أو يحتاج دعماً إضافياً (${view.compositeLabel}).`\n            : `Concept flagged as needs review based on mastery records (${view.compositeLabel}).`,\n          originTag: concept.origin,\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'الإجابة على أسئلة المراجعة واستعادة الثقة'\n            : 'Answer review questions and restore confidence',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY D: Due-for-spaced-review concepts (Phase 7 Spaced Revision Scheduler)\n  const dueSpacedReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, {\n    currentDate: new Date(),\n    language,\n  });\n\n  dueSpacedReviews.forEach((item, idx) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(item.conceptId)) return;\n    usedConceptIds.add(item.conceptId);\n\n    const conceptMeta = flatConcepts.find((c) => c.id === item.conceptId);\n    const conceptName = isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 450 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_spaced_${date}_${item.conceptId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: item.subjectName,\n        lessonId: conceptMeta?.lessonId,\n        conceptId: item.conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `مراجعة متباعدة: ${conceptName}` : `Spaced Review: ${conceptName}`,\n        type: 'review',\n        estimatedMinutes: 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `حان موعد المراجعة المتباعدة (${item.reason}).`\n          : `Spaced review interval reached (${item.reason}).`,\n        originTag: conceptMeta?.origin || 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  Mission,\n  DayRecord,\n  Timetable,\n  MasteryRecord,\n  Student,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  SchoolDayKey,\n  Language,\n  ParentPreferences,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { normalizeSubjectId as normalizeSubject, getSubjectDisplayName } from '../curriculum/subjectIdentity';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { getDueReviewConcepts } from '../review/spacedReviewScheduler';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsParams {\n  student?: Student | null;\n  dayRecord?: DayRecord | null;\n  timetable?: Timetable | null;\n  masteryRecords: Record<string, MasteryRecord>;\n  availableMinutes?: number;\n  sessionHistoryCount?: number;\n  fatigueSignal?: boolean;\n  date?: string; // YYYY-MM-DD\n  language?: Language;\n  parentPreferences?: ParentPreferences | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsResult {\n  missions: Mission[];\n  explanation: {\n    droppedCount: number;\n    droppedMessage?: string;\n    isMinimumViableDay: boolean;\n    usedTimetableFallback: boolean;\n    totalEstimatedMinutes: number;\n    budgetMinutes: number;\n    parentOverrideApplied?: boolean;\n    parentOverrideMessage?: string;\n    needsSchoolInformation?: boolean;\n    emptyReason?: string;\n  };\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET = 45;\nconst MAX_MISSIONS_CAP = 6;\nconst MAX_MISSION_MINUTES = 20;\n\n/**\n * Maps subject strings across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject IDs.\n * Delegates to the shared canonical resolver so every engine agrees.\n */\nconst normalizeSubject = normalizeSubjectId;\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction findConceptsForSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  topicText: string = '',\n  flatConcepts: FlatCurriculumConcept[]\n): FlatCurriculumConcept[] {\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (!topicText || subjectConcepts.length === 0) return subjectConcepts;\n\n  const words = topicText.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n  const matched = subjectConcepts.filter((c) => {\n    const textAr = (c.nameAr + ' ' + (c.descriptionAr || '')).toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = (c.nameEn + ' ' + (c.descriptionEn || '')).toLowerCase();\n    return words.some((w) => textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w));\n  });\n\n  return matched.length > 0 ? matched : subjectConcepts;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled daily mission planner.\n * Follows exact priority ordering:\n *  a. Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n *  b. Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n *  c. Concepts flagged needs_review\n *  d. Due-for-spaced-review concepts (stub)\n *  e. General practice for weakest subject\n */\nexport function planDailyMissions(params: PlanMissionsParams): PlanMissionsResult {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecord,\n    timetable,\n    masteryRecords,\n    availableMinutes,\n    fatigueSignal = false,\n    date = localDateStr(),\n    language = 'ar',\n    parentPreferences,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (!student || !student.id) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: 0,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'no_student',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لا يوجد ملف طالب نشط حالياً. يرجى إعداد الملف للبدء.'\n          : 'No active student profile found. Please complete onboarding first.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n\n  let parentOverrideApplied = false;\n  let parentOverrideMessage: string | undefined;\n\n  // 1. Determine Time Budget\n  // Default is 45 min, or student declared. If fatigue signal is high, adjust downward.\n  let declaredBudget = availableMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET;\n  if (declaredBudget < 5) declaredBudget = 10; // minimum sensible budget\n\n  // Check parent override on daily study budget\n  if (parentPreferences?.maxDailyStudyMinutes && parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes < declaredBudget) {\n    declaredBudget = parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes;\n    parentOverrideApplied = true;\n    parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n      ? `تم تعديل وقت المذاكرة اليومي إلى (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} دقيقة) وفقاً للحد المحدد مع ولي الأمر لضمان راحة متوازنة.`\n      : `Daily study time adjusted to (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} min) per parent settings to ensure healthy rest.`;\n  }\n\n  if (fatigueSignal) {\n    declaredBudget = Math.max(15, Math.floor(declaredBudget * 0.75));\n  }\n\n  // Check parent bedtime constraint\n  let nearBedtime = false;\n  if (parentPreferences?.bedtimeLimit) {\n    try {\n      const [bHour, bMin] = parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit.split(':').map(Number);\n      const now = new Date();\n      const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();\n      const bedtimeMinutes = bHour * 60 + (bMin || 0);\n      if (bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes <= 45 && bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes > -60) {\n        nearBedtime = true;\n        parentOverrideApplied = true;\n        parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n          ? `اقترب موعد النوم المحدد مع ولي الأمر (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). تم تقليص الخطة لمهمة واحدة سريعة لمساعدتك على النوم مبكراً.`\n          : `Approaching bedtime set by parent (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). Tasks limited to a single quick mission.`;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore time parse issues\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Failure path A: No time today / under 15 minutes or near bedtime → Offer \"minimum viable day\": ONE mission of 5-10 min\n  const isMinimumViableDay = declaredBudget <= 15 || nearBedtime;\n\n  const candidatePool: Array<{\n    mission: Mission;\n    priorityWeight: number; // Higher number = higher priority\n  }> = [];\n\n  const usedConceptIds = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Determine subjects active today\n  let activeSubjectIds: string[] = [];\n  let usedTimetableFallback = false;\n\n  const isConfirmedDay = Boolean(dayRecord && dayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  if (dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered && dayRecord.lessonsCovered.length > 0) {\n    // Collect from today's recorded lessons (confirmed or student-logged)\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(l.subject);\n      if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Fallback to timetable if no confirmed day record or no subjects identified\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && timetable) {\n    usedTimetableFallback = true;\n    const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n    const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n      0: 'sunday',\n      1: 'monday',\n      2: 'tuesday',\n      3: 'wednesday',\n      4: 'thursday',\n    };\n    const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n    const daySched = todayKey ? timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n    if (daySched) {\n      daySched.periods.forEach((p) => {\n        if (!p.isBreak) {\n          const sId = normalizeSubject(p.subject);\n          if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Identify subjects with due reviews or low mastery\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    const dueReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, { language });\n    for (const r of dueReviews) {\n      const c = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === r.conceptId);\n      if (c && !activeSubjectIds.includes(c.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(c.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If no reliable learning signal exists (no confirmed day record, no timetable for today, no due reviews, no mastery history):\n  // Safe fallback: Return explicit safe onboarding / needs-school-info state without fabricating priorities!\n  const hasLearningSignal =\n    (isConfirmedDay && ((dayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.length || 0) > 0 || (dayRecord?.homeworkAssigned?.length || 0) > 0)) ||\n    usedTimetableFallback ||\n    activeSubjectIds.length > 0 ||\n    Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0;\n\n  if (!hasLearningSignal) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم يتم تسجيل يوم مدرسي أو جدول حصص بعد. سجلي ما تم دراسته اليوم في المدرسة لنضع لكِ خطة مذاكرة ذكية ودقيقة!'\n          : 'No school day record or timetable yet. Please log today\\'s school lessons so we can build your personalized learning plan!',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Existing mastery is a learning signal only for the subjects represented by\n  // those authoritative concepts. Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم نتمكن من تحديد مادة دراسية موثوقة لهذا اليوم. سجلي ما تم دراسته أو جدول الحصص لنضع خطة دقيقة.'\n          : 'No reliable subject is available for today. Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY B: Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered?.length > 0) {\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((les, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(les.subject);\n      if (!sId) return;\n\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, les.topic || '', flatConcepts);\n      // Find concept with lowest mastery or unstarted\n      let candidate = matched.find((c) => !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (!candidate && matched.length > 0) candidate = matched[0];\n\n      if (candidate) {\n        usedConceptIds.add(candidate.id);\n        const mastery = masteryRecords[candidate.id];\n        const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n\n        const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n        const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'مشاهدة الشرح والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب السريع'\n              : 'Watch explanation and pass quick check',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY C: Concepts flagged needs_review (from Phase 4 mastery records)\n  flatConcepts.forEach((concept) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(concept.id)) return;\n    const rec = masteryRecords[concept.id];\n    if (!rec) return;\n\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review') {\n      usedConceptIds.add(concept.id);\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(concept.subjectId, language);\n      const conceptName = isAr ? concept.nameAr : concept.nameEn;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 600,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_review_${date}_${concept.id}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: concept.lessonId,\n          conceptId: concept.id,\n          title: isAr ? `مراجعة داعمة: ${conceptName}` : `Review: ${conceptName}`,\n          type: 'review',\n          estimatedMinutes: 8,\n          whyNow: isAr\n            ? `مفهوم علمي انخفض استيعابه أو يحتاج دعماً إضافياً (${view.compositeLabel}).`\n            : `Concept flagged as needs review based on mastery records (${view.compositeLabel}).`,\n          originTag: concept.origin,\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'الإجابة على أسئلة المراجعة واستعادة الثقة'\n            : 'Answer review questions and restore confidence',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY D: Due-for-spaced-review concepts (Phase 7 Spaced Revision Scheduler)\n  const dueSpacedReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, {\n    currentDate: new Date(),\n    language,\n  });\n\n  dueSpacedReviews.forEach((item, idx) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(item.conceptId)) return;\n    usedConceptIds.add(item.conceptId);\n\n    const conceptMeta = flatConcepts.find((c) => c.id === item.conceptId);\n    const conceptName = isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 450 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_spaced_${date}_${item.conceptId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: item.subjectName,\n        lessonId: conceptMeta?.lessonId,\n        conceptId: item.conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `مراجعة متباعدة: ${conceptName}` : `Spaced Review: ${conceptName}`,\n        type: 'review',\n        estimatedMinutes: 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `حان موعد المراجعة المتباعدة (${item.reason}).`\n          : `Spaced review interval reached (${item.reason}).`,\n        originTag: conceptMeta?.origin || 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "kind": "FileEditorObservation"
}

 date,\n      subject,\n      description,\n      dueDate,\n      unlinked: true,\n      status: 'pending',\n      questions: [],\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalizes text for lenient student answer checking\n */\nexport function normalizeStudentText(raw?: string): string {\n  if (!raw) return '';\n  return raw\n    .trim()\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')\n    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')\n    .replace(/[\\u064B-\\u065F]/g, '') // remove Arabic tashkeel / diacritics\n    .replace(/[.,\\/#!$%\\^&\\*;:{}=\\-_`~()؟?]/g, '')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * Evaluates student answer for a digital homework question.\n */\nexport function evaluateStudentAnswer(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion,\n  studentAnswer: any\n): {\n  isCorrect: boolean;\n  correctness: 'full' | 'partial' | 'wrong';\n  feedback?: string;\n} {\n  if (studentAnswer === undefined || studentAnswer === null || studentAnswer === '') {\n    return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n\n  switch (question.type) {\n    case 'multiple_choice': {\n      const isMatch = String(studentAnswer).trim() === String(question.correctAnswer).trim();\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'short_answer':\n    case 'fill_in_the_blank': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const target = typeof question.correctAnswer === 'string'\n        ? question.correctAnswer\n        : question.blanks?.blankAnswer || '';\n      const normTarget = normalizeStudentText(target);\n\n      // Support fraction variations: 2/5 or 2 / 5 or ٢/٥\n      const cleanStudent = normStudent.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n      const cleanTarget = normTarget.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n\n      const isMatch =\n        normStudent === normTarget ||\n        cleanStudent === cleanTarget ||\n        normStudent.includes(normTarget) ||\n        normTarget.includes(normStudent);\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'matching': {\n      // studentAnswer is an array of right strings matched in order of matchingPairs\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !question.matchingPairs) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      let correctMatches = 0;\n      question.matchingPairs.forEach((pair, idx) => {\n        if (studentAnswer[idx] === pair.right) {\n          correctMatches += 1;\n        }\n      });\n      const total = question.matchingPairs.length;\n      if (correctMatches === total) {\n        return { isCorrect: true, correctness: 'full' };\n      } else if (correctMatches > 0) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'partial' };\n      }\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'ordering': {\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      const isMatch =\n        studentAnswer.length === question.correctAnswer.length &&\n        studentAnswer.every((val, idx) => val === (question.correctAnswer as string[])[idx]);\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'voice_response': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const targetStr = Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)\n        ? question.correctAnswer.join(' ')\n        : String(question.correctAnswer);\n      const targetKeywords = normalizeStudentText(targetStr)\n        .split(' ')\n        .filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n\n      // If at least one essential concept keyword is spoken\n      const matchedCount = targetKeywords.filter((k) => normStudent.includes(k)).length;\n      const isMatch = targetKeywords.length > 0 && matchedCount >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(targetKeywords.length * 0.4));\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    default:\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * HINT-FIRST POLICY EVALUATION\n * Deliverable 3:\n * Attempt 1 wrong: show hint (conceptual — what rule applies), do NOT reveal answer\n * Attempt 2 wrong: show worked step (partial — how to approach), do NOT show final answer\n * Attempt 3 wrong OR student requested reveal (\"show me\" / \"ورّيني\"): reveal full answer + explanation, mark revealed = true\n */\nexport function getHintFirstGuidance(params: {\n  attemptCount: number;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  forceReveal?: boolean;\n  question: HomeworkQuestion;\n}): {\n  guidanceType: 'hint' | 'worked_step' | 'reveal';\n  guidanceText: string;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  allowRetry: boolean;\n  offerSimilarQuestion: boolean;\n} {\n  const { attemptCount, revealed, forceReveal, question } = params;\n\n  if (forceReveal || revealed || attemptCount >= 3) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'reveal',\n      guidanceText: question.explanation,\n      revealed: true,\n      allowRetry: false,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (attemptCount === 2) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'worked_step',\n      guidanceText: question.workedStep,\n      revealed: false,\n      allowRetry: true,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // attemptCount === 1 or default\n  return {\n    guidanceType: 'hint',\n    guidanceText: question.hint,\n    revealed: false,\n    allowRetry: true,\n    offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates a similar practice problem after reveal to re-establish mastery\n */\nexport function generateSimilarPracticeQuestion(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion\n): HomeworkQuestion {\n  return {\n    ...question,\n    id: `${question.id}_similar_${Date.now()}`,\n    prompt: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.prompt}`,\n    promptAr: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.promptAr || question.prompt}`,\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  HomeworkItem,\n  HomeworkQuestion,\n  HomeworkQuestionType,\n  MatchingPair,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  Language,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { normalizeSubjectId } from '../curriculum/subjectIdentity';\n\n/**\n * Normalizes subject string across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject ID.\n * Delegates to the shared canonical resolver so homework agrees with the planner,\n * review and curriculum engines.\n */\nexport function normalizeSubjectIdForHomework(subName?: string): string {\n  return normalizeSubjectId(subName);\n}\n\n/**\n * Searches curriculum for a matching concept.\n * Returns null if the homework cannot be linked to any curriculum concept.\n */\nexport function findConceptForHomework(\n  subject: string,\n  description: string\n): FlatCurriculumConcept | null {\n  const subjectId = normalizeSubjectId(subject);\n  if (!subjectId) return null;\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (subjectConcepts.length === 0) return null;\n\n  const descLower = description.toLowerCase().trim();\n  const descWords = descLower\n    .split(/[\\s,،.؛;()]+/)\n    .filter((w) => w.length > 2 && !['صفحة', 'حل', 'واجب', 'تمارين', 'كتاب', 'page', 'hw'].includes(w));\n\n  if (descWords.length === 0) {\n    // If description is completely vague or has no keywords, return first topic of subject\n    return subjectConcepts[0] || null;\n  }\n\n  // Score concepts based on keyword occurrences\n  const scored = subjectConcepts.map((concept) => {\n    const textAr = `${concept.nameAr} ${concept.descriptionAr || ''}`.toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = `${concept.nameEn} ${concept.descriptionEn || ''}`.toLowerCase();\n    let score = 0;\n    for (const w of descWords) {\n      if (textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w)) {\n        score += 1;\n      }\n    }\n    return { concept, score };\n  });\n\n  scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n  return scored[0]?.score > 0 ? scored[0].concept : subjectConcepts[0] || null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates questions for a linked concept across all 6 activity types.\n */\nexport function 'ا')\n    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')\n    .replace(/[\\u064B-\\u065F]/g, '') // remove Arabic tashkeel / diacritics\n    .replace(/[.,\\/#!$%\\^&\\*;:{}=\\-_`~()؟?]/g, '')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * Evaluates student answer for a digital homework question.\n */\nexport function evaluateStudentAnswer(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion,\n  studentAnswer: any\n): {\n  isCorrect: return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'short_answer':\n    case 'fill_in_the_blank': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const target = typeof question.correctAnswer === 'string'\n        ? question.correctAnswer\n        : question.blanks?.blankAnswer || '';\n      const normTarget = normalizeStudentText(target);\n\n      // Support fraction variations: 2/5 or 2 / 5 or ٢/٥\n      const cleanStudent = normStudent.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n      const cleanTarget = normTarget.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n\n      const isMatch =\n        normStudent === normTarget ||\n        cleanStudent === cleanTarget ||\n        normStudent.includes(normTarget) ||\n        normTarget.includes(normStudent);\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'matching': {\n      // studentAnswer is an array of right strings matched in order of matchingPairs\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !question.matchingPairs) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      let correctMatches = 0;\n      question.matchingPairs.forEach((pair, idx) => {\n        if (studentAnswer[idx] === pair.right) {\n          correctMatches += 1;\n        }\n      });\n      const total = question.matchingPairs.length;\n      if (correctMatches === total) {\n        return { isCorrect: true, correctness: 'full' };\n      } else if (correctMatches > 0) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'partial' };\n      }\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'ordering': {\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      const isMatch =\n        studentAnswer.length === question.correctAnswer.length &&\n        studentAnswer.every((val, idx) => val === (question.correctAnswer as string[])[idx]);\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'voice_response': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const targetStr = Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)\n        ? question.correctAnswer.join(' ')\n        : String(question.correctAnswer);\n      const targetKeywords = normalizeStudentText(targetStr)\n        .split(' ')\n        .filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n\n      // If at least one essential concept keyword is spoken\n      const matchedCount = targetKeywords.filter((k) => normStudent.includes(k)).length;\n      const isMatch = targetKeywords.length > 0 && matchedCount >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(targetKeywords.length * 0.4));\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    default:\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * HINT-FIRST POLICY EVALUATION\n * Deliverable 3:\n * Attempt 1 wrong: show hint (conceptual — what rule applies), do NOT reveal answer\n * Attempt 2 wrong: show worked step (partial — how to approach), do NOT show final answer\n * Attempt 3 wrong OR student requested reveal (\"show me\" / \"ورّيني\"): reveal full answer + explanation, mark revealed = true\n */\nexport function getHintFirstGuidance(params: {\n  attemptCount: number;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  forceReveal?: boolean;\n  question: HomeworkQuestion;\n}): {\n  guidanceType: 'hint' | 'worked_step' | 'reveal';\n  guidanceText: string;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  allowRetry: boolean;\n  offerSimilarQuestion: boolean;\n} {\n  const { attemptCount, revealed, forceReveal, question } = params;\n\n  if (forceReveal || revealed || attemptCount >= 3) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'reveal',\n      guidanceText: question.explanation,\n      revealed: true,\n      allowRetry: false,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (attemptCount === 2) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'worked_step',\n      guidanceText: question.workedStep,\n      revealed: false,\n      allowRetry: true,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // attemptCount === 1 or default\n  return {\n    guidanceType: 'hint',\n    guidanceText: question.hint,\n    revealed: false,\n    allowRetry: true,\n    offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates a similar practice problem after reveal to re-establish mastery\n */\nexport function generateSimilarPracticeQuestion(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion\n): HomeworkQuestion {\n  return {\n    ...question,\n    id: `${question.id}_similar_${Date.now()}`,\n    prompt: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.prompt}`,\n    promptAr: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.promptAr || question.prompt}`,\n  };\n}\n",

function createHomeworkItemFromDayRecord(params: {\n  studentId: string;\n  date: string;\n  subject: string;\n  description: string;\n  dueDate?: string;\n  index: number;\n}): HomeworkItem {\n  const { studentId, date, subject, description, dueDate, index } = params;\n  const homeworkItemId = `hw_${studentId}_${date}_${index}`;\n  const matchedConcept = findConceptForHomework(subject, description);\n\n  if (!matchedConcept) {\n    return {\n      id: homeworkItemId,\n      studentId,\n      date,\n      subject,\n      description,\n      dueDate,\n      unlinked: true,\n      status: 'pending',\n      questions: [],\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  const questions = generateQuestionsForConcept(matchedConcept, homeworkItemId);\n\n  return {\n    id: homeworkItemId,\n    studentId,\n    date,\n    subject,\n    description,\n    dueDate,\n    conceptId: matchedConcept.id,\n    unlinked: false,\n    status: 'pending',\n    questions,\n    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalizes text for lenient student answer checking\n */\nexport function normalizeStudentText(raw?: string): string {\n  if (!raw) return '';\n  return raw\n    .trim()\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')\n    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')\n    .replace(/[\\u064B-\\u065F]/g, '') // remove Arabic tashkeel / diacritics\n    .replace(/[.,\\/#!$%\\^&\\*;:{}=\\-_`~()؟?]/g, '')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * Evaluates student answer for a digital homework question.\n */\nexport function evaluateStudentAnswer(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion,\n  studentAnswer: any\n): {\n  isCorrect: boolean;\n  correctness: 'full' | 'partial' | 'wrong';\n  feedback?: string;\n} {\n  if (studentAnswer === undefined || studentAnswer === null || studentAnswer === '') {\n    return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n\n  switch (question.type) {\n    case 'multiple_choice': {\n      const isMatch = String(studentAnswer).trim() === String(question.correctAnswer).trim();\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'short_answer':\n    case 'fill_in_the_blank': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const target = typeof question.correctAnswer === 'string'\n        ? question.correctAnswer\n        : question.blanks?.blankAnswer || '';\n      const normTarget = normalizeStudentText(target);\n\n      // Support fraction variations: 2/5 or 2 / 5 or ٢/٥\n      const cleanStudent = normStudent.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n      const cleanTarget = normTarget.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n\n      const isMatch =\n        normStudent === normTarget ||\n        cleanStudent === cleanTarget ||\n        normStudent.includes(normTarget) ||\n        normTarget.includes(normStudent);\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'matching': {\n      // studentAnswer is an array of right strings matched in order of matchingPairs\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !question.matchingPairs) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      let correctMatches = 0;\n      question.matchingPairs.forEach((pair, idx) => {\n        if (studentAnswer[idx] === pair.right) {\n          correctMatches += 1;\n        }\n      });\n      const total = question.matchingPairs.length;\n      if (correctMatches === total) {\n        return { isCorrect: true, correctness: 'full' };\n      } else if (correctMatches > 0) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'partial' };\n      }\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'ordering': {\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      const isMatch =\n        studentAnswer.length === question.correctAnswer.length &&\n        studentAnswer.every((val, idx) => val === (question.correctAnswer as string[])[idx]);\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'voice_response': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const targetStr = Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)\n        ? question.correctAnswer.join(' ')\n        : String(question.correctAnswer);\n      const targetKeywords = normalizeStudentText(targetStr)\n        .split(' ')\n        .filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n\n      // If at least one essential concept keyword is spoken\n      const matchedCount = targetKeywords.filter((k) => normStudent.includes(k)).length;\n      const isMatch = targetKeywords.length > 0 && matchedCount >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(targetKeywords.length * 0.4));\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    default:\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * HINT-FIRST POLICY EVALUATION\n * Deliverable 3:\n * Attempt 1 wrong: show hint (conceptual — what rule applies), do NOT reveal answer\n * Attempt 2 wrong: show worked step (partial — how to approach), do NOT show final answer\n * Attempt 3 wrong OR student requested reveal (\"show me\" / \"ورّيني\"): reveal full answer + explanation, mark revealed = true\n */\nexport function getHintFirstGuidance(params: {\n  attemptCount: number;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  forceReveal?: boolean;\n  question: HomeworkQuestion;\n}): {\n  guidanceType: 'hint' | 'worked_step' | 'reveal';\n  guidanceText: string;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  allowRetry: boolean;\n  offerSimilarQuestion: boolean;\n} {\n  const { attemptCount, revealed, forceReveal, question } = params;\n\n  if (forceReveal || revealed || attemptCount >= 3) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'reveal',\n      guidanceText: question.explanation,\n      revealed: true,\n      allowRetry: false,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (attemptCount === 2) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'worked_step',\n      guidanceText: question.workedStep,\n      revealed: false,\n      allowRetry: true,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // attemptCount === 1 or default\n  return {\n    guidanceType: 'hint',\n    guidanceText: question.hint,\n    revealed: false,\n    allowRetry: true,\n    offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates a similar practice problem after reveal to re-establish mastery\n */\nexport function generateSimilarPracticeQuestion(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion\n): HomeworkQuestion {\n  return {\n    ...question,\n    id: `${question.id}_similar_${Date.now()}`,\n    prompt: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.prompt}`,\n    promptAr: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.promptAr || question.prompt}`,\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  HomeworkItem,\n  HomeworkQuestion,\n  HomeworkQuestionType,\n  MatchingPair,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  Language,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { normalizeSubjectId } from '../curriculum/subjectIdentity';\n\nexport { findConceptForHomework(\n  subject: string,\n  description: string\n): FlatCurriculumConcept | null {\n  const subjectId = normalizeSubjectId(subject);\n  if (!subjectId) return null;\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (subjectConcepts.length === 0) return null;\n\n  const descLower = description.toLowerCase().trim();\n  const descWords = descLower\n    .split(/[\\s,،.؛;()]+/)\n    .filter((w) => w.length > 2 && !['صفحة', 'حل', 'واجب', 'تمارين', 'كتاب', 'page', 'hw'].includes(w));\n\n  if (descWords.length === 0) {\n    // If description is completely vague or has no keywords, return first topic of subject\n    return subjectConcepts[0] || null;\n  }\n\n  // Score concepts based on keyword occurrences\n  const scored = subjectConcepts.map((concept) => {\n    const textAr = `${concept.nameAr} ${concept.descriptionAr || ''}`.toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = `${concept.nameEn} ${concept.descriptionEn || ''}`.toLowerCase();\n    let score = 0;\n    for (const w of descWords) {\n      if (textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w)) {\n        score += 1;\n      }\n    }\n    return { concept, score };\n  });\n\n  scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n  return scored[0]?.score > 0 ? scored[0].concept : subjectConcepts[0] || null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Date().toISOString(),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalizes text for lenient student answer checking\n */\nexport function normalizeStudentText(raw?: string): string {\n  if (!raw) return '';\n  return raw\n    .trim()\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')\n    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')\n    .replace(/[\\u064B-\\u065F]/g, '') // remove Arabic tashkeel / diacritics\n    .replace(/[.,\\/#!$%\\^&\\*;:{}=\\-_`~()؟?]/g, '')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * Evaluates student answer for a digital homework question.\n */\nexport function evaluateStudentAnswer(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion,\n  studentAnswer: any\n): {\n  isCorrect: boolean;\n  correctness: 'full' | 'partial' | 'wrong';\n  feedback?: string;\n} {\n  if (studentAnswer === undefined || studentAnswer === null || studentAnswer === '') {\n    return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n\n  switch (question.type) {\n    case 'multiple_choice': {\n      const isMatch = String(studentAnswer).trim() === String(question.correctAnswer).trim();\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'short_answer':\n    case 'fill_in_the_blank': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const target = typeof question.correctAnswer === 'string'\n        ? question.correctAnswer\n        : question.blanks?.blankAnswer || '';\n      const normTarget = normalizeStudentText(target);\n\n      // Support fraction variations: 2/5 or 2 / 5 or ٢/٥\n      const cleanStudent = normStudent.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n      const cleanTarget = normTarget.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))).replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n\n      const isMatch =\n        normStudent === normTarget ||\n        cleanStudent === cleanTarget ||\n        normStudent.includes(normTarget) ||\n        normTarget.includes(normStudent);\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'matching': {\n      // studentAnswer is an array of right strings matched in order of matchingPairs\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !question.matchingPairs) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      let correctMatches = 0;\n      question.matchingPairs.forEach((pair, idx) => {\n        if (studentAnswer[idx] === pair.right) {\n          correctMatches += 1;\n        }\n      });\n      const total = question.matchingPairs.length;\n      if (correctMatches === total) {\n        return { isCorrect: true, correctness: 'full' };\n      } else if (correctMatches > 0) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'partial' };\n      }\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'ordering': {\n      if (!Array.isArray(studentAnswer) || !Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)) {\n        return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n      }\n      const isMatch =\n        studentAnswer.length === question.correctAnswer.length &&\n        studentAnswer.every((val, idx) => val === (question.correctAnswer as string[])[idx]);\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    case 'voice_response': {\n      const normStudent = normalizeStudentText(String(studentAnswer));\n      const targetStr = Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer)\n        ? question.correctAnswer.join(' ')\n        : String(question.correctAnswer);\n      const targetKeywords = normalizeStudentText(targetStr)\n        .split(' ')\n        .filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n\n      // If at least one essential concept keyword is spoken\n      const matchedCount = targetKeywords.filter((k) => normStudent.includes(k)).length;\n      const isMatch = targetKeywords.length > 0 && matchedCount >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(targetKeywords.length * 0.4));\n\n      return { isCorrect: isMatch, correctness: isMatch ? 'full' : 'wrong' };\n    }\n\n    default:\n      return { isCorrect: false, correctness: 'wrong' };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * HINT-FIRST POLICY EVALUATION\n * Deliverable 3:\n * Attempt 1 wrong: show hint (conceptual — what rule applies), do NOT reveal answer\n * Attempt 2 wrong: show worked step (partial — how to approach), do NOT show final answer\n * Attempt 3 wrong OR student requested reveal (\"show me\" / \"ورّيني\"): reveal full answer + explanation, mark revealed = true\n */\nexport function getHintFirstGuidance(params: {\n  attemptCount: number;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  forceReveal?: boolean;\n  question: HomeworkQuestion;\n}): {\n  guidanceType: 'hint' | 'worked_step' | 'reveal';\n  guidanceText: string;\n  revealed: boolean;\n  allowRetry: boolean;\n  offerSimilarQuestion: boolean;\n} {\n  const { attemptCount, revealed, forceReveal, question } = params;\n\n  if (forceReveal || revealed || attemptCount >= 3) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'reveal',\n      guidanceText: question.explanation,\n      revealed: true,\n      allowRetry: false,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (attemptCount === 2) {\n    return {\n      guidanceType: 'worked_step',\n      guidanceText: question.workedStep,\n      revealed: false,\n      allowRetry: true,\n      offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // attemptCount === 1 or default\n  return {\n    guidanceType: 'hint',\n    guidanceText: question.hint,\n    revealed: false,\n    allowRetry: true,\n    offerSimilarQuestion: false,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates a similar practice problem after reveal to re-establish mastery\n */\nexport function generateSimilarPracticeQuestion(\n  question: HomeworkQuestion\n): HomeworkQuestion {\n  return {\n    ...question,\n    id: `${question.id}_similar_${Date.now()}`,\n    prompt: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.prompt}`,\n    promptAr: `مسألة تدريبية مماثلة: ${question.promptAr || question.prompt}`,\n  };\n}\n",

Would you like to add anything else?';\n  }\n\n  const parts: string[] = [];\n\n  lessons.forEach((l) => {\n    if (isArabic) {\n      let desc = `في ${l.subject}`;\n      if (l.topic) desc += `: درس «${l.topic}»`;\n      if (l.notes) desc += ` (${l.notes})`;\n      parts.push(desc);\n    } else {\n      let desc = `in ${l.subject}`;\n      if (l.topic) desc += `: lesson on \"${l.topic}\"`;\n      if (l.notes) desc += ` (${l.notes})`;\n      parts.push(desc);\n    }\n  });\n\n  const hwParts: string[] = [];\n  homework.forEach((h) => {\n    if (isArabic) {\n      let desc = `واجب ${h.subject}`;\n      if (h.description) desc += `: ${h.description}`;\n      if (h.dueDate) desc += ` (تسليم: ${h.dueDate})`;\n      hwParts.push(desc);\n    } else {\n      let desc = `homework for ${h.subject}`;\n      if (h.description) desc += `: ${h.description}`;\n      if (h.dueDate) desc += ` (due: ${h.dueDate})`;\n      hwParts.push(desc);\n    }\n  });\n\n  if (isArabic) {\n    let summary = 'يعني النهارده ';\n    if (parts.length > 0) {\n      summary += parts.join('، ومادة ') + '.';\n    }\n    if (hwParts.length > 0) {\n      summary += ' وبالنسبة للواجبات: ' + hwParts.join('، و') + '.';\n    }\n    summary += ' فهمت كلامك صح كده ولا تحب نعدل حاجة؟';\n    return summary;\n  } else {\n    let summary = 'So today you had ';\n    if (parts.length > 0) {\n      summary += parts.join(', and ') + '.';\n    }\n    if (hwParts.length > 0) {\n      summary += ' And for homework: ' + hwParts.join(', and ') + '.';\n    }\n    summary += ' Did I get that right, or would you like to tweak anything?';\n    return summary;\n  }\n}\n",

 const rq = recheckQuestion || teacherContext.recheckQuestion;\n    const prompt = isArabic\n      ? `دلوقتي بعد ما شرحنا الفكرة يا ${studentName}، تعالي نتحقق من فهمك بمثال تطبيقي جديد ونشوف النتيجة سوا!`\n      : `Now that we explored the concept, ${studentName}, let's verify with a brand new practice example!`;\n    speakText(prompt, 'excited');\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectRecheckOption = (optIdx: number) => {\n    if (isRecheckSubmitted) return;\n    setSelectedRecheckIndex(optIdx);\n    soundEffects.playPop();\n  };\n\n  // Confirm Re-Check & Evaluate Real Outcome\n  const handleConfirmRecheck = async () => {\n    if (selectedRecheckIndex === null) return;\n    soundEffects.playPop();\n\n    const rq = recheckQuestion || teacherContext.recheckQuestion;\n    const selectedRecheckOpt = rq.options[selectedRecheckIndex];\n    if (!selectedRecheckOpt) return;\n\n    // 1. Analyze Recheck Reasoning\n    const recheckAnalysis = analyzeStudentReasoning(\n      recheckThinkingInput,\n      {\n        isCorrect: selectedRecheckOpt.isCorrect,\n        diagnosisType: selectedRecheckOpt.isCorrect ? 'solid_understanding' : 'misconception',\n        suggestedStrategy: 'guided_practice',\n        textAr: selectedRecheckOpt.textAr,\n        textEn: selectedRecheckOpt.textEn,\n        textFr: selectedRecheckOpt.textFr,\n        diagnosisExplanationAr: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationAr,\n        diagnosisExplanationEn: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationEn,\n        diagnosisExplanationFr: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationFr,\n        pedagogicHintAr: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationAr,\n        pedagogicHintEn: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationEn,\n        pedagogicHintFr: selectedRecheckOpt.explanationFr,\n      },\n      teacherContext.targetConcept,\n      currentLesson,\n      language\n    );\n    setRecheckReasoningAnalysis(recheckAnalysis);\n    setIsRecheckSubmitted(true);\n\n    // 2. Evaluate Genuine Teaching Outcome\n    const outcomeEval = evaluateTeachingOutcome({\n      initialDiagnosticCorrect: Boolean(\n        selectedDiagnosticIndex !== null &&\n        teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.options[selectedDiagnosticIndex]?.isCorrect\n      ),\n      initialReasoningCategory: reasoningAnalysis?.category || 'unclear_reasoning',\n      recheckCorrect: selectedRecheckOpt.isCorrect,\n      recheckReasoningCategory: recheckAnalysis.category,\n      attemptsCount: 2,\n    });\n\n    setSessionOutcome(outcomeEval.outcome);\n    setSessionOutcomeRationale(isArabic ? outcomeEval.rationaleAr : isFrench ? outcomeEval.rationaleFr : outcomeEval.rationaleEn);\n    setSessionReviewInterval(outcomeEval.reviewIntervalDays);\n\n    // 3. Record Real Evidence to Existing Mastery Architecture\n    const targetConceptId = teacherContext.targetConcept?.id || `${currentLesson.id}_c1`;\n    await recordEvidence(targetConceptId, {\n      correctness: outcomeEval.evidenceCorrectness,\n      difficulty: 0.6,\n      independence: outcomeEval.evidenceIndependence,\n      modality: 'quiz',\n      notes: `Miss Nour Adaptive Closed Loop: Diagnostic=${reasoningAnalysis?.category || 'unknown'} -> Teaching=${chosenTeachingStrategy} -> Recheck=${recheckAnalysis.category} -> Outcome=${outcomeEval.outcome.toUpperCase()}`,\n    });\n    setSessionEvidenceRecorded(true);\n\n    // 4. Complete Mission if applicable\n    if (companionContext?.missionId && (outcomeEval.outcome === 'mastered' || outcomeEval.outcome === 'almost')) {\n      completeMission(companionContext.missionId, {\n        score: outcomeEval.outcome === 'mastered' ? 1.0 : 0.8,\n        modality: 'practice',\n      });\n      setMissionDoneNotification(true);\n    }\n\n    // 5. Miss Nour Voice Feedback based on real outcome\n    if (outcomeEval.outcome === 'mastered') {\n      soundEffects.playSuccess();\n      soundEffects.playStarEarned();\n      setStarsCount((prev) => prev + 2);\n      const msg = isArabic\n        ? `🎉 ألف مبروك يا بطلتنا ${studentName}! أثبتِ إتقانك للمفهوم بتعليل منطقي سليم على مثال جديد. تم تسجيل إتقانك وتحديث خريطة التعلم!`\n        : `🎉 Fantastic ${studentName}! We scheduled this for a quick review tomorrow to reinforce it smoothly.`;\n      speakText(msg, 'encouraging');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Tap on Nour for a fun interactive cheer\n  const handleNourTap = () => {\n    soundEffects.playBounce();\n    const cheers = [\n      isArabic\n        ? `أهلاً ببطلتنا ${studentName}! أنا فخورة بوجودك معايا في الفصل النهاردة! 🌟`\n        : `Hello champion ${studentName}! I am so happy to learn with you today! 🌟`,\n      isArabic\n        ? `كل سؤال بتسأليه يا ${studentName} بيخلّيكي أذكى وأقوى في مذاكرتك! 💪`\n        : `Every question you ask makes you sharper and stronger in your studies, ${studentName}! 💪`,\n      isArabic\n        ? `يا سلام على النشاط والتركيز يا ${studentName}! يلا نذاكر ونجمع النجوم الذهبية سوا! 🚀`\n        : `Look at that focus and energy, ${studentName}! Let's earn our gold stars together! 🚀`,\n    ];\n    const cheer = cheers[Math.floor(Math.random() * cheers.length)];\n    speakText(cheer, 'excited');\n  };\n\n  // Ring the school bell\n  const handleRingBell = () => {\n    soundEffects.playSchoolBell();\n    const greeting = isArabic\n      ? `🔔 رن جرس الحصة! الكل يركز مع مس نور في درس «${currentLesson.titleAr}»!`\n      : isFrench\n      ? `🔔 La cloche a sonné!
