        setTimeout(() => handleNextBeat(true), 1200);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_match_pairs':\n        return (\n          <MatchPairsBoard\n            pairs={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.pairs || []}\n            onAllMatched={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_drag_drop':\n        return (\n          <DragDropMat\n            zones={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.zones || []}\n            items={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.items || []}\n            onComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_trace':\n        return (\n          <TraceCanvas\n            letterPrompt={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.letterPrompt || 'أ'}\n            instructionAr={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.instructionAr || 'تتبعي الحرف:'}\n            instructionEn={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.instructionEn || 'Trace letter:'}\n            onTraceComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_choose_answer':\n        return (\n          <ChoiceCard\n            questionText={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.questionText}\n            options={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.options || []}\n            onAnswerSelected={(isCorrect) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(isCorrect);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_build':\n        return (\n          <BuildCanvas\n            centerConcept={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.centerConcept || 'نهر النيل'}\n            nodes={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.nodes || []}\n            onBuildComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_speak_answer':\n        return (\n          <VoiceAnswerControl\n            promptText={isAr ? currentBeat.nourTextAr : currentBeat.nourTextEn}\n            onAnswerSubmit={(text) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'explain_back':\n        return (\n          <ExplainBackStage\n            conceptTitle={\n              currentBeat.interactionPayload?.conceptTitle ||\n              (isAr ? 'قسم حماية النيل' : 'Nile Protection Oath')\n            }\n            onExplainSubmitted={(explanation) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_tap_object':\n      default:\n        return (\n          <div className=\"w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-center p-3 max-w-sm mx-auto space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => handleNextBeat(true)}\n              className=\"w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer\"\n            >\n              <span>{isAr ? 'فهمت الفكرة يا نور، لنكمل!' : 'Understood Nour, let’s continue!'}</span>\n              {isAr ? <ChevronLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        );\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-3 overflow-hidden select-none\"\n      dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}\n      onClick={() => {\n        // Unlock browser audio context on any modal click\n        if (!hasStartedAudio) {\n          setHasStartedAudio(true);\n          playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n        }\n      }}\n    >\n      <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-xl h-full sm:h-[94vh] sm:max-h-[860px] bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-none sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden\">\n        {/* TOP HEADER: TITLE, PROGRESS DOTS, VOICE CONTROLS & CHAT FALLBACK */}\n        <div className=\"px-3 py-2 bg-slate-900/90 text-white border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 z-30\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <div className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs\">\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-amber-300\" />\n            </div>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                <span>{isAr ? sequence.lessonTitleAr : sequence.lessonTitleEn}</span>\n                <span className=\"text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-300 font-bold\">\n                  {isAr ? `مع نور لـ ${studentName}` : `With Nour for ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium\">\n                {sequence.sourceRefText}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Center Beat Progress Dots */}\n          <div className=\"hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {sequence.beats.map((b, i) => (\n              <span\n                key={b.id}\n                className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${\n                  i === sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-5 bg-amber-400'\n                    : i < sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-2 bg-emerald-400'\n                    : 'w-1.5 bg-slate-700'\n                }`}\n              />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Action Tools */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {/* Talk to Nour (Fallback Chat Drawer Trigger) */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(!showChatFallback)}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n            >\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Mute Toggle */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={handleToggleMute}\n              className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${\n                isMuted ? 'text-rose-400 bg-rose-950/40' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'\n              }`}\n              title={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n              aria-label={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n            >\n              {isMuted ? <VolumeX className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Close */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={onClose}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n            >\n              <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Browser Audio Unlock Reminder Banner */}\n        {!hasStartedAudio && !isMuted && (\n          <div\n            onClick={(e) => {\n              e.stopPropagation();\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n            }}\n            className=\"w-full bg-linear-to-r from-amber-500 via-amber-400 to-yellow-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs py-1.5 px-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-md animate-pulse z-40\"\n          >\n            <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4 animate-bounce\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'اضغطي هنا لتشغيل صوت نور التفاعلي 🔊' : 'Tap here to enable Nour’s voice 🔊'}</span>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* 1. TOP 55%: SCENE CANVAS */}\n        <div className=\"h-[55%] w-full relative shrink-0\">\n          <StageSceneCanvas\n            nourState={sessionState.nourCurrentState}\n            outfit={sequence.outfit}\n            isNourSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            clipId={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.clipId}\n            interactiveObjects={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.interactiveObjects}\n            onObjectTap={(obj) => {\n              const text = isAr ? obj.descriptionAr : obj.descriptionEn;\n              setTutorSpokenText(text);\n              playTutorSpeech(text);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n            onNourTap={handleReplayVoice}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. MIDDLE 20%: NARRATION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[20%] w-full shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-center\">\n          <NarrationBar\n            spokenText={tutorSpokenText}\n            isSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            isMuted={isMuted}\n            sourceRefText={`ص. ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}`}\n            language={language}\n            onReplayAudio={handleReplayVoice}\n            onToggleMute={handleToggleMute}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. BOTTOM 25%: INTERACTION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[25%] w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto\">\n          {renderInteractionZone()}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* FALLBACK CHAT DRAWER (\"Talk to Nour\" - Sub-Phase 11.7) */}\n        {showChatFallback && (\n          <div className=\"absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[65%] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-t-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300\">\n            <div className=\"p-3 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-b border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between\">\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n                <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? `محادثة مفتوحة مع نور يا ${studentName}` : `Talk to Nour, ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(false)}\n                className=\"p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat History */}\n            <div className=\"flex-1 p-3 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 text-xs\">\n              <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقتكِ ومعلمتكِ نور. لو فيه أي سؤال في درس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» مش فاهماه أو سؤال يدور في ذهنكِ، احكيلي براحتك خالص!`\n                  : `Hi ${studentName}! I’m Nour. If anything in \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\" isn't clear or you have any curious thought, ask me freely!`}\n              </div>\n\n              {chatMessages.map((msg, i) => (\n                <div\n                  key={i}\n                  className={`flex ${msg.role === 'child' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}\n                >\n                  <div\n                    className={`max-w-[85%] p-2.5 rounded-2xl ${\n                      msg.role === 'child'\n                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                        : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    {msg.text}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat Input */}\n            <form onSubmit={handleSendFallbackChat} className=\"p-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex gap-2\">\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                value={chatInput}\n                onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}\n                placeholder={isAr ? 'اسألي نور أي سؤال...' : 'Ask Nour anything...'}\n                className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n              />\n              <button\n                type=\"submit\"\n                disabled={!chatInput.trim()}\n                className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                {isAr ? 'إرسال' : 'Send'}\n              </button>\n            </form>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { resolveStudentName } from '../../utils/studentAddress';\nimport {\n  StageLessonSequence,\n  StageSessionState,\n  BeatDefinition,\n  NourState,\n} from '../../types/stage';\nimport { stageEngine } from '../../services/stage/stageEngine';\nimport { voiceService } from '../../services/voice/voiceService';\nimport { storageService } from '../../services/storage';\nimport { StageSceneCanvas } from './StageSceneCanvas';\nimport { NarrationBar } from './NarrationBar';\n\n// Toolkit Interactions\nimport { TapWordCard } from './interactions/TapWordCard';\nimport { MatchPairsBoard } from './interactions/MatchPairsBoard';\nimport { DragDropMat } from './interactions/DragDropMat';\nimport { TraceCanvas } from './interactions/TraceCanvas';\nimport { ChoiceCard } from './interactions/ChoiceCard';\nimport { BuildCanvas } from './interactions/BuildCanvas';\nimport { VoiceAnswerControl } from './interactions/VoiceAnswerControl';\nimport { ExplainBackStage } from './interactions/ExplainBackStage';\n\nimport {\n  X,\n  Volume2,\n  VolumeX,\n  MessageCircle,\n  Sparkles,\n  ChevronRight,\n  ChevronLeft,\n  HelpCircle,\n  Send,\n  Heart,\n  Lightbulb,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface StageModalProps {\n  lessonId: string;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  onSessionComplete?: () => void;\n}\n\n/**\n * THE STAGE — The Interactive Human-Like Animated Multimodal Tutor Modal\n * (Phase 11 & Sub-Phase 11.2 - 11.9)\n *\n * Implements an interactive private tutor (Nour) who:\n * 1. Speaks aloud with synchronized word-by-word highlights.\n * 2. Actively asks Amina if she understood after each explanation.\n * 3. Fulfils explanations with warm, relatable real-life Egyptian examples when asked.\n * 4. Answers Amina's questions dynamically in friendly conversation.\n * 5. Guides her through touch, calligraphy tracing, concept building, and explain-back.\n */\nexport const StageModal: React.FC<StageModalProps> = ({\n  lessonId,\n  onClose,\n  onSessionComplete,\n}) => {\n  const { language, recordEvidence, showToast, student } = useApp();\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const studentName = resolveStudentName(student?.name, language);\n\n  const [sequence] = useState<StageLessonSequence>(() =>\n    stageEngine.getSequenceForLesson(lessonId)\n  );\n\n  const [sessionState, setSessionState] = useState<StageSessionState>(() =>\n    stageEngine.initSession(lessonId)\n  );\n\n  const [isSpeaking, setIsSpeaking] = useState(false);\n  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);\n  const [hasStartedAudio, setHasStartedAudio] = useState(false);\n\n  // Conversational Tutor state\n  const [tutorSpokenText, setTutorSpokenText] = useState<string>('');\n  const [isAskingClarification, setIsAskingClarification] = useState(false);\n  const [showQuestionInput, setShowQuestionInput] = useState(false);\n  const [customQuestionInput, setCustomQuestionInput] = useState('');\n  const [isAnsweringQuestion, setIsAnsweringQuestion] = useState(false);\n\n  // Chat Drawer Fallback state\n  const [showChatFallback, setShowChatFallback] = useState(false);\n  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState('');\n  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<Array<{ role: 'nour' | 'child'; text: string }>>([]);\n\n  const currentBeat: BeatDefinition | undefined =\n    sequence.beats[sessionState.currentBeatIndex];\n\n  // Helper to speak and update state\n  const playTutorSpeech = (text: string) => {\n    if (isMuted) return;\n    setIsSpeaking(true);\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    voiceService.unlockAudio();\n\n    voiceService.speak(\n      text,\n      isAr ? 'ar' : 'en',\n      () => setIsSpeaking(true),\n      () => setIsSpeaking(false),\n      () => setIsSpeaking(false)\n    );\n  };\n\n  // Sync spoken text when beat changes\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!currentBeat) return;\n\n    let baseText = isAr ? currentBeat.nourTextAr : currentBeat.nourTextEn;\n    // Personalize with Amina's name\n    baseText = baseText.replace(/أمينة/g, studentName).replace(/Amina/g, studentName);\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(baseText);\n    setIsAskingClarification(false);\n    setShowQuestionInput(false);\n\n    // If user has already interacted, speak immediately\n    if (hasStartedAudio && !isMuted) {\n      playTutorSpeech(baseText);\n    }\n\n    return () => {\n      voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n    };\n  }, [currentBeat?.id, hasStartedAudio, isMuted, isAr, studentName]);\n\n  const handleNextBeat = async (childSuccess: boolean = true) => {\n    voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n    setIsSpeaking(false);\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n\n    const { newState, result } = stageEngine.advanceBeat(sessionState, childSuccess);\n    setSessionState(newState);\n\n    // Record invisible mastery evidence\n    if (result.masteryEvidence) {\n      await recordEvidence(result.masteryEvidence.conceptId, {\n        correctness: result.masteryEvidence.correctness,\n        difficulty: 0.5,\n        independence: result.masteryEvidence.independence,\n        modality: result.masteryEvidence.modality,\n        notes: `The Stage: Beat ${currentBeat?.type} in ${sequence.lessonTitleAr}`,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Save session in IndexedDB if active student exists\n    if (student?.id) {\n      await storageService.saveTeachingSession({\n        sessionId: `stage_sess_${lessonId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        lessonId,\n        subjectId: sequence.subjectId,\n        startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        currentConceptIndex: newState.currentBeatIndex,\n        totalConcepts: sequence.beats.length,\n        currentStep: 'teach',\n        currentAttemptCount: 0,\n        modalityHistory: ['structured_visual'],\n        turnHistory: [],\n        explainBackDone: Object.values(newState.explainBackPassed).some(Boolean),\n        offBookQuestions: newState.offBookQuestions.map((q) => ({\n          question: q,\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          parentNote: `سؤال استكشافي من المسرح التفاعلي: \"${q}\"`,\n        })),\n        status: result.isLessonCompleted ? 'completed' : 'in_progress',\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (result.isLessonCompleted) {\n      showToast(\n        isAr\n          ? `🎉 مبارك يا ${studentName}! أتممتِ جلسة المسرح التفاعلي لدرس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» بنجاح باهر!`\n          : `🎉 Congratulations ${studentName}! You completed The Stage for \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\"!`\n      );\n      onSessionComplete?.();\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina says \"مش فاهماها أوي.. وضحيلي بمثال\"\n  const handleExplainWithAnalogy = () => {\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'encouraging' }));\n\n    const analogyText = isAr\n      ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName} يا حبيبتي! تعالي نتخيلها بمثال من بيتنا: لو المية اتقطعت عن البيت يوم كامل في الصيف.. لا هنعرف نشرب، ولا ماما هتعرف تطبخ، والزرع هيموت! عشان كده أجدادنا الفراعنة كانوا بيعتبروا النيل مش مجرد نهر عادي، ده سر الحياة، وكانوا بيقسموا إنهم ميوسخوهوش أبداً بإلقاء القمامة. ها، كده الرؤية وضحت في دماغك؟`\n      : `Don't worry at all, ${studentName}! Picture this: if water was shut off at home for an entire day, we couldn't drink, cook, or water plants! That's why ancient Egyptians swore to never pollute the Nile. Does that make sense now?`;\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(analogyText);\n    playTutorSpeech(analogyText);\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina asks \"يعني إيه الكلمة دي؟\"\n  const handleExplainWordMeaning = () => {\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'talking' }));\n\n    const meaningText = isAr\n      ? `بصي يا ${studentName}: كلمة «لم أوتِ» معناها في اللغة المصرية القديمة: لم أدنّس، ولم ألوّث، ولم أفسد طهارة ماء النهر أبداً بإلقاء المخلفات. كلمة قوية جداً بتدل على احترامهم العظيم للنيل!`\n      : `Look ${studentName}: \"لم أوت\" means: I have never defiled, polluted, or spoiled the purity of the river water with waste. It shows deep respect for the Nile!`;\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(meaningText);\n    playTutorSpeech(meaningText);\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina asks an open question\n  const handleSendCustomQuery = async () => {\n    const query = customQuestionInput.trim();\n    if (!query) return;\n\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAnsweringQuestion(true);\n    setCustomQuestionInput('');\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'thinking' }));\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch('/api/tutor-reply', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          studentInput: query,\n          currentBeatText: tutorSpokenText,\n          language: isAr ? 'ar' : 'en',\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const data = await resp.json();\n      const reply = data.reply || (isAr ? `أنا معاكي يا ${studentName}، وضحت ليكي الفكرة؟` : `I'm with you ${studentName}!`);\n\n      setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'talking' }));\n      setTutorSpokenText(reply);\n      playTutorSpeech(reply);\n      setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.warn('tutor-reply error:', e);\n    } finally {\n      setIsAnsweringQuestion(false);\n      setShowQuestionInput(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleReplayVoice = () => {\n    if (!tutorSpokenText) return;\n    playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n  };\n\n  const handleToggleMute = () => {\n    if (!isMuted) {\n      voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n      setIsSpeaking(false);\n    }\n    setIsMuted(!isMuted);\n  };\n\n  // Fallback Chat Handler (routes off-book questions safely)\n  const handleSendFallbackChat = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const query = chatInput.trim();\n    if (!query) return;\n\n    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: 'child', text: query }]);\n    setChatInput('');\n\n    const lower = query.toLowerCase();\n    const isOffBook =\n      lower.includes('فضاء') ||\n      lower.includes('ديناصور') ||\n      lower.includes('كورة') ||\n      lower.includes('space');\n\n    if (isOffBook) {\n      setSessionState((prev) => ({\n        ...prev,\n        offBookQuestions: [...prev.offBookQuestions, query],\n      }));\n      setChatMessages((prev) => [\n        ...prev,\n        {\n          role: 'nour',\n          text: isAr\n            ? `سؤال ذكي وفضولي جداً يا ${studentName}! لكنه خارج كتابنا لدرس اليوم (${sequence.sourceRefText}). دعيني أركز معكِ على الدرس وسجلت سؤالكِ الجميل لمناقشته مع والديك!`\n            : `That’s a brilliant curious question ${studentName}! It’s not in our textbook lesson today though. Let’s focus on your lesson, and I saved your great question for family talk!`,\n        },\n      ]);\n    } else {\n      setChatMessages((prev) => [\n        ...prev,\n        {\n          role: 'nour',\n          text: isAr\n            ? `أنا معاكي يا ${studentName}! نحن ندرس معاً درس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» من صفحة ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}. دعينا نركز في هذه الخطوة الجميلة!`\n            : `I'm with you, ${studentName}! We are learning \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\" from page ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}. Let's continue on the stage!`,\n        },\n      ]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Render context-sensitive interaction component for the bottom 25%\n  const renderInteractionZone = () => {\n    if (!currentBeat) return null;\n\n    switch (currentBeat.type) {\n      case 'scene_open':\n      case 'character_speak':\n        return (\n          <div className=\"w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-center p-2.5 max-w-lg mx-auto space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200\">\n            {/* Real Human-Like Tutor Check-In */}\n            <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold bg-amber-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-slate-700\">\n              <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200\">\n                <Sparkles className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500 shrink-0\" />\n                <span>\n                  {isAr\n                    ? `يا ${studentName}، هل النقطة دي واضحة ليكي ولا تحبي أوضحهالك أكتر؟`\n                    : `${studentName}, does this make sense or would you like another example?`}\n                </span>\n              </span>\n\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowQuestionInput(!showQuestionInput)}\n                className=\"text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ml-1\"\n              >\n                <HelpCircle className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                <span>{isAr ? 'اسألي نور' : 'Ask Nour'}</span>\n              </button>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Conversational Action Options */}\n            {!isAskingClarification && !showQuestionInput ? (\n              <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-1.5\">\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => handleNextBeat(true)}\n                  className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:scale-95 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between hover:scale-101 cursor-pointer\"\n                >\n                  <span>{isAr ? 'فهمت كويس يا نور! كملي 👍' : 'Understood, continue! 👍'}</span>\n                  {isAr ? <ChevronLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n                </button>\n\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={handleExplainWithAnalogy}\n                  className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between hover:scale-101 cursor-pointer\"\n                >\n                  <span>{isAr ? 'مش فاهماها أوي.. بمثال 🤔' : 'Explain with example 🤔'}</span>\n                  <Lightbulb className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0\" />\n                </button>\n\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={handleExplainWordMeaning}\n                  className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between hover:scale-101 cursor-pointer\"\n                >\n                  <span>{isAr ? 'يعني إيه الكلمة دي؟ ❓' : 'Word meaning? ❓'}</span>\n                  <HelpCircle className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 shrink-0\" />\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            ) : isAskingClarification ? (\n              <div className=\"space-y-1.5 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200\">\n                <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => {\n                      setIsAskingClarification(false);\n                      handleNextBeat(true);\n                    }}\n                    className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:scale-95 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ? 'أيوة كده فهمت جداً يا نور! 🌟 يلا نكمل' : 'Now I understand! Let’s continue 🌟'}</span>\n                    {isAr ? <ChevronLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n                  </button>\n\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setShowQuestionInput(true)}\n                    className=\"py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 hover:bg-indigo-200 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-100 font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer\"\n                  >\n                    {isAr ? 'عندي سؤال تاني' : 'Another question'}\n                  </button>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            ) : (\n              /* Custom Question to Nour */\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-200\">\n                <input\n                  type=\"text\"\n                  value={customQuestionInput}\n                  onChange={(e) => setCustomQuestionInput(e.target.value)}\n                  placeholder={isAr ? 'اسألي نور: يعني إيه...؟ أو ليه كانوا...؟' : 'Ask Nour anything about the lesson...'}\n                  className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n                  onKeyDown={(e) => {\n                    if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSendCustomQuery();\n                  }}\n                />\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  disabled={!customQuestionInput.trim() || isAnsweringQuestion}\n                  onClick={handleSendCustomQuery}\n                  className=\"px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n                >\n                  <Send className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n                  <span>{isAr ? 'اسألي' : 'Ask'}</span>\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        );\n\n      case 'child_tap_word':\n        return (\n          <TapWordCard\n            word={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.word || 'لَمْ أُوَتِّ'}\n            definition={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.definition || ''}\n            exampleSentence={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.exampleSentence}\n            sourceRefText={sequence.sourceRefText}\n            onTappedWord={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              setTimeout(() => handleNextBeat(true), 1200);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_match_pairs':\n        return (\n          <MatchPairsBoard\n            pairs={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.pairs || []}\n            onAllMatched={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_drag_drop':\n        return (\n          <DragDropMat\n            zones={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.zones || []}\n            items={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.items || []}\n            onComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_trace':\n        return (\n          <TraceCanvas\n            letterPrompt={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.letterPrompt || 'أ'}\n            instructionAr={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.instructionAr || 'تتبعي الحرف:'}\n            instructionEn={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.instructionEn || 'Trace letter:'}\n            onTraceComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_choose_answer':\n        return (\n          <ChoiceCard\n            questionText={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.questionText}\n            options={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.options || []}\n            onAnswerSelected={(isCorrect) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(isCorrect);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_build':\n        return (\n          <BuildCanvas\n            centerConcept={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.centerConcept || 'نهر النيل'}\n            nodes={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.nodes || []}\n            onBuildComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_speak_answer':\n        return (\n          <VoiceAnswerControl\n            promptText={(isAr ? currentBeat.nourTextAr : currentBeat.nourTextEn)\n              .replace(/أمينة/g, studentName)\n              .replace(/Amina/g, studentName)}\n            onAnswerSubmit={(text) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'explain_back':\n        return (\n          <ExplainBackStage\n            conceptTitle={\n              currentBeat.interactionPayload?.conceptTitle ||\n              (isAr ? 'قسم حماية النيل' : 'Nile Protection Oath')\n            }\n            onExplainSubmitted={(explanation) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_tap_object':\n      default:\n        return (\n          <div className=\"w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-center p-3 max-w-sm mx-auto space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => handleNextBeat(true)}\n              className=\"w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer\"\n            >\n              <span>{isAr ? 'فهمت الفكرة يا نور، لنكمل!' : 'Understood Nour, let’s continue!'}</span>\n              {isAr ? <ChevronLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        );\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-3 overflow-hidden select-none\"\n      dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}\n      onClick={() => {\n        // Unlock browser audio context on any modal click\n        if (!hasStartedAudio) {\n          setHasStartedAudio(true);\n          playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n        }\n      }}\n    >\n      <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-xl h-full sm:h-[94vh] sm:max-h-[860px] bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-none sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden\">\n        {/* TOP HEADER: TITLE, PROGRESS DOTS, VOICE CONTROLS & CHAT FALLBACK */}\n        <div className=\"px-3 py-2 bg-slate-900/90 text-white border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 z-30\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <div className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs\">\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-amber-300\" />\n            </div>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                <span>{isAr ? sequence.lessonTitleAr : sequence.lessonTitleEn}</span>\n                <span className=\"text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-300 font-bold\">\n                  {isAr ? `مع نور لـ ${studentName}` : `With Nour for ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium\">\n                {sequence.sourceRefText}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Center Beat Progress Dots */}\n          <div className=\"hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {sequence.beats.map((b, i) => (\n              <span\n                key={b.id}\n                className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${\n                  i === sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-5 bg-amber-400'\n                    : i < sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-2 bg-emerald-400'\n                    : 'w-1.5 bg-slate-700'\n                }`}\n              />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Action Tools */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {/* Talk to Nour (Fallback Chat Drawer Trigger) */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(!showChatFallback)}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n            >\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Mute Toggle */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={handleToggleMute}\n              className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${\n                isMuted ? 'text-rose-400 bg-rose-950/40' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'\n              }`}\n              title={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n              aria-label={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n            >\n              {isMuted ? <VolumeX className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Close */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={onClose}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n            >\n              <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Browser Audio Unlock Reminder Banner */}\n        {!hasStartedAudio && !isMuted && (\n          <div\n            onClick={(e) => {\n              e.stopPropagation();\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n            }}\n            className=\"w-full bg-linear-to-r from-amber-500 via-amber-400 to-yellow-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs py-1.5 px-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-md animate-pulse z-40\"\n          >\n            <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4 animate-bounce\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'اضغطي هنا لتشغيل صوت نور التفاعلي 🔊' : 'Tap here to enable Nour’s voice 🔊'}</span>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* 1. TOP 55%: SCENE CANVAS */}\n        <div className=\"h-[55%] w-full relative shrink-0\">\n          <StageSceneCanvas\n            nourState={sessionState.nourCurrentState}\n            outfit={sequence.outfit}\n            isNourSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            clipId={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.clipId}\n            interactiveObjects={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.interactiveObjects}\n            onObjectTap={(obj) => {\n              const text = isAr ? obj.descriptionAr : obj.descriptionEn;\n              setTutorSpokenText(text);\n              playTutorSpeech(text);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n            onNourTap={handleReplayVoice}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. MIDDLE 20%: NARRATION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[20%] w-full shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-center\">\n          <NarrationBar\n            spokenText={tutorSpokenText}\n            isSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            isMuted={isMuted}\n            sourceRefText={`ص. ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}`}\n            language={language}\n            onReplayAudio={handleReplayVoice}\n            onToggleMute={handleToggleMute}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. BOTTOM 25%: INTERACTION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[25%] w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto\">\n          {renderInteractionZone()}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* FALLBACK CHAT DRAWER (\"Talk to Nour\" - Sub-Phase 11.7) */}\n        {showChatFallback && (\n          <div className=\"absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[65%] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-t-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300\">\n            <div className=\"p-3 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-b border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between\">\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n                <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? `محادثة مفتوحة مع نور يا ${studentName}` : `Talk to Nour, ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(false)}\n                className=\"p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat History */}\n            <div className=\"flex-1 p-3 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 text-xs\">\n              <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقتكِ ومعلمتكِ نور. لو فيه أي سؤال في درس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» مش فاهماه أو سؤال يدور في ذهنكِ، احكيلي براحتك خالص!`\n                  : `Hi ${studentName}! I’m Nour. If anything in \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\" isn't clear or you have any curious thought, ask me freely!`}\n              </div>\n\n              {chatMessages.map((msg, i) => (\n                <div\n                  key={i}\n                  className={`flex ${msg.role === 'child' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}\n                >\n                  <div\n                    className={`max-w-[85%] p-2.5 rounded-2xl ${\n                      msg.role === 'child'\n                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                        : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    {msg.text}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat Input */}\n            <form onSubmit={handleSendFallbackChat} className=\"p-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex gap-2\">\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                value={chatInput}\n                onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}\n                placeholder={isAr ? 'اسألي نور أي سؤال...' : 'Ask Nour anything...'}\n                className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n              />\n              <button\n                type=\"submit\"\n                disabled={!chatInput.trim()}\n                className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                {isAr ? 'إرسال' : 'Send'}\n              </button>\n            </form>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "kind": "FileEditorObservation"
}

Before this module\n * each engine had its own copy of the mapping and they disagreed:\n *   - Social Studies: \"الدراسات الاجتماعية\" -> `subj_social` (0 lessons) while\n *     the curriculum stores it as `subj_social_studies` (3 lessons).\n *   - ICT: \"تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات\" contains the substring \"علوم\" so it\n *     was matched as Science before ICT was ever tested.\n *   - Calligraphy: \"الخط العربي\" contains \"عرب\" so it was matched as Arabic.\n *\n * `normalizeSubjectId` is now the single source of truth. Keep it dependency\n * free so both `src/data` and `src/services` can import it without cycles.\n */\n\n/**\n * Returns the canonical curriculum subject ID for a free-text subject label,\n * or an empty string when nothing authoritative matches.\n */\nexport function normalizeSubjectId(subName?: string): string {\n  if (!subName) return '';\n  const s = subName.trim().toLowerCase();\n\n  // Math is the Egyptian national curriculum taught in French.\n  // French wording must never create a second subject identity.\n  if (\n    (s.includes('math') && (s.includes('fr') || s.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    s.includes('mathématiques') ||\n    s.includes('الرياضيات بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'subj_math';\n  }\n\n  // Science is the Egyptian national curriculum taught in French.\n  if (\n    (s.includes('sci') && (s.includes('fr') || s.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    s.includes('sciences fr') ||\n    s.includes('العلوم بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'subj_science';\n  }\n\n  // Most specific subjects first. Calligraphy and ICT must be tested before the\n  // generic Arabic / Science substring checks that would otherwise swallow them.\n  if (s.includes('خط') || s.includes('calligraph') || s.includes('خط Got step '${understandRes.session.currentStep}'`);\n    }\n    console.log(`[Step 7 - Explain-it-back ENFORCED]: OK -> \"${understandRes.newTutorTurn.text.slice(0, 90)}...\"`);\n\n    // 8. ### MessageEvent — role: `assistant` — source: `agent` — id: `46b98821-bde1-4ed3-b77e-2bb93569ca26` — 2026-10-21T15:50:09.304934

```
Audit complete. Here's what I found and did.

## About the API key

I registered the key as `AMINA5`, but it is **not reaching the running app**. The server's own health check confirms it:

```
GET /api/health → {"status":"ok","hasApiKey":false}
```

I tried referencing `$AMINA5` and even starting the server with `GEMINI_API_KEY="$AMINA5"` — `hasApiKey` stayed `false`. Secrets in this environment are injected per-command from a **registered secret key name**, and the app only reads `process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY`. So the key needs to be registered under the name **`GEMINI_API_KEY`** (not `AMINA5`) for the app to pick it up automatically.

Importantly, **the app does not break without the key** — it degrades honestly. `/api/chat` returns `"degraded": true, "source": "local_companion_fallback"` and the tutor endpoints return local pedagogic fallbacks. Voice (STT/TTS) and photo homework-checking are the features that genuinely need the live key.

## What is preventing Amina from being sellable

I audited the live code against the Forge handoff doc (`docs/AMINA_PROJECT_MEMORY_AND_FORGE_ORDERS.md`). Status, by requirement:

| Req | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| FEED — real, swipeable, curriculum-connected | **PASS** | `FeedScreen.tsx` renders full-screen `snap-y` cards from real lessons/missions/review; verified live in browser |
| All subjects/books visible (no 4-cap) | **PASS** | Library shows all 9 subjects live; integrity test `> 4 subjects` passes |
| Demo timetable | **PARTIAL** | Still `createDefaultTimetable` (`isDemo: true`) but now **truthfully labelled** with a "Sample" badge; user can edit |
| No fake student identity | **PASS** | `aminaCurriculumConfig.ts` no longer auto-creates a student; `resolveStudentName` returns a neutral vocative; I removed remaining hardcoded `أمينة/Amina` from `server.ts`, `TutorExplanationCheck.tsx`, `VirtualTeacherClassroom.tsx`, `StageModal.tsx` |
| Reasoning actually analyzed | **PASS** | `analyzeStudentReasoning()` genuinely inspects text (guessing/unclear/parroting detection); wired from the classroom |
| One School Brain (consistent subject IDs) | **FIXED** | New shared `subjectIdentity.ts`; all engines now agree (`subj_social` → `subj_social_studies`); removed 5 divergent copies |
| Verified outcomes / explain-back gate | **PASS** | Proving-lesson E2E now passes; 1-word answers correctly rejected |
| Evidence-backed review | **PASS** | Review driven by mastery records, not hardcoded subject names |
| CI honesty | **FIXED** | Removed `continue-on-error` — 0 TS errors; wired `verifyPhase9` into `npm test` |
| Adaptive Nour loop (diagnose→teach→practice→analyze→recheck→verify) | **PASS** | 7/7 proving lessons pass full end-to-end verification |

**Verification run:** `tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors · 39 + 66 tests pass · 7/7 proving lessons pass · production build succeeds.

## The real blockers to "sellable"

1. **API key not wired** — register it as `GEMINI_API_KEY`; until then voice and photo-homework are degraded (but the app stays truthful).
2. **Timetable is still sample data** — no real per-student schedule import; it's labelled, not faked, but a real timetable needs a data source.
3. **Curriculum is a Term-1 registry, not the full textbook** — the code itself admits this in `officialCurriculum.ts`; full book digitisation is an owner decision/input.
4. **No runtime/browser test harness** — tests are static/Node; I verified FEED and Library live, but timetabled flows (tutor→Library→Nour handoff) would benefit from browser automation before release.

Two test scripts were also stale (expecting 5 proving lessons when there are 7, and asserting the OLD reject path). I corrected them to match the actually-correct engine behaviour and folded `verifyPhase9` into `npm test` so it can't silently rot again.

Note: I have **not committed or pushed** any of this — 23 modified files plus 2 new files are staged in the working tree on `main`. Say the word and I'll move it to a review branch and open a PR (the doc explicitly requires a dedicated branch and no merge without your approval).
```

'واجب (التفاصيل غير محددة)' : 'Homework (details not specified)' });\n        }\n      }\n      if (lower.includes('إنجليز') || lower.includes('انجليز') || lower.includes('english')) {\n        lessons.push({ subject: 'اللغة الإنجليزية' });\n      }\n\n      return res.json({\n        lessonsCovered: lessons,                      // may be empty; never invent a default lesson\n        homeworkAssigned: homework,\n        notes: trimmedInput,\n        isSilence: false,\n        isVague: lessons.length === 0,\n        detectedConfidence: lessons.length > 0 ? 'partial' : 'vague',\n        degraded: true,\n        source: 'local_parser_fallback',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" Day Record extractor for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nThe student has just come home from school and described their day in free-text: \"${trimmedInput}\".\nToday's timetable scheduled subjects are: ${JSON.stringify(todayTimetableSubjects)}.\n\nYOUR TASK:\nExtract the concrete lessons covered and homework assigned into structured JSON.\nCRITICAL RULES:\n1. Do not hallucinate or invent subjects that the student did not attend or mention.\n2. If the student explicitly names a subject not in the timetable, capture it accurately.\n3. Extract homework with clear subject, description, and due date if stated.\n4. If input is vague or brief, mark detectedConfidence as \"partial\" or \"vague\".\n5. Return JSON ONLY matching this exact structure:\n{\n  \"lessonsCovered\": [\n    { \"subject\": \"string\", \"topic\": \"string (optional)\", \"notes\": \"string (optional)\" }\n  ],\n  \"homeworkAssigned\": [\n    { \"subject\": \"string\", \"description\": \"string\", \"dueDate\": \"string (optional)\" }\n  ],\n  \"notes\": \"string (optional)\",\n  \"detectedConfidence\": \"high\" | \"partial\" | \"vague\",\n  \"isSilence\": boolean,\n  \"isVague\": boolean\n}\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: trimmedInput }] }],\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        responseMimeType: 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    const text = response.text || '{}';\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: parsed.lessonsCovered || [],\n      homeworkAssigned: parsed.homeworkAssigned || [],\n      notes: parsed.notes || trimmedInput,\n      detectedConfidence: parsed.detectedConfidence || 'partial',\n      isSilence: Boolean(parsed.isSilence),\n      isVague: Boolean(parsed.isVague),\n      source: 'gemini',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Reconstruct Day API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: [],\n      homeworkAssigned: [],\n      notes: req.body?.studentInput || '',\n      detectedConfidence: 'vague',\n      isSilence: false,\n      isVague: true,\n      degraded: true,\n      source: 'error_fallback',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Dev vs Prod server setup\nif (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {\n  const { createServer: createViteServer } = await import('vite');\n  const vite = await createViteServer({\n    server: { middlewareMode: true },\n    appType: 'spa',\n  });\n  app.use(vite.middlewares);\n} else {\n  app.use(express.static(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist')));\n  app.get('*', (_req, res) => {\n    res.sendFile(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\napp.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {\n  console.log(`AI School Companion Server running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);\n});\n",
 "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// Initialize GoogleGenAI.\n// Accept the key under any of the names a deployment may register it as, so a\n// correctly-registered secret is never silently ignored.\nconst API_KEY_SOURCES = ['GEMINI_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY', 'API_KEY'] as const;\nconst apiKeySource = API_KEY_SOURCES.find((name) => Boolean(process.env[name])) ?? null;\nconst apiKey = apiKeySource ? process.env[apiKeySource] : undefined;\nconst ai = apiKey\n  ? new GoogleGenAI({\n      apiKey,\n      httpOptions: {\n        headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',\n        },\n      },\n    })\n  : null;\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction isQuotaExhaustedError(err: any): boolean {\n  if (!err) return false;\n  const status = err.status || err.code;\n  const msg = String(err.message || err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 1]?.content || '').trim();\n    const lowerUserMsg = lastUserMsg.toLowerCase();\n\n    // Specific intent detection for Phase 3\n    const isDontUnderstand =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهم') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهمة') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't understand\") ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('dont understand') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const isTestMe =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبرني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اسألني سؤال') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبار') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('test me') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('quiz me');\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Graceful offline/local companion fallback if API key is not yet set or during quota cooldown\n      let fallbackReply = '';\n      if (isDontUnderstand) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName}! عادي جداً متفهمش من أول مرة، دي خطوة طبيعية في التعلم. قولي إيه أكثر نقطة حسيتها ملخبطة وهنبسطها سوا خطوة بخطوة.`\n          : `No worries at all, ${studentName}! It's completely normal not to understand right away. Tell me which part felt tricky, and we'll break it down step by step together.`;\n      } else if (isExplainDifferently) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! تعال نجرب مثال من حياتنا اليومية أو نشبه الموضوع بحاجة بنشوفها كل يوم. قولي تحب نبدأ من أول فكرة ولا من النص؟`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! Let's look at this with a simple real-world analogy. Ready for a quick, friendly question on what we discussed? Take your time!`;\n      } else {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقك الذكي للتعلم. أنا هنا علشان أسمعك وأساعدك تنظم يومك وتفهم اللي محتاجه بهدوء ودون أي ضغط.`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am here to help organize your day and walk through any questions without stress.`;\n      }\n\n      return res.json({\n        reply: fallbackReply,\n        source: 'local_companion_fallback',\n        degraded: true,\n        detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const contextJson = schoolBrainContext ? JSON.stringify({\n      school: schoolBrainContext.school || null,\n      location: schoolBrainContext.location || null,\n      curriculumTrack: schoolBrainContext.curriculumTrack || null,\n      dayRecord: schoolBrainContext.dayRecord || null,\n      activeMission: schoolBrainContext.activeMission || null,\n    }) : 'No verified School Brain context was supplied.';\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" (الرفيق الدراسي الذكي), a personal AI learning assistant for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nCRITICAL PRINCIPLES:\n1. You are an AI companion, NOT a human teacher or parent. Never pretend to be human.\n2. Tone: Warm, patient, encouraging, age-appropriate for an ~11-year-old child.\n3. Absolutely NO moralizing, scolding, or guilt-tripping (e.g. never say \"you should have studied earlier\" or \"why didn't you finish?\").\n4. Praise must be specific and grounded, never generic or effusive.\n5. Language: Primarily Egyptian/Friendly Arabic when the student writes in Arabic (${isArabic ? 'Active' : 'Optional'}), clear simple English if English is selected.\n6. SCHOOL BRAIN IS AUTHORITATIVE:\n   - Treat the verified context below as the source of truth for the student's current school day, curriculum track, and active mission.\n   - Do not invent lessons, homework, concepts, assignments, scores, mastery, or school events that are not present in the verified context.\n   - If the context does not contain enough information to answer a school-specific question, say exactly what information is missing and ask for it or direct the student to record today's school information.\n   - Never silently substitute another lesson or another subject.\n   - When discussing learning, stay grounded in the active mission/day record when one exists.\n7. VERIFIED SCHOOL BRAIN CONTEXT:\n${contextJson}\n8. SPECIAL INTENT HANDLING:\n   - If the student says \"I don't understand\" / \"مش فاهم\": Reassure them warmly that learning takes time, normalize confusion, and invite them gently to say which part was confusing.\n   - If the student says \"explain differently\" / \"اشرح بطريقة تانية\": Offer a simple everyday analogy or relatable example suited for an 11-year-old.\n   - If the student says \"test me\" / \"اختبرني\": Provide a single, friendly, low-stakes practice question to build confidence, and encourage them to take their time.\n   - Note: Do NOT trigger a rigid tutor escalation ladder yet; keep replies conversational, supportive, and grounded.\n`.trim();\n\n    // Prepare contents array for Gemini\n    let started = false;\n    const contents = (Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [])\n      .filter((m: any) => m && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())\n      .slice(-12)\n      .map((m: { role: string; content: string }) => ({\n        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',\n        parts: [{ text: m.content.slice(0, 2000) }],\n      }))\n      .filter((c: { role: string }) => {\n        if (!started && c.role === 'model') return false; // history must start with a user turn\n        started = true;\n        return true;\n      });\n    if (contents.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No messages', degraded: true });\n    }\n\n    // Generate response using SDK default model\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents,\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const reply = response.text || (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n    res.json({\n      reply,\n      source: 'gemini',\n      detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('chat', error);\n    const isArabic = req.body?.language !== 'en';\n    const errorFallback = isArabic\n      ? 'مش قادرة أوصل للمساعد دلوقتي. جرّبي كمان شوية.'\n      : \"I can't reach the assistant right now. Try again in a moment.\";\n    res.json({ reply: errorFallback, source: 'error_fallback', degraded: true });\n  }\n});\n\n// STT (Speech-to-Text) API endpoint (Tier 2 fallback)\napp.post('/api/stt', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { audioBase64, mimeType = 'audio/webm', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n\n    if (!audioBase64) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing audio data', transcript: '' });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        transcript: '',\n        error: 'Gemini STT requires API key',\n        tier: 'fallback_unavailable',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const promptText = isArabic\n      ? 'استمع إلى التسجيل الصوتي المرفق وقم بتفريغه نصياً بدقة كما نطق الطالب باللغة العربية (اللهجة المصرية أو الفصحى). أرجع فقط النص الدقيق بدون أي مقدمات أو تحيات أو إضافات.'\n      : 'Listen to the audio recording and transcribe it accurately as spoken. Return only the exact transcription without any commentary.';\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [\n            {\n              inlineData: {\n                data: audioBase64,\n                mimeType,\n              },\n            },\n            {\n              text: promptText,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        temperature: 0.1,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const transcript = (response.text || '').trim();\n    res.json({\n      transcript,\n      tier: 'gemini_stt',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('STT API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      transcript: '',\n      error: error.message || 'STT failed',\n      tier: 'gemini_stt_error',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// TTS in-memory cache\nconst ttsCache = new Map<string, string>();\n\n// TTS (Text-to-Speech) API endpoint powered by Gemini Flash Lite TTS\napp.post('/api/tts', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { text = '', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n    if (!text || !text.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing text' });\n    }\n\n    const cleanText = text\n      .replace(/[*#_~`]/g, '')\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n      .trim()\n      .slice(0, 450); // Safe length for natural speech delivery\n\n    const langKey = language === 'fr' ? 'fr' : language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar';\n    const cacheKey = `${langKey}:${cleanText}`;\n\n    // 1. Serve from in-memory cache if previously generated\n    if (ttsCache.has(cacheKey)) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: true,\n        audioBase64: ttsCache.get(cacheKey),\n        mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        fromCache: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: false,\n        useBrowserSpeech: true,\n        text: cleanText,\n        language: langKey,\n      });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const voiceName = langKey === 'ar' ? 'Puck' : langKey === 'fr' ? 'Kore' : 'Kore';\n      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n        model: 'gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts',\n        contents: [\n          {\n            role: 'user',\n            parts: [{ text: cleanText }],\n          },\n        ],\n        config: {\n          responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],\n          speechConfig: {\n            voiceConfig: {\n              prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      const base64Audio = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData?.data;\n      if (base64Audio) {\n        ttsCache.set(cacheKey, base64Audio);\n        return res.json({\n          success: true,\n          audioBase64: base64Audio,\n          mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (genErr: any) {\n      console.warn('Gemini TTS generation issue:', genErr?.message || genErr);\n    }\n\n    // Graceful browser speech fallback if server TTS encountered an issue\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: cleanText,\n      language: langKey,\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: req.body?.text || '',\n      language: req.body?.language || 'ar',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Dynamic Lesson Explanation Generation (Miss Nour Deep Explanation)\napp.post('/api/tutor-explain', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      lessonText = '',\n      studentName = 'صديقتي',\n      language = 'ar',\n      mode = 'full_hook_story',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Local pedagogic explanations fallback\n      const fallbackExplanations: Record<string, string> = {\n        full_hook_story: isArabic\n          ? `يا أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تعالي أحكي لك سر مشوق عن درس «${lessonTitle}» في ${subjectName}. تخيلي لو إنتي عالمة أو مستكشفة صغيرة بتواجه لغز كبير؛ الدرس ده بيعلمنا إزاي نفكر بذكاء ونحل أصعب التحديات خطوة بخطوة. يلا نفتح عيوننا وتركيزنا ونبدأ المغامرة سوا!`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Bonjour ${studentName}! Laisse-moi te raconter une histoire passionnante sur la leçon «${lessonTitle}» en ${subjectName}. Imagine que tu sois une jeune chercheuse explorant une énigme fascinante. Cette leçon va nous donner les clés pour comprendre le monde qui nous entoure!`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! Let me tell you an exciting story about our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" in ${subjectName}. Imagine you are a young explorer facing a great discovery. This lesson will show us how to think critically and solve big puzzles step by step!`,\n        core_concepts: isArabic\n          ? `ركزي معايا يا ${studentName} في أهم ثلاث نقاط في درس «${lessonTitle}»: أولاً: الفكرة المركزية اللي بيبني عليها كتاب الوزارة. ثانياً: المصطلحات الجديدة اللي بنقابلها. ثالثاً: القاعدة الأساسية اللي بتخلينا نحل أي تمرين بكل سهولة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Retiens bien ces points clés pour «${lessonTitle}», ${studentName}: D'abord, l'idée principale du manuel. Ensuite, les termes nouveaux indispensables. Enfin, la règle pratique pour résoudre tous les exercices.`\n          : `Focus with me on the key ideas for \"${lessonTitle}\", ${studentName}: First, the main concept from the textbook. Second, our core vocabulary. Just like sharing a delicious treat or organizing your room, we apply this exact concept naturally. Science is all around us!`,\n        discussion_question: isArabic\n          ? `يا ترى يا ${studentName}، لو سألتك: إيه أكتر فكرة لفتت نظرك في درس «${lessonTitle}»؟ وإزاي نقدر نستخدم الفكرة دي عشان نساعد بلدنا أو بيتنا النهاردة؟`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `À ton avis ${studentName}, quelle est la partie la plus intéressante de «${lessonTitle}»? \"homeworkAssigned\": [\n    { \"subject\": \"string\", \"description\": \"string\", \"dueDate\": \"string (optional)\" }\n  ],\n  \"notes\": \"string (optional)\",\n  \"detectedConfidence\": \"high\" | \"partial\" | \"vague\",\n  \"isSilence\": boolean,\n  \"isVague\": boolean\n}\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || });\n\n    const text = response.text || '{}';\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: parsed.lessonsCovered || [],\n      homeworkAssigned: isVague: Boolean(parsed.isVague),\n      source: 'gemini',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Reconstruct Day API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: [],\n      homeworkAssigned: [],\n      notes: req.body?.studentInput || '',\n      detectedConfidence: 'vague',\n      isSilence: false,\n      isVague: true,\n      degraded: true,\n      source:  "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// Initialize GoogleGenAI.\n// Accept the key under any of the names a deployment may register it as, so a\n// correctly-registered secret is never silently ignored.\nconst API_KEY_SOURCES = ['GEMINI_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY', 'API_KEY'] as const;\nconst apiKeySource = API_KEY_SOURCES.find((name) => headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',\n        },\n      },\n    })\n  : null;\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    apiKeySource,\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 1]?.content || '').trim();\n    const lowerUserMsg = lastUserMsg.toLowerCase();\n\n    // understand\") ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('dont understand') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const isTestMe =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبرني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اسألني سؤال') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبار') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('test me') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('quiz me');\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Graceful offline/local companion fallback if API key is not yet set or during quota cooldown\n      let fallbackReply = '';\n      if (isDontUnderstand) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName}! عادي جداً متفهمش من أول مرة، دي خطوة طبيعية في التعلم. قولي إيه أكثر نقطة حسيتها ملخبطة وهنبسطها سوا خطوة بخطوة.`\n          : `No worries at all, ${studentName}! It's completely normal not to understand right away. Tell me which part felt tricky, and we'll break it down step by step together.`;\n      } else if (isExplainDifferently) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! تعال نجرب مثال من حياتنا اليومية أو نشبه الموضوع بحاجة بنشوفها كل يوم. قولي تحب نبدأ من أول فكرة ولا من النص؟`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! Let's look at this with a simple real-world analogy.
