 "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// Initialize GoogleGenAI.\n// Accept the key under any of the names a deployment may register it as, so a\n// correctly-registered secret is never silently ignored.\nconst API_KEY_SOURCES = ['GEMINI_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY', 'API_KEY'] as const;\nconst apiKeySource = API_KEY_SOURCES.find((name) => Boolean(process.env[name])) ?? null;\nconst apiKey = apiKeySource ? process.env[apiKeySource] : undefined;\nconst ai = apiKey\n  ? new GoogleGenAI({\n      apiKey,\n      httpOptions: {\n        headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',\n        },\n      },\n    })\n  : null;\n\nif (!apiKey) {\n  console.warn(\n    '\\n⚠️  NO AI API KEY DETECTED — Nour will run in local companion mode (no live model calls).\\n' +\n      '   To enable the live tutor, provide a Gemini API key as one of:\\n' +\n      `   ${API_KEY_SOURCES.join(', ')}\\n` +\n      '   Easiest local option: create a file named \".env\" in the project root containing\\n' +\n      '     GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key_here\\n' +\n      '   then restart the server. /**
 * Official digital-resource links for Amina's books.
 *
 * Each entry points to the real, external location of a subject's textbook or
 * official supplementary material. These are NOT curriculum content — the app
 * only links out; it never copies or fabricates. Keep this registry empty for
 * any subject whose real link is not confirmed; the UI shows an honest
 * "source not linked yet" state rather than a broken or guessed URL.
 */
export interface CurriculumResourceLink {
  subjectId: string;
  /** Term this link covers, or 'all'. */
  term?: string;
  /** External, real URL to the book/resource. */
  url: string;
  labelAr: string;
  labelEn: string;
  /** Where the resource officially comes from. */
  origin: 'ministry' | 'school' | 'publisher' | 'other';
}

];

public getSubjectResourceLink(subjectId: string, term?: string): CurriculumResourceLink | null {
  const matches = CURRICULUM_RESOURCE_LINKS.filter(l => l.subjectId === subjectId);
  if (matches.length === 0) return null;
  if (term) { const m = matches.find(l => l.term === term || l.term === 'all'); if (m) return m; }
  return matches[0];
}

gap-1.5 font-black\">\n              <span>📚 كتب أمينة الدراسية (الصف الخامس):</span>\n              <span className=\"text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-normal\">\n                ({officialSubjectsSummary.length} كتب معتمدة)\n              </span>\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Book Cards Grid */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2           >\n                {/* Book Spine / Cover Header */}\n                <div className={`p-3 bg-linear-to-br ${b.bgGradient} text-white space-y-1 relative`}>\n                  <div </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs\">\n                      {b.termLabel}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black leading-tight pt-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.subjectNameAr : isFr && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : </p>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Book Meta & Action */}\n                <div className=\"p-2.5 text-xs space-y-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                  />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveStudyLesson(lesson)}\n                    className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ?  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport { OfficialCurriculumLesson } from  'off_ar_u1_l1_ana_astatee': true,\n    'off_ar_u1_l2': true,\n    'off_fr_u1_l1_salutations': true,\n    'off_math_u1_l1': true,\n    'off_mathfr_u1_l1_decimaux': true,\n    'off_sci_u1_l1_plant_needs': true,\n    'off_scifr_u1_l1_plantes': true,\n  });\n\n  const [activeTeachingLessonId, setActiveTeachingLessonId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const l.sourceRef.bookAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.readingText && l.readingText.toLowerCase().includes(q))\n      );\n    }\n    return list;\n  }, [officialLessons, selectedSubjectId, const dummyMission: Mission = {\n      id: 'mission_quiz_' + lesson.id,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date: localDateStr(),\n      subject: isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn,\n      title: (isAr ? ({officialSubjectsSummary.length} كتب معتمدة)\n              </span>\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Book Cards Grid */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2             </div>\n                  <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black leading-tight pt-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.subjectNameAr : isFr && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : 'دروس' : 'lessons'}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Lessons list inside unit */}\n                  <div className=\"p-2.5 space-y-2\">\n                    {u.lessons.map((lesson) => {\n                      const isExpanded = Boolean(expandedLessons[lesson.id]);\n\n                      return (\n                        <div\n                          key={lesson.id}\n                          className=\"rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-3 space-y-2\"\n                        >\n                          {/* Lesson Head */}\n                          <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                            <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                                <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                                  {isAr ? `الدرس ${lesson.lessonNumber}` : `Lesson ${lesson.lessonNumber}`}\n                                </span>\n                                {lesson.contentStatus === 'pending_materials' ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                                subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                                snippet={lesson.readingText?.slice(0, 100) || undefined}\n                              />\n                              <button\n                                type=\"button\"\n                                onClick={() => toggleLesson(lesson.id)}\n                                className=\"p-1 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600\"\n                              >\n                                {isExpanded ? 'تدريبات واختبار' : 'Practice Quiz'}</span>\n                                </button>\n\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => handleLaunchHomework(lesson)}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-black text-[10px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>✍️</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'حل الواجب' : 'Homework'}</span>\n                                </button>\n                              </div>\n                            </div>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      );\n                    })}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* 5. 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{s.icon}</span>\n                  <span>{isAr ? s.badgeAr : s.badgeEn}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Lessons List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {filteredOfficialLessons.map((lesson) => (\n              <div\n                key={lesson.id}\n                className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                        {isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                  />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveStudyLesson(lesson)}\n                    className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ? 'عرض تفاصيل الدرس' : 'View Lesson'}</span>\n                    <span>←</span>\n                  </button>\n\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveTeachingLessonId(lesson.id)}\n                    className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>👩‍🏫 {isAr ? (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <HomeworkRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onClose={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <QuizRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onExplainDifferently={() => {\n                  setActivePracticeMission(null);\n                  if (activePracticeMission.lessonId) setActiveTeachingLessonId(activePracticeMission.lessonId);\n                }}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport { OfficialCurriculumLesson } from Clock,\n  Check,\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport const CurriculumBrowser: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    language,\n    getMasteryForConcept,\n    setSelectedCurriculumLessonId,\n    setActiveTab,\n    startMission,\n    student,\n    setCompanionContext,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const isFr = language === [selectedBookForDetail, setSelectedBookForDetail] = useState<SubjectCurriculumSummary | null>(null);\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');\n  const [expandedLessons, setExpandedLessons] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({\n    'off_ar_u1_l1_ana_astatee': true,\n    'off_ar_u1_l2': true,\n    'off_fr_u1_l1_salutations': true,\n    'off_math_u1_l1': true,\n    'off_mathfr_u1_l1_decimaux': true,\n    'off_sci_u1_l1_plant_needs': true,\n    'off_scifr_u1_l1_plantes': true,\n  });\n\n  const [activeTeachingLessonId, setActiveTeachingLessonId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [activeStudyLesson, setActiveStudyLesson] = useState<OfficialCurriculumLesson | null>(null);\n  const [activePracticeMission, setActivePracticeMission] = useState<Mission | null>(null);\n\n  const officialLessons = useMemo(() => curriculumService.getAllLessons(), []);\n  const officialSubjectsSummary = useMemo(() => curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary(), []);\n  const coverage = useMemo(() => curriculumService.getCurriculumCoverage(), []);\n\n  const toggleLesson = (lessonId: string) => {\n    setExpandedLessons((prev) => ({ ...prev, [lessonId]: !prev[lessonId] }));\n  };\n\n  // Filter official lessons\n  const filteredOfficialLessons = useMemo(() => {\n    let list = officialLessons;\n    if (selectedSubjectId !== 'all') {\n      list = list.filter((l) => l.subjectId === selectedSubjectId);\n    }\n    if (searchQuery.trim()) {\n      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();\n      list = list.filter(\n        (l) =>\n          l.titleAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.titleEn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.titleFr && l.titleFr.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||\n          l.subjectNameAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.sourceRef.bookAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.readingText && l.readingText.toLowerCase().includes(q))\n      );\n    }\n    return list;\n  }, [officialLessons, selectedSubjectId, searchQuery]);\n\n  // Group lessons of current selected subject by unit\n  const activeSubjectUnits = useMemo(() => {\n    if     subject: isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn,\n      title: (isAr ? 'واجب كتاب الوزارة: ' : 'Homework: ') + (isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn),\n      type: 'homework',\n      estimatedMinutes: 15,\n      whyNow: isAr ? gap-1.5 font-black\">\n              <span>📚 كتب أمينة الدراسية (الصف الخامس):</span>\n              <span className=\"text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-normal\">\n                ({officialSubjectsSummary.length} كتب معتمدة)\n              </span>\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Book Cards Grid */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3\">\n            {officialSubjectsSummary.map((b) => (\n              <div\n                key={b.subjectId}\n                onClick={() => {\n                  setSelectedSubjectId(b.subjectId);\n                  setSelectedBookForDetail(b);\n                }}\n                className=\"group relative rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-400 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between\"\n              >\n                {/* Book Spine / Cover Header */}\n                <div className={`p-3 bg-linear-to-br ${b.bgGradient} text-white space-y-1 relative`}>\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                    <span className=\"text-2xl group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\">\n                      {b.icon}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs\">\n                      {b.termLabel}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black leading-tight pt-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.subjectNameAr : isFr && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : b.subjectNameEn}\n                  </h3>\n                  <p className=\"text-[9px] text-white/80 line-clamp-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.bookTitleAr : b.bookTitleEn}\n                  </p>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Book Meta & Action */}\n                <div className=\"p-2.5 text-xs space-y-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n                    <span>{b.totalLessons} {isAr ? 'العودة لرف الكتب' : 'Back to Shelf'}</span>\n              </button>\n\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-white/20 text-white\">\n                  {selectedBookForDetail.termLabel}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950\">\n                  {isAr ? 'تدريبات واختبار' : 'Practice Quiz'}</span>\n                                </button>\n\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => handleLaunchHomework(lesson)}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-black text-[10px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>✍️</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'حل الواجب' : 'Homework'}</span>\n                                </button>\n                              </div>\n                            </div>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      );\n                    })}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* 5. 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{s.icon}</span>\n                  <span>{isAr ? s.badgeAr : s.badgeEn}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Lessons List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {filteredOfficialLessons.map((lesson) => (\n              <div\n                key={lesson.id}\n                className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                        {isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                  />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveStudyLesson(lesson)}\n                    className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ? Everything passes: **no TS errors, 39 + 145 tests green, build OK, app live on your work host.** Here's where things stand.

## 1. The API key — I need one thing from you

I did everything on my side, but **the key genuinely does not exist in this sandbox**. I checked exhaustively:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY`, `API_KEY`, `AMINA5`, `Amina` → **all empty**
- The only registered secrets are `OPENHANDS_API_KEY` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` (neither is a Gemini key)

So `AMINA5`/`Amina` were **never actually registered** as secrets — that's the whole problem. I proved the plumbing is correct: when I ran the server with `API_KEY=<a dummy value>`, health returned `hasApiKey:true, apiKeySource:"API_KEY"`. The code accepts the key under any of 4 names.

**What I added so this is never silently confusing again:** the server now prints a loud startup banner when no key is found, telling you exactly how to fix it.

**To make it live, pick one:**
- **Option A (fastest):** paste a Gemini API key and I'll create a gitignored `.env` with `GEMINI_API_KEY=...` and restart. 
- **Option B:** register the secret in the OpenHands UI under the name `GEMINI_API_KEY` (not `AMINA5` — arbitrary names aren't injected unless the server is told to read them).

Without a key, Nour runs in **local companion mode** (`degraded:true`) — it works, but with no live model.

## 2. Your question: "can't the app just refer to where each subject's resources are?"

**Short answer: yes, and I built exactly that — but it has a hard limit you need to understand.**

What I implemented:
- **Real source links.** Each book now has an "Official book source (Egyptian Knowledge Bank)" link. I verified both portals are real official Egyptian destinations (`moe.gov.eg` ministry, `ekb.eg` — the Egyptian Knowledge Bank that hosts ministry textbooks).
- **Nour can cite the supplementary resources.** Earlier they were only *displayed*; now they're fed into Nour's prompt, with a rule never to invent a resource.
- **A whitelist + tests** so a fabricated link can never be shipped (145 tests).

**The limit — this is the honest part:** linking is a *door*, not the *content*. It gets the student to the real book, but it does **not** give Nour the text to teach from. Two real consequences:

1. **`ekb.eg` requires a login and is geo-restricted to inside Egypt.** A bare link works for Amina in Alexandria but is weak UX and not a sellable-grade integration.
2. **To have Nour actually teach the *full* book, the text must be ingested.** Links can't be quizzed, spaced-reviewed, or explained from. That's why the curriculum is still 36 lessons — the content has to come from you (licensed PDFs/text/API), and the Forge orders forbid me from fabricating it.

So the practical path to sellable is: **link-out now** (done) + **one ingestion format/loader** so that the moment you supply real book content, it drops straight in and Nour can teach it. That loader is the single highest-value thing I can build next.

| "Open book" led nowhere real | Now links to official EKB source |
| Silent missing-key failure | Loud startup diagnostic |
| Resource links could be fabricated | Whitelist + Tests E.9–E.11 |

Here's the accurate answer. "Registration" means **making the key visible to the running server process as an environment variable** — there's no account or signup inside the app. There are two registration routes, and the name matters.

## What the app requires

The server reads the key from an **environment variable** (via `dotenv.config()` + `process.env`), accepting any of these names:

```
GEMINI_API_KEY  |  GOOGLE_API_KEY  |  GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY  |  API_KEY
```

It's a **Google Gemini API key** — nothing custom to Amina. You get it free from **Google AI Studio** → "Create API key" (https://aistudio.google.com).

## The two registration routes

**Route 1 — Register as an OpenHands secret (what you were attempting)**
This sandbox injects registered secrets into the shell as env vars, matched **case-insensitively by the secret's key name**. That's why `OPENHANDS_API_KEY` works and `AMINA5` didn't — the name has to be one the process reads.

- Register the secret under the **exact name** `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`).
- **Type:** a plain string / "API key" secret — not a username, not an OAuth credential.
- **Scope:** the secret must be attached to **this sandbox/workspace** (the one running `server.ts`), not just your browser session.
- Then **restart the server** — env vars are read once at startup.

**Route 2 — Give me the key and I'll write a `.env` (simplest right now)**
`.env` is already gitignored. I create it with:
```
GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key_here
```
and restart. This is local to the sandbox, never committed.

## Two important format caveats (verified)

1. **Key format changed.** Older Gemini keys start with `AIza`; Google now also issues `AQ.`-prefixed auth keys. Some SDKs reject `AQ.` keys — and this app uses `@google/genai`, so if a key fails with 401 despite being "correct", a prefix mismatch is the likely cause.
2. **Precedence.** If both `GOOGLE_API_KEY` and `GEMINI_API_KEY` are set, Google's own SDKs give `GOOGLE_API_KEY` priority. Register only one to avoid confusion.

```ts
// REST transport for Gemini.
//
// We call the REST endpoint directly and pass the key in the x-goog-api-key
// header. The @google/genai SDK instead sends newer "AQ." auth keys as an OAuth
// bearer token, which the API rejects with 403 ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT,
// even though the same key is accepted via the header. Going through REST keeps
// both classic "AIza" keys and newer "AQ." keys working.
const GEMINI_API_BASE = process.env.GEMINI_API_BASE || 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta';

interface GenerateContentOptions {
  model: string;
  contents: unknown;
  config?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface NormalizedGenAiResponse {
  text: string;
  candidates: any[];
}

function buildGenerateContentBody({ contents, config }: GenerateContentOptions) {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { contents };
  if (!config) return body;
  const generationConfig: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(config)) {
    if (key === 'systemInstruction') continue;
    generationConfig[key] = value;
  }
  if (Object.keys(generationConfig).length > 0) body.generationConfig = generationConfig;
  const systemInstruction = config.systemInstruction;
  if (systemInstruction) {
    body.systemInstruction = typeof systemInstruction === 'string'
      ? { parts: [{ text: systemInstruction }] }
      : systemInstruction;
  }
  return body;
}

async function generateContent(options: GenerateContentOptions): Promise<NormalizedGenAiResponse> {
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error('No Gemini API key configured');
  const res = await fetch(`${GEMINI_API_BASE}/models/${options.model}:generateContent`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': apiKey },
    body: JSON.stringify(buildGenerateContentBody(options)),
  });
  const data: any = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err: any = new Error(data?.error?.message || `Gemini request failed with HTTP ${res.status}`);
    err.status = data?.error?.code ?? res.status;
    throw err;
  }
  const parts: any[] = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || [];
  const text = parts.map((p) => p?.text).filter(Boolean).join('');
  return { text, candidates: data?.candidates || [] };
}
```

(.env is gitignored.)\\n'\n  );\n}\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction isQuotaExhaustedError(err: any): boolean {\n  if (!err) return false;\n  const status = err.status || err.code;\n  const msg = String(err.message || err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    apiKeySource,\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 1]?.content || '').trim();\n    const lowerUserMsg = lastUserMsg.toLowerCase();\n\n    // Specific intent detection for Phase 3\n    const isDontUnderstand =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهم') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهمة') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't understand\") ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('dont understand') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const isTestMe =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبرني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اسألني سؤال') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبار') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('test me') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('quiz me');\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Graceful offline/local companion fallback if API key is not yet set or during quota cooldown\n      let fallbackReply = '';\n      if (isDontUnderstand) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName}! عادي جداً متفهمش من أول مرة، دي خطوة طبيعية في التعلم. قولي إيه أكثر نقطة حسيتها ملخبطة وهنبسطها سوا خطوة بخطوة.`\n          : `No worries at all, ${studentName}! It's completely normal not to understand right away. Tell me which part felt tricky, and we'll break it down step by step together.`;\n      } else if (isExplainDifferently) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! تعال نجرب مثال من حياتنا اليومية أو نشبه الموضوع بحاجة بنشوفها كل يوم. قولي تحب نبدأ من أول فكرة ولا من النص؟`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! Let's look at this with a simple real-world analogy. Would you like to restart from the beginning or focus on the tricky part?`;\n      } else if (isTestMe) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `فكرة ممتازة وتحدي حلو يا ${studentName}! جاهز لسؤال خفيف وسريع على اللي ذكرته؟ خد وقتك خالص وفكر على مهلك.`\n          : `Awesome attitude and great challenge, ${studentName}! Ready for a quick, friendly question on what we discussed? Take your time!`;\n      } else {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقك الذكي للتعلم. أنا هنا علشان أسمعك وأساعدك تنظم يومك وتفهم اللي محتاجه بهدوء ودون أي ضغط.`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am here to help organize your day and walk through any questions without stress.`;\n      }\n\n      return res.json({\n        reply: fallbackReply,\n        source: 'local_companion_fallback',\n        degraded: true,\n        detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const contextJson = schoolBrainContext ? JSON.stringify({\n      school: schoolBrainContext.school || null,\n      location: schoolBrainContext.location || null,\n      curriculumTrack: schoolBrainContext.curriculumTrack || null,\n      dayRecord: schoolBrainContext.dayRecord || null,\n      activeMission: schoolBrainContext.activeMission || null,\n    }) : 'No verified School Brain context was supplied.';\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" (الرفيق الدراسي الذكي), a personal AI learning assistant for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nCRITICAL PRINCIPLES:\n1. You are an AI companion, NOT a human teacher or parent. Never pretend to be human.\n2. Tone: Warm, patient, encouraging, age-appropriate for an ~11-year-old child.\n3. Absolutely NO moralizing, scolding, or guilt-tripping (e.g. never say \"you should have studied earlier\" or \"why didn't you finish?\").\n4. Praise must be specific and grounded, never generic or effusive.\n5. Language: Primarily Egyptian/Friendly Arabic when the student writes in Arabic (${isArabic ? 'Active' : 'Optional'}), clear simple English if English is selected.\n6. SCHOOL BRAIN IS AUTHORITATIVE:\n   - Treat the verified context below as the source of truth for the student's current school day, curriculum track, and active mission.\n   - Do not invent lessons, homework, concepts, assignments, scores, mastery, or school events that are not present in the verified context.\n   - If the context does not contain enough information to answer a school-specific question, say exactly what information is missing and ask for it or direct the student to record today's school information.\n   - Never silently substitute another lesson or another subject.\n   - When discussing learning, stay grounded in the active mission/day record when one exists.\n7. VERIFIED SCHOOL BRAIN CONTEXT:\n${contextJson}\n8. SPECIAL INTENT HANDLING:\n   - If the student says \"I don't understand\" / \"مش فاهم\": Reassure them warmly that learning takes time, normalize confusion, and invite them gently to say which part was confusing.\n   - If the student says \"explain differently\" / \"اشرح بطريقة تانية\": Offer a simple everyday analogy or relatable example suited for an 11-year-old.\n   - If the student says \"test me\" / \"اختبرني\": Provide a single, friendly, low-stakes practice question to build confidence, and encourage them to take their time.\n   - Note: Do NOT trigger a rigid tutor escalation ladder yet; keep replies conversational, supportive, and grounded.\n`.trim();\n\n    // Prepare contents array for Gemini\n    let started = false;\n    const contents = (Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [])\n      .filter((m: any) => m && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())\n      .slice(-12)\n      .map((m: { role: string; content: string }) => ({\n        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',\n        parts: [{ text: m.content.slice(0, 2000) }],\n      }))\n      .filter((c: { role: string }) => {\n        if (!started && c.role === 'model') return false; // history must start with a user turn\n        started = true;\n        return true;\n      });\n    if (contents.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No messages', degraded: true });\n    }\n\n    // Generate response using SDK default model\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents,\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const reply = response.text || (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n    res.json({\n      reply,\n      source: 'gemini',\n      detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('chat', error);\n    const isArabic = req.body?.language !== 'en';\n    const errorFallback = isArabic\n      ? 'مش قادرة أوصل للمساعد دلوقتي. جرّبي كمان شوية.'\n      : \"I can't reach the assistant right now. Try again in a moment.\";\n    res.json({ reply: errorFallback, source: 'error_fallback', degraded: true });\n  }\n});\n\n// STT (Speech-to-Text) API endpoint (Tier 2 fallback)\napp.post('/api/stt', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { audioBase64, mimeType = 'audio/webm', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n\n    if (!audioBase64) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing audio data', transcript: '' });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        transcript: '',\n        error: 'Gemini STT requires API key',\n        tier: 'fallback_unavailable',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const promptText = isArabic\n      ? 'استمع إلى التسجيل الصوتي المرفق وقم بتفريغه نصياً بدقة كما نطق الطالب باللغة العربية (اللهجة المصرية أو الفصحى). أرجع فقط النص الدقيق بدون أي مقدمات أو تحيات أو إضافات.'\n      : 'Listen to the audio recording and transcribe it accurately as spoken. Return only the exact transcription without any commentary.';\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [\n            {\n              inlineData: {\n                data: audioBase64,\n                mimeType,\n              },\n            },\n            {\n              text: promptText,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        temperature: 0.1,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const transcript = (response.text || '').trim();\n    res.json({\n      transcript,\n      tier: 'gemini_stt',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('STT API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      transcript: '',\n      error: error.message || 'STT failed',\n      tier: 'gemini_stt_error',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// TTS in-memory cache\nconst ttsCache = new Map<string, string>();\n\n// TTS (Text-to-Speech) API endpoint powered by Gemini Flash Lite TTS\napp.post('/api/tts', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { text = '', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n    if (!text || !text.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing text' });\n    }\n\n    const cleanText = text\n      .replace(/[*#_~`]/g, '')\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n      .trim()\n      .slice(0, 450); // Safe length for natural speech delivery\n\n    const langKey = language === 'fr' ? 'fr' : language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar';\n    const cacheKey = `${langKey}:${cleanText}`;\n\n    // 1. Serve from in-memory cache if previously generated\n    if (ttsCache.has(cacheKey)) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: true,\n        audioBase64: ttsCache.get(cacheKey),\n        mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        fromCache: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: false,\n        useBrowserSpeech: true,\n        text: cleanText,\n        language: langKey,\n      });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const voiceName = langKey === 'ar' ? 'Puck' : langKey === 'fr' ? 'Kore' : 'Kore';\n      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n        model: 'gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts',\n        contents: [\n          {\n            role: 'user',\n            parts: [{ text: cleanText }],\n          },\n        ],\n        config: {\n          responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],\n          speechConfig: {\n            voiceConfig: {\n              prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      const base64Audio = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData?.data;\n      if (base64Audio) {\n        ttsCache.set(cacheKey, base64Audio);\n        return res.json({\n          success: true,\n          audioBase64: base64Audio,\n          mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (genErr: any) {\n      console.warn('Gemini TTS generation issue:', genErr?.message || genErr);\n    }\n\n    // Graceful browser speech fallback if server TTS encountered an issue\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: cleanText,\n      language: langKey,\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: req.body?.text || '',\n      language: req.body?.language || 'ar',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Dynamic Lesson Explanation Generation (Miss Nour Deep Explanation)\napp.post('/api/tutor-explain', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      lessonText = '',\n      supplementaryReference = null,\n      studentName = 'صديقتي',\n      language = 'ar',\n      mode = 'full_hook_story',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Local pedagogic explanations fallback\n      const fallbackExplanations: Record<string, string> = {\n        full_hook_story: isArabic\n          ? `يا أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تعالي أحكي لك سر مشوق عن درس «${lessonTitle}» في ${subjectName}. تخيلي لو إنتي عالمة أو مستكشفة صغيرة بتواجه لغز كبير؛ الدرس ده بيعلمنا إزاي نفكر بذكاء ونحل أصعب التحديات خطوة بخطوة. يلا نفتح عيوننا وتركيزنا ونبدأ المغامرة سوا!`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Bonjour ${studentName}! Laisse-moi te raconter une histoire passionnante sur la leçon «${lessonTitle}» en ${subjectName}. Imagine que tu sois une jeune chercheuse explorant une énigme fascinante. Cette leçon va nous donner les clés pour comprendre le monde qui nous entoure!`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! Let me tell you an exciting story about our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" in ${subjectName}. Imagine you are a young explorer facing a great discovery. This lesson will show us how to think critically and solve big puzzles step by step!`,\n        core_concepts: isArabic\n          ? `ركزي معايا يا ${studentName} في أهم ثلاث نقاط في درس «${lessonTitle}»: أولاً: الفكرة المركزية اللي بيبني عليها كتاب الوزارة. ثانياً: المصطلحات الجديدة اللي بنقابلها. ثالثاً: القاعدة الأساسية اللي بتخلينا نحل أي تمرين بكل سهولة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Retiens bien ces points clés pour «${lessonTitle}», ${studentName}: D'abord, l'idée principale du manuel. Ensuite, les termes nouveaux indispensables. Enfin, la règle pratique pour résoudre tous les exercices.`\n          : `Focus with me on the key ideas for \"${lessonTitle}\", ${studentName}: First, the main concept from the textbook. Second, our core vocabulary. Third, the practical rule to solve any practice problem with confidence.`,\n        real_world_analogy: isArabic\n          ? `عارفة يا ${studentName}، بنقدر نشبه فكرة «${lessonTitle}» بحاجة بنشوفها في بيتنا كل يوم! لما بننظم ألعابنا أو نقسم وجبة حلوة مع أصحابنا، بنطبق نفس المبدأ العلمي ده تماماً. شفتي بقى العلم قريب من حياتنا إزاي؟`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Tu sais ${studentName}, le concept de «${lessonTitle}» ressemble exactement à ce que l'on fait au quotidien quand on partage un gâteau avec ses amis ou qu'on range sa chambre. La science est partout autour de nous!`\n          : `You know ${studentName}, we can relate \"${lessonTitle}\" to everyday life! Just like sharing a delicious treat or organizing your room, we apply this exact concept naturally. Science is all around us!`,\n        discussion_question: isArabic\n          ? `يا ترى يا ${studentName}، لو سألتك: إيه أكتر فكرة لفتت نظرك في درس «${lessonTitle}»؟ وإزاي نقدر نستخدم الفكرة دي عشان نساعد بلدنا أو بيتنا النهاردة؟`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `À ton avis ${studentName}, quelle est la partie la plus intéressante de «${lessonTitle}»? Comment pourrais-tu utiliser cette idée pour aider tes proches aujourd'hui?`\n          : `What do you think, ${studentName}: what was the most interesting part of \"${lessonTitle}\"? How could we use this idea in our daily life today?`,\n      };\n\n      return res.json({\n        explanation: fallbackExplanations[mode] || fallbackExplanations.full_hook_story,\n        source: 'local_tutor_fallback',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are \"المعلمة نور\" (Miss Nour), an extraordinary, caring, world-class 5th-grade primary school teacher in Egypt.\nYou are teaching a 5th-grade student named \"${studentName}\".\nCURRENT LESSON: \"${lessonTitle}\" in Subject: \"${subjectName}\".\nLESSON TEXT / CURRICULUM CONTEXT:\n\"\"\"${lessonText ? lessonText.slice(0, 1000) : 'Official Egyptian Ministry Curriculum for Grade 5.'}\"\"\"\n${\n  supplementaryReference\n    ? `SUPPLEMENTARY RESOURCES THE STUDENT ACTUALLY HAS (الأضواء / سلاح التلميذ / دليل المعلم). You may refer the student to these by name and page when it helps:\n${String(supplementaryReference).slice(0, 600)}`\n    : 'SUPPLEMENTARY RESOURCES: none recorded for this lesson. Do not invent or cite any supplementary book.'\n}\n\nTEACHING GOAL FOR MODE \"${mode}\":\n- If mode is \"full_hook_story\": Create an irresistible, captivating 3-4 sentence hook/story that makes an 11-year-old curious and excited to learn this specific lesson!\n- If mode is \"core_concepts\": Clearly break down the 2-3 essential concepts of \"${lessonTitle}\" using simple, engaging language and practical clarity suited for Grade 5.\n- If mode is \"real_world_analogy\": Give a vivid everyday real-world analogy (e.g. food, sports, nature, family) that makes the abstract concept immediately click.\n- If mode is \"discussion_question\": Ask the student a gentle, thought-provoking question to test her understanding warmly.\n- If mode is \"simplify\": The student found the lesson hard. Reassure her affectionately, and re-explain in ultra-simple, reassuring terms.\n\nSTYLE & LANGUAGE:\n- If language is \"ar\": Use natural, warm, affectionate Egyptian Arabic (e.g. \"يا حبيبتي\", \"شوفي يا ستي\", \"الموضوع ممتع جداً\", \"بصي معايا\").\n- If language is \"fr\": Use warm, polite, enthusiastic French adapted for primary school students (\"Chère amie\", \"C'est très simple et passionnant!\").\n- If language is \"en\": Use warm, encouraging, engaging English suitable for 5th grade.\n- Keep output concise (max 4-5 sentences) so it reads beautifully and can be spoken out loud by the voice engine without lagging.\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [{ text: `Generate the ${mode} explanation for ${studentName} about ${lessonTitle}.` }],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const explanation = response.text || (isArabic ? `درس «${lessonTitle}» درس ممتع ومهم جداً يا ${studentName}!` : `Our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" is exciting and important, ${studentName}!`);\n    res.json({ explanation, source: 'gemini' });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('tutor-explain', error);\n    const isAr = req.body?.language !== 'en' && req.body?.language !== 'fr';\n    res.json({\n      explanation: isAr\n        ? `أهلاً يا ${req.body?.studentName || 'صديقتي'}! درس «${req.body?.lessonTitle || 'الدرس'}» من أهم الدروس في كتاب الوزارة، يلا نستكشفه سوا خطوة بخطوة!`\n        : `Welcome ${req.body?.studentName || 'friend'}! This lesson is a key part of your textbook, let's explore it together!`,\n      source: 'error_fallback',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Interactive Stage Tutor Dialogue (Nour - Real human-like tutor for ANY official lesson)\napp.post('/api/tutor-reply', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      studentInput,\n      currentBeatText = '',\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      studentName = 'صديقتي',\n      language = 'ar',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      const lower = (studentInput || '').toLowerCase();\n      let contextualReply = '';\n\n      if (lower.includes('معنى') || lower.includes('يعني ايه') || lower.includes('يعني إيه') || lower.includes('meaning') || lower.includes('c\\'est quoi')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال ممتاز يا ${studentName}! في درسنا «${lessonTitle}»، المعنى الأساسي هنا بيوضح لنا إزاي نفهم الفكرة بدقة ونربطها بالسياق في كتاب الوزارة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Excellente question ${studentName}! Dans la leçon «${lessonTitle}», ce terme nous aide à comprendre précisément le sujet du manuel.`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! In our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\", this key idea helps us understand the textbook concept clearly.`;\n      } else if (lower.includes('ليه') || lower.includes('لماذا') || lower.includes('عشان ايه') || lower.includes('why') || lower.includes('pourquoi')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `ذكاء رائع منك يا ${studentName} إنك بتسألي عن السبب! في «${lessonTitle}»، ده بيحصل علشان يحقق التوازن والنتيجة الصحيحة اللي بندرسها في كتاب الوزارة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Très bonne curiosité, ${studentName}! Dans «${lessonTitle}», cela s'explique par la règle fondamentale de notre cours.`\n          : `Brilliant curiosity, ${studentName}! In \"${lessonTitle}\", this happens because of the core principle we are studying.`;\n      } else if (lower.includes('مش فاهم') || lower.includes('مش فاهمة') || lower.includes(\"don't understand\") || lower.includes('pas compris')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا حبيبتي يا ${studentName}! طبيعي جداً نحتاج نبسطها. تعالي نتخيل «${lessonTitle}» بمثال بسيط من بيتنا ويومنا: الفكرة ببساطة إننا بنمشي خطوة بخطوة عشان نوصل للحل.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Ne t'inquiète pas du tout, ${studentName}! (.env is gitignored.)\\n'\n  );\n}\n\nclass GeminiRequestError extends Error {\n  status: number;\n  constructor(status: number, message: string) {\n    super(message);\n    this.status = status;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Minimal REST client for the subset of Gemini the app uses (generateContent).\n * Kept intentionally small so the key travels in the header the API expects.\n */\nconst gemini = {\n  async generateContent(body: {\n    model: string;\n    contents: unknown;\n    config?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    if (!apiKey) throw new GeminiRequestError(401, 'No API key configured');\n    const { model, contents, config } = body;\n    const url = `${GEMINI_BASE_URL}/models/${model}:generateContent`;\n    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { contents };\n    if (config) {\n      const { systemInstruction, ...rest } = config as Record<string, unknown>;\n      Object.assign(payload, rest);\n      if (systemInstruction) payload.systemInstruction = { parts: [{ text: systemInstruction }] };\n    }\n    const resp = await fetch(url, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        'x-goog-api-key': apiKey,\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify(payload),\n    });\n    const json: any = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));\n    if (!resp.ok) {\n      throw new GeminiRequestError(\n        resp.status,\n        json?.error?.message || `Gemini request failed (HTTP ${resp.status})`\n      );\n    }\n    return json;\n  },\n};\n\n/** Extract plain text from a generateContent response. */\nfunction geminiText(response: any): string {\n  const parts = response?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts;\n  if (!Array.isArray(parts)) return '';\n  return parts\n    .map((p: any) => (typeof p?.text === 'string' ? p.text : ''))\n    .join('')\n    .trim();\n}\n",

(.env is gitignored.)\\n'\n  );\n}\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction isQuotaExhaustedError(err: any): boolean {\n  if (!err) return false;\n  const status = err.status || err.code;\n  const msg = String(err.message || err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    apiKeySource,\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 1]?.content || '').trim();\n    const lowerUserMsg = lastUserMsg.toLowerCase();\n\n    // Specific intent detection for Phase 3\n    const isDontUnderstand =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهم') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهمة') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't understand\") ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('dont understand') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const isTestMe =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبرني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اسألني سؤال') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبار') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('test me') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('quiz me');\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Graceful offline/local companion fallback if API key is not yet set or during quota cooldown\n      let fallbackReply = '';\n      if (isDontUnderstand) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName}! عادي جداً متفهمش من أول مرة، دي خطوة طبيعية في التعلم. قولي إيه أكثر نقطة حسيتها ملخبطة وهنبسطها سوا خطوة بخطوة.`\n          : `No worries at all, ${studentName}! It's completely normal not to understand right away. Tell me which part felt tricky, and we'll break it down step by step together.`;\n      } else if (isExplainDifferently) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! تعال نجرب مثال من حياتنا اليومية أو نشبه الموضوع بحاجة بنشوفها كل يوم. قولي تحب نبدأ من أول فكرة ولا من النص؟`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! Let's look at this with a simple real-world analogy. Would you like to restart from the beginning or focus on the tricky part?`;\n      } else if (isTestMe) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `فكرة ممتازة وتحدي حلو يا ${studentName}! جاهز لسؤال خفيف وسريع على اللي ذكرته؟ خد وقتك خالص وفكر على مهلك.`\n          : `Awesome attitude and great challenge, ${studentName}! Ready for a quick, friendly question on what we discussed? Take your time!`;\n      } else {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقك الذكي للتعلم. أنا هنا علشان أسمعك وأساعدك تنظم يومك وتفهم اللي محتاجه بهدوء ودون أي ضغط.`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am here to help organize your day and walk through any questions without stress.`;\n      }\n\n      return res.json({\n        reply: fallbackReply,\n        source: 'local_companion_fallback',\n        degraded: true,\n        detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const contextJson = schoolBrainContext ? JSON.stringify({\n      school: schoolBrainContext.school || null,\n      location: schoolBrainContext.location || null,\n      curriculumTrack: schoolBrainContext.curriculumTrack || null,\n      dayRecord: schoolBrainContext.dayRecord || null,\n      activeMission: schoolBrainContext.activeMission || null,\n    }) : 'No verified School Brain context was supplied.';\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" (الرفيق الدراسي الذكي), a personal AI learning assistant for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nCRITICAL PRINCIPLES:\n1. You are an AI companion, NOT a human teacher or parent. Never pretend to be human.\n2. Tone: Warm, patient, encouraging, age-appropriate for an ~11-year-old child.\n3. Absolutely NO moralizing, scolding, or guilt-tripping (e.g. never say \"you should have studied earlier\" or \"why didn't you finish?\").\n4. Praise must be specific and grounded, never generic or effusive.\n5. Language: Primarily Egyptian/Friendly Arabic when the student writes in Arabic (${isArabic ? 'Active' : 'Optional'}), clear simple English if English is selected.\n6. SCHOOL BRAIN IS AUTHORITATIVE:\n   - Treat the verified context below as the source of truth for the student's current school day, curriculum track, and active mission.\n   - Do not invent lessons, homework, concepts, assignments, scores, mastery, or school events that are not present in the verified context.\n   - If the context does not contain enough information to answer a school-specific question, say exactly what information is missing and ask for it or direct the student to record today's school information.\n   - Never silently substitute another lesson or another subject.\n   - When discussing learning, stay grounded in the active mission/day record when one exists.\n7. VERIFIED SCHOOL BRAIN CONTEXT:\n${contextJson}\n8. SPECIAL INTENT HANDLING:\n   - If the student says \"I don't understand\" / \"مش فاهم\": Reassure them warmly that learning takes time, normalize confusion, and invite them gently to say which part was confusing.\n   - If the student says \"explain differently\" / \"اشرح بطريقة تانية\": Offer a simple everyday analogy or relatable example suited for an 11-year-old.\n   - If the student says \"test me\" / \"اختبرني\": Provide a single, friendly, low-stakes practice question to build confidence, and encourage them to take their time.\n   - Note: Do NOT trigger a rigid tutor escalation ladder yet; keep replies conversational, supportive, and grounded.\n`.trim();\n\n    // Prepare contents array for Gemini\n    let started = false;\n    const contents = (Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [])\n      .filter((m: any) => m && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())\n      .slice(-12)\n      .map((m: { role: string; content: string }) => ({\n        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',\n        parts: [{ text: m.content.slice(0, 2000) }],\n      }))\n      .filter((c: { role: string }) => {\n        if (!started && c.role === 'model') return false; // history must start with a user turn\n        started = true;\n        return true;\n      });\n    if (contents.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No messages', degraded: true });\n    }\n\n    // Generate response using SDK default model\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents,\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const reply = response.text || (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n    res.json({\n      reply,\n      source: 'gemini',\n      detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('chat', error);\n    const isArabic = req.body?.language !== 'en';\n    const errorFallback = isArabic\n      ? 'مش قادرة أوصل للمساعد دلوقتي. جرّبي كمان شوية.'\n      : \"I can't reach the assistant right now. Try again in a moment.\";\n    res.json({ reply: errorFallback, source: 'error_fallback', degraded: true });\n  }\n});\n\n// STT (Speech-to-Text) API endpoint (Tier 2 fallback)\napp.post('/api/stt', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { audioBase64, mimeType = 'audio/webm', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n\n    if (!audioBase64) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing audio data', transcript: '' });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        transcript: '',\n        error: 'Gemini STT requires API key',\n        tier: 'fallback_unavailable',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const promptText = isArabic\n      ? 'استمع إلى التسجيل الصوتي المرفق وقم بتفريغه نصياً بدقة كما نطق الطالب باللغة العربية (اللهجة المصرية أو الفصحى). أرجع فقط النص الدقيق بدون أي مقدمات أو تحيات أو إضافات.'\n      : 'Listen to the audio recording and transcribe it accurately as spoken. Return only the exact transcription without any commentary.';\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [\n            {\n              inlineData: {\n                data: audioBase64,\n                mimeType,\n              },\n            },\n            {\n              text: promptText,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        temperature: 0.1,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const transcript = (response.text || '').trim();\n    res.json({\n      transcript,\n      tier: 'gemini_stt',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('STT API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      transcript: '',\n      error: error.message || 'STT failed',\n      tier: 'gemini_stt_error',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// TTS in-memory cache\nconst ttsCache = new Map<string, string>();\n\n// TTS (Text-to-Speech) API endpoint powered by Gemini Flash Lite TTS\napp.post('/api/tts', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { text = '', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n    if (!text || !text.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing text' });\n    }\n\n    const cleanText = text\n      .replace(/[*#_~`]/g, '')\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n      .trim()\n      .slice(0, 450); // Safe length for natural speech delivery\n\n    const langKey = language === 'fr' ? 'fr' : language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar';\n    const cacheKey = `${langKey}:${cleanText}`;\n\n    // 1. Serve from in-memory cache if previously generated\n    if (ttsCache.has(cacheKey)) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: true,\n        audioBase64: ttsCache.get(cacheKey),\n        mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        fromCache: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: false,\n        useBrowserSpeech: true,\n        text: cleanText,\n        language: langKey,\n      });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const voiceName = langKey === 'ar' ? 'Puck' : langKey === 'fr' ? 'Kore' : 'Kore';\n      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n        model: 'gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts',\n        contents: [\n          {\n            role: 'user',\n            parts: [{ text: cleanText }],\n          },\n        ],\n        config: {\n          responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],\n          speechConfig: {\n            voiceConfig: {\n              prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      const base64Audio = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData?.data;\n      if (base64Audio) {\n        ttsCache.set(cacheKey, base64Audio);\n        return res.json({\n          success: true,\n          audioBase64: base64Audio,\n          mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (genErr: any) {\n      console.warn('Gemini TTS generation issue:', genErr?.message || genErr);\n    }\n\n    // Graceful browser speech fallback if server TTS encountered an issue\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: cleanText,\n      language: langKey,\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: req.body?.text || '',\n      language: req.body?.language || 'ar',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Dynamic Lesson Explanation Generation (Miss Nour Deep Explanation)\napp.post('/api/tutor-explain', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      lessonText = '',\n      supplementaryReference = null,\n      studentName = 'صديقتي',\n      language = 'ar',\n      mode = 'full_hook_story',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Local pedagogic explanations fallback\n      const fallbackExplanations: Record<string, string> = {\n        full_hook_story: isArabic\n          ? `يا أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تعالي أحكي لك سر مشوق عن درس «${lessonTitle}» في ${subjectName}. تخيلي لو إنتي عالمة أو مستكشفة صغيرة بتواجه لغز كبير؛ الدرس ده بيعلمنا إزاي نفكر بذكاء ونحل أصعب التحديات خطوة بخطوة. يلا نفتح عيوننا وتركيزنا ونبدأ المغامرة سوا!`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Bonjour ${studentName}! Laisse-moi te raconter une histoire passionnante sur la leçon «${lessonTitle}» en ${subjectName}. Imagine que tu sois une jeune chercheuse explorant une énigme fascinante. Cette leçon va nous donner les clés pour comprendre le monde qui nous entoure!`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! Let me tell you an exciting story about our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" in ${subjectName}. Imagine you are a young explorer facing a great discovery. This lesson will show us how to think critically and solve big puzzles step by step!`,\n        core_concepts: isArabic\n          ? `ركزي معايا يا ${studentName} في أهم ثلاث نقاط في درس «${lessonTitle}»: أولاً: الفكرة المركزية اللي بيبني عليها كتاب الوزارة. ثانياً: المصطلحات الجديدة اللي بنقابلها. ثالثاً: القاعدة الأساسية اللي بتخلينا نحل أي تمرين بكل سهولة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Retiens bien ces points clés pour «${lessonTitle}», ${studentName}: D'abord, l'idée principale du manuel. Ensuite, les termes nouveaux indispensables. Enfin, la règle pratique pour résoudre tous les exercices.`\n          : `Focus with me on the key ideas for \"${lessonTitle}\", ${studentName}: First, the main concept from the textbook. Second, our core vocabulary. Third, the practical rule to solve any practice problem with confidence.`,\n        real_world_analogy: isArabic\n          ? `عارفة يا ${studentName}، بنقدر نشبه فكرة «${lessonTitle}» بحاجة بنشوفها في بيتنا كل يوم! لما بننظم ألعابنا أو نقسم وجبة حلوة مع أصحابنا، بنطبق نفس المبدأ العلمي ده تماماً. شفتي بقى العلم قريب من حياتنا إزاي؟`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Tu sais ${studentName}, le concept de «${lessonTitle}» ressemble exactement à ce que l'on fait au quotidien quand on partage un gâteau avec ses amis ou qu'on range sa chambre. La science est partout autour de nous!`\n          : `You know ${studentName}, we can relate \"${lessonTitle}\" to everyday life! Just like sharing a delicious treat or organizing your room, we apply this exact concept naturally. Science is all around us!`,\n        discussion_question: isArabic\n          ? `يا ترى يا ${studentName}، لو سألتك: إيه أكتر فكرة لفتت نظرك في درس «${lessonTitle}»؟ وإزاي نقدر نستخدم الفكرة دي عشان نساعد بلدنا أو بيتنا النهاردة؟`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `À ton avis ${studentName}, quelle est la partie la plus intéressante de «${lessonTitle}»? Comment pourrais-tu utiliser cette idée pour aider tes proches aujourd'hui?`\n          : `What do you think, ${studentName}: what was the most interesting part of \"${lessonTitle}\"? How could we use this idea in our daily life today?`,\n      };\n\n      return res.json({\n        explanation: fallbackExplanations[mode] || fallbackExplanations.full_hook_story,\n        source: 'local_tutor_fallback',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are \"المعلمة نور\" (Miss Nour), an extraordinary, caring, world-class 5th-grade primary school teacher in Egypt.\nYou are teaching a 5th-grade student named \"${studentName}\".\nCURRENT LESSON: \"${lessonTitle}\" in Subject: \"${subjectName}\".\nLESSON TEXT / CURRICULUM CONTEXT:\n\"\"\"${lessonText ? lessonText.slice(0, 1000) : 'Official Egyptian Ministry Curriculum for Grade 5.'}\"\"\"\n${\n  supplementaryReference\n    ? `SUPPLEMENTARY RESOURCES THE STUDENT ACTUALLY HAS (الأضواء / سلاح التلميذ / دليل المعلم). You may refer the student to these by name and page when it helps:\n${String(supplementaryReference).slice(0, 600)}`\n    : 'SUPPLEMENTARY RESOURCES: none recorded for this lesson. Do not invent or cite any supplementary book.'\n}\n\nTEACHING GOAL FOR MODE \"${mode}\":\n- If mode is \"full_hook_story\": Create an irresistible, captivating 3-4 sentence hook/story that makes an 11-year-old curious and excited to learn this specific lesson!\n- If mode is \"core_concepts\": Clearly break down the 2-3 essential concepts of \"${lessonTitle}\" using simple, engaging language and practical clarity suited for Grade 5.\n- If mode is \"real_world_analogy\": Give a vivid everyday real-world analogy (e.g. food, sports, nature, family) that makes the abstract concept immediately click.\n- If mode is \"discussion_question\": Ask the student a gentle, thought-provoking question to test her understanding warmly.\n- If mode is \"simplify\": The student found the lesson hard. Reassure her affectionately, and re-explain in ultra-simple, reassuring terms.\n\nSTYLE & LANGUAGE:\n- If language is \"ar\": Use natural, warm, affectionate Egyptian Arabic (e.g. \"يا حبيبتي\", \"شوفي يا ستي\", \"الموضوع ممتع جداً\", \"بصي معايا\").\n- If language is \"fr\": Use warm, polite, enthusiastic French adapted for primary school students (\"Chère amie\", \"C'est très simple et passionnant!\").\n- If language is \"en\": Use warm, encouraging, engaging English suitable for 5th grade.\n- Keep output concise (max 4-5 sentences) so it reads beautifully and can be spoken out loud by the voice engine without lagging.\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [{ text: `Generate the ${mode} explanation for ${studentName} about ${lessonTitle}.` }],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const explanation = response.text || (isArabic ? `درس «${lessonTitle}» درس ممتع ومهم جداً يا ${studentName}!` : `Our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" is exciting and important, ${studentName}!`);\n    res.json({ explanation, source: 'gemini' });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('tutor-explain', error);\n    const isAr = req.body?.language !== 'en' && req.body?.language !== 'fr';\n    res.json({\n      explanation: isAr\n        ? `أهلاً يا ${req.body?.studentName || 'صديقتي'}! درس «${req.body?.lessonTitle || 'الدرس'}» من أهم الدروس في كتاب الوزارة، يلا نستكشفه سوا خطوة بخطوة!`\n        : `Welcome ${req.body?.studentName || 'friend'}! This lesson is a key part of your textbook, let's explore it together!`,\n      source: 'error_fallback',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Interactive Stage Tutor Dialogue (Nour - Real human-like tutor for ANY official lesson)\napp.post('/api/tutor-reply', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      studentInput,\n      currentBeatText = '',\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      studentName = 'صديقتي',\n      language = 'ar',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      const lower = (studentInput || '').toLowerCase();\n      let contextualReply = '';\n\n      if (lower.includes('معنى') || lower.includes('يعني ايه') || lower.includes('يعني إيه') || lower.includes('meaning') || lower.includes('c\\'est quoi')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال ممتاز يا ${studentName}! في درسنا «${lessonTitle}»، المعنى الأساسي هنا بيوضح لنا إزاي نفهم الفكرة بدقة ونربطها بالسياق في كتاب الوزارة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Excellente question ${studentName}! Dans la leçon «${lessonTitle}», ce terme nous aide à comprendre précisément le sujet du manuel.`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! In our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\", this key idea helps us understand the textbook concept clearly.`;\n      } else if (lower.includes('ليه') || lower.includes('لماذا') || lower.includes('عشان ايه') || lower.includes('why') || lower.includes('pourquoi')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `ذكاء رائع منك يا ${studentName} إنك بتسألي عن السبب! في «${lessonTitle}»، ده بيحصل علشان يحقق التوازن والنتيجة الصحيحة اللي بندرسها في كتاب الوزارة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Très bonne curiosité, ${studentName}! Dans «${lessonTitle}», cela s'explique par la règle fondamentale de notre cours.`\n          : `Brilliant curiosity, ${studentName}! In \"${lessonTitle}\", this happens because of the core principle we are studying.`;\n      } else if (lower.includes('مش فاهم') || lower.includes('مش فاهمة') || lower.includes(\"don't understand\") || lower.includes('pas compris')) {\n        contextualReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا حبيبتي يا ${studentName}! طبيعي جداً نحتاج نبسطها. تعالي نتخيل «${lessonTitle}» بمثال بسيط من بيتنا ويومنا: الفكرة ببساطة إننا بنمشي خطوة بخطوة عشان نوصل للحل.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Ne t'inquiète pas du tout, ${studentName}! Reassure her affectionately, and re-explain in ultra-simple, reassuring terms.\n\nSTYLE & LANGUAGE:\n- If language is \"ar\": Use natural, warm, affectionate Egyptian Arabic (e.g. \"يا حبيبتي\", \"شوفي يا ستي\", \"الموضوع ممتع جداً\", \"بصي معايا\").\n- If language is \"fr\": Use warm, polite, enthusiastic French adapted for primary school students (\"Chère amie\", \"C'est très simple et passionnant!\").\n- If language is \"en\": Use warm, encouraging, engaging English suitable for 5th grade.\n- Keep output concise (max 4-5 sentences) so it reads beautifully and can be spoken out loud by the voice engine without lagging.\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await gemini.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [{ text: `Generate the ${mode} explanation for ${studentName} about ${lessonTitle}.` }],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n    const responseText = geminiText(response);\n\n    const explanation = responseText || (isArabic ? `درس «${lessonTitle}» درس ممتع ومهم جداً يا ${studentName}!` : `Our lesson \"${lessonTitle}\" is exciting and important, ${studentName}!`);\n    res.json({ explanation, source: 'gemini' });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('tutor-explain', error);\n    const isAr = req.body?.language !== 'en' && req.body?.language !== 'fr';\n    res.json({\n      explanation: isAr\n        ? `أهلاً يا ${req.body?.studentName || 'صديقتي'}! درس «${req.body?.lessonTitle || 'الدرس'}» من أهم الدروس في كتاب الوزارة، يلا نستكشفه سوا خطوة بخطوة!`\n        : `Welcome ${req.body?.studentName || 'friend'}!  "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// AI access via the Gemini REST API.\n// The @google/genai SDK misclassifies Google's newer \"AQ.\" authentication keys\n// as OAuth access tokens and returns 403 ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT, while\n// the same key authenticates correctly over REST. (.env is gitignored.)\\n'\n  );\n}\n\nclass GeminiRequestError extends Error {\n  status: number;\n  constructor(status: number, message: string) {\n    super(message);\n    this.status = status;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Minimal REST client for the subset of Gemini the app uses (generateContent).\n * Kept intentionally small so the key travels in the header the API expects.\n */\nconst gemini = {\n configured');\n    const { model, contents, config } = body;\n    const url = `${GEMINI_BASE_URL}/models/${model}:generateContent`;\n    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { contents };\n    if (config) {\n      const { systemInstruction, ...generationConfig } = config as Record<string, unknown>;\n      // REST expects sampling/response options nested under generationConfig;\n      // only resp.status,\n        json?.error?.message || `Gemini request failed (HTTP ${resp.status})`\n      );\n    }\n    return json;\n  },\n};\n\n/** Extract plain text from a generateContent response. p?.text === 'string' ? p.text : ''))\n    .join('')\n    .trim();\n}\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const
