Two shapes:\n    a dot-leader list, or a contents heading with many bare numerals.\n    \"\"\"\n    hits = []\n    for i in range(min(20, doc.page_count)):\n        t = norm(doc[i].get_text())\n        if \"قائمة المحتوى\" in t or \"المحتويات\" in t or \"قائمة املحتوى\" in t:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        if len(ENTRY_RE.findall(t)) >= 3:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        # Layout B: several lines that are only a page number.\n        bare = sum(\n            1\n            for l in t.split(\"\\n\")\n            if digits(l).strip(\" .-|\").isdigit() and l.strip()\n        )\n        if bare >= 5 and (\"الدرس\" in t or \"الوحدة\" in t):\n            hits.append(i)\n    return hits\n\n\ndef _detect_offset(doc) -> int:\n    \"\"\"\n    Printed page number -> PDF page index offset.\n    Scan pages for a bare number and take the most common difference.\n    \"\"\"\n    diffs = Counter()\n    for i in range(min(60, doc.page_count)):\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\") if l.strip()]\n        # Page numbers usually sit in the first or last couple of lines.\n        for cand in (lines[:2] + lines[-2:]):\n            digits = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", cand).strip(\" .-|\")\n            if digits.isdigit():\n                n = int(digits)\n                if 1 <= n <= doc.page_count:\n                    diffs[i - n] += 1\n    return diffs.most_common(1)[0][0] if diffs else 0\n\n\ndef parse_toc(pdf_path: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    Return {\"offset\": int, \"units\": [...], \"confidence\": str}.\n    Two contents layouts occur and both are handled:\n      A) \"12. . . . . .  title\"          (dot leader — Science, Math)\n      B) \"title\" then \"12\" below it      (Social Studies)\n    These PDFs also emit each heading twice, the second copy word-reversed.\n    Layout B therefore skips echo lines, and a page is only accepted when\n    enough entries survive. A page that yields nothing usable is reported as\n    low confidence rather than guessed at.\n    \"\"\"\n    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)\n    try:\n        offset = _detect_offset(doc)\n        units: list[dict] = []\n        current: Optional[dict] = None\n        accepted = 0\n\n        for i in _toc_pages(doc):\n            lines = [norm(l) for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\")]\n            lines = [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip()]\n            page_entries: list[dict] = []\n            seen: set[tuple] = set()\n\n            for j, line in enumerate(lines):\n                # Layout A\n                m = ENTRY_RE.match(line)\n                if m:\n                    title = clean_title(m.group(2))\n                    if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n                        key = (int(m.group(1)), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(m.group(1)), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n                    continue\n\n                # Layout B: a bare number, title on a preceding line.\n                num = digits(line).strip(\" .-|\")\n                if num.isdigit() and len(num) <= 3:\n                    title = _preceding_title(lines, j)\n                    if title:\n                        key = (int(num), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(num), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n\n            if len(page_entries) >= 4:\n                accepted += len(page_entries)\n                for e in page_entries:\n                    current = _attach(units, current, e)\n\n            # Unit / mahwar headings on any contents page.\n            for line in lines:\n                if UNIT_RE.search(line) and not ENTRY_RE.match(line):\n                    heading = clean_title(DOT_LEADER_RE.sub(\" \", line))\n                    if 2 <= len(heading) <= 90:\n                        current = {\"unit\": heading, \"lessons\": []}\n                        units.append(current)\n\n        units = [u for u in units if u[\"lessons\"]]\n        return {\n            \"offset\": offset,\n            \"units\": units,\n            \"confidence\": \"high\" if accepted >= 8 else (\"low\" if accepted else \"none\"),\n        }\n    finally:\n        doc.close()\n\n\nLABEL_RE = re.compile(r\"^(الدرس|الوحدة|المحور|الظاهرة|المفهوم|املفهوم|تعلّم|شارك|تساءل|مشروع)\\b\")\n\n\ndef _wordbag(s: str) -> frozenset:\n    return frozenset(re.findall(r\"[\\u0600-\\u06FF]+\", s))\n\n\ndef _is_echo(cand: str, prev: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True when cand is a reversed duplicate of prev (a bidi artefact).\"\"\"\n    a, b = _wordbag(cand), _wordbag(prev)\n    if not a or not b:\n        return False\n    return a == b\n\n\ndef _preceding_title(lines: list[str], j: int) -> Optional[str]:\n    \"\"\"\n    The lesson title for the number at lines[j]. Walk back up to two lines,\n    skipping reversed-duplicate echoes and bare labels like \"الدرس الأوّل:\".\n    \"\"\"\n    for k in (j - 1, j - 2):\n        if k < 0:\n            break\n        cand = lines[k].strip()\n        if not cand or not ARABIC_RE.search(cand):\n            continue\n        if LABEL_RE.match(cand):\n            continue\n        if k - 1 >= 0 and _is_echo(cand, lines[k - 1]):\n            continue\n        title = clean_title(cand)\n        if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n            return title\n    return None\n\n\ndef _entry(printed: int, title: str, offset: int, page_count: int) -> dict:\n    resolved = printed + offset\n    return {\n        \"title\": title,\n        \"printedPage\": printed,\n        \"page\": resolved if 0 < resolved <= page_count else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef _attach(units: list, current: Optional[dict], entry: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Append an entry to the open unit, opening a default one if needed.\"\"\"\n    if current is None:\n        current = {\"unit\": \"المحتوى\", \"lessons\": []}\n        units.append(current)\n    current[\"lessons\"].append(entry)\n    return current\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    import sys\n\n    for p in sys.argv[1:]:\n        r = parse_toc(p)\n        print(f\"\\n=== {p}  offset={r['offset']}  units={len(r['units'])} ===\")\n        for u in r[\"units\"]:\n            print(f\"  {u['unit']}\")\n            for l in u[\"lessons\"][:6]:\n                print(f\"     p{l['printedPage']:>4} (pdf {l['page']})  {l['title']}\")\n",

 "old_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDeterministic table-of-contents extraction.\n\nThe ministry PDFs carry a real text layer, so contents can be read directly —\nno OCR, no vision API, no quota. Two quirks have to be undone first:\n\n1. Arabic lines are stored in visual order, i.e. with the word order reversed.\n   Reversing the words restores logical Arabic.\n2. The lam-alef ligature is decomposed into \"ا\" + \"ل\" + \"ا\" style sequences\n   (\"األ\" for \"الأ\"). These are repaired by table.\n\nPage numbers in the contents are the *printed* numbers. The offset to the PDF\npage index is detected per book by finding the most common difference between\na page's printed number and its position.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport unicodedata\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nimport fitz\n\n# Ligature repairs: NFKC leaves these broken, so fix them explicitly.\nLIGATURES = [\n    (\"األ\", \"الأ\"), (\"اإل\", \"الإ\"), (\"اآل\", \"الآ\"),\n    (\"ألا\", \"ألا\"), (\"إل\", \"إل\"),\n]\n\nARABIC_RE = re.compile(r\"[\\u0600-\\u06FF]\")\n# Arabic-Indic (0-9) and Extended Arabic-Indic digits -> ASCII.\nDIGITS = str.maketrans(\"٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\",\n                       \"01234567890123456789\")\n\n\ndef digits(s: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Convert Arabic-Indic numerals to ASCII.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", s).translate(DIGITS)\n# \"12. . . . . . . title\" — number, dot leader, then the title.\nENTRY_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(\\d{1,4})\\s*\\.\\s*(?:\\.\\s*){2,}\\s*\\x03?\\s*(.+?)\\s*$\", re.M)\nUNIT_RE = re.compile(r\"(الوحدة|المحور|الوحده)\")\nDOT_LEADER_RE = re.compile(r\"[\\s.\\u00b7\\u2026]*\\.{2,}[\\s.\\u00b7\\u2026]*\")\n\n\ndef norm(s: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalise and repair Arabic extracted from these PDFs.\"\"\"\n    s = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", s)\n    for bad, good in LIGATURES:\n        s = s.replace(bad, good)\n    return s\n\n\ndef fix_visual_order(line: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"These PDFs store Arabic words in visual order. Reverse the words.\"\"\"\n    if not ARABIC_RE.search(line):\n        return line\n    words = line.split()\n    return \" \".join(reversed(words))\n\n\n# Letters that can precede the definite article (و ف ب ك ل + أ لل). A mid-word\n# \"ال\" after one of these is a real article and must be left alone.\nPREFIX_LETTERS = set(\"وفبكلأ\")\n\n\ndef fix_lam_alef(word: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"\n    The lam-alef ligature is stored reversed as \"ال\" instead of \"لا\".\n    Repair only mid-word occurrences, and never a prefixed article\n    (بالمدرسة, والكتاب stay intact).\n    \"\"\"\n    if len(word) < 3 or ARABIC_RE.search(word) is None:\n        return word\n    # Protect a leading definite article, including after a prefix letter.\n    protected = 0\n    if word.startswith(\"ال\"):\n        protected = 2\n    elif len(word) > 2 and word[0] in PREFIX_LETTERS and word[1:3] == \"ال\":\n        protected = 3\n    head, tail = word[:protected], word[protected:]\n    return head + tail.replace(\"ال\", \"لا\")\n\n\ndef clean_title(raw: str) -> str:\n    raw = raw.replace(\"\\x03\", \" \").strip()\n    raw = fix_visual_order(raw)\n    # A colon that ended up attached to the wrong side after reversal.\n    raw = re.sub(r\"\\s+:\", \":\", raw)\n    raw = re.sub(r\":(\\S)\", r\": \\1\", raw)\n    # Unit headings read \"الوحدة: الأولى …\" once reversed; the colon belongs\n    # after the ordinal: \"الوحدة الأولى: …\".\n    m = re.match(r\"^(الوحدة|المحور)\\s*:\\s*(\\S+)\\s*(.*)$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        rest = f\" {m.group(3)}\" if m.group(3) else \"\"\n        raw = f\"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}:{rest}\"\n    return re.sub(r\"\\s{2,}\", \" \", raw).strip(\" .\")\n\n\ndef _toc_pages(doc) -> list[int]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Pages near the front that look like a table of contents. Two shapes:\n    a dot-leader list, or a contents heading with many bare numerals.\n    \"\"\"\n    hits = []\n    for i in range(min(20, doc.page_count)):\n        t = norm(doc[i].get_text())\n        if \"قائمة المحتوى\" in t or \"المحتويات\" in t or \"قائمة املحتوى\" in t:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        if len(ENTRY_RE.findall(t)) >= 3:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        # Layout B: several lines that are only a page number.\n        bare = sum(\n            1\n            for l in t.split(\"\\n\")\n            if digits(l).strip(\" .-|\").isdigit() and l.strip()\n        )\n        if bare >= 5 and (\"الدرس\" in t or \"الوحدة\" in t):\n            hits.append(i)\n    return hits\n\n\ndef _detect_offset(doc) -> int:\n    \"\"\"\n    Printed page number -> PDF page index offset.\n    Scan pages for a bare number and take the most common difference.\n    \"\"\"\n    diffs = Counter()\n    for i in range(min(60, doc.page_count)):\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\") if l.strip()]\n        # Page numbers usually sit in the first or last couple of lines.\n        for cand in (lines[:2] + lines[-2:]):\n            digits = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", cand).strip(\" .-|\")\n            if digits.isdigit():\n                n = int(digits)\n                if 1 <= n <= doc.page_count:\n                    diffs[i - n] += 1\n    return diffs.most_common(1)[0][0] if diffs else 0\n\n\ndef parse_toc(pdf_path: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    Return {\"offset\": int, \"units\": [...], \"confidence\": str}.\n    Two contents layouts occur and both are handled:\n      A) \"12. . . . . .  title\"          (dot leader — Science, Math)\n      B) \"title\" then \"12\" below it      (Social Studies)\n    These PDFs also emit each heading twice, the second copy word-reversed.\n    Layout B therefore skips echo lines, and a page is only accepted when\n    enough entries survive. A page that yields nothing usable is reported as\n    low confidence rather than guessed at.\n    \"\"\"\n    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)\n    try:\n        offset = _detect_offset(doc)\n        units: list[dict] = []\n        current: Optional[dict] = None\n        accepted = 0\n\n        for i in _toc_pages(doc):\n            lines = [norm(l) for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\")]\n            lines = [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip()]\n            page_entries: list[dict] = []\n            seen: set[tuple] = set()\n\n            for j, line in enumerate(lines):\n                # Layout A\n                m = ENTRY_RE.match(line)\n                if m:\n                    title = clean_title(m.group(2))\n                    if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n                        key = (int(m.group(1)), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(m.group(1)), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n                    continue\n\n                # Layout B: a bare number, title on a preceding line.\n                num = digits(line).strip(\" .-|\")\n                if num.isdigit() and len(num) <= 3:\n                    title = _preceding_title(lines, j)\n                    if title:\n                        key = (int(num), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(num), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n\n            if len(page_entries) >= 4:\n                accepted += len(page_entries)\n                for e in page_entries:\n                    current = _attach(units, current, e)\n\n            # Unit / mahwar headings on any contents page.\n            for line in lines:\n                if UNIT_RE.search(line) and not ENTRY_RE.match(line):\n                    heading = clean_title(DOT_LEADER_RE.sub(\" \", line))\n                    if 2 <= len(heading) <= 90:\n                        current = {\"unit\": heading, \"lessons\": []}\n                        units.append(current)\n\n        units = [u for u in units if u[\"lessons\"]]\n        return {\n            \"offset\": offset,\n            \"units\": units,\n            \"confidence\": \"high\" if accepted >= 8 else (\"low\" if accepted else \"none\"),\n        }\n    finally:\n        doc.close()\n\n\nLABEL_RE = re.compile(r\"^(الدرس|الوحدة|المحور|الظاهرة|المفهوم|املفهوم|تعلّم|شارك|تساءل|مشروع)\\b\")\n\n\ndef _wordbag(s: str) -> frozenset:\n    return frozenset(re.findall(r\"[\\u0600-\\u06FF]+\", s))\n\n\ndef _is_echo(cand: str, prev: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True when cand is a reversed duplicate of prev (a bidi artefact).\"\"\"\n    a, b = _wordbag(cand), _wordbag(prev)\n    if not a or not b:\n        return False\n    return a == b\n\n\ndef _preceding_title(lines: list[str], j: int) -> Optional[str]:\n    \"\"\"\n    The lesson title for the number at lines[j]. Walk back up to two lines,\n    skipping reversed-duplicate echoes and bare labels like \"الدرس الأوّل:\".\n    \"\"\"\n    for k in (j - 1, j - 2):\n        if k < 0:\n            break\n        cand = lines[k].strip()\n        if not cand or not ARABIC_RE.search(cand):\n            continue\n        if LABEL_RE.match(cand):\n            continue\n        if k - 1 >= 0 and _is_echo(cand, lines[k - 1]):\n            continue\n        title = clean_title(cand)\n        if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n            return title\n    return None\n\n\ndef _entry(printed: int, title: str, offset: int, page_count: int) -> dict:\n    resolved = printed + offset\n    return {\n        \"title\": title,\n        \"printedPage\": printed,\n        \"page\": resolved if 0 < resolved <= page_count else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef _attach(units: list, current: Optional[dict], entry: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Append an entry to the open unit, opening a default one if needed.\"\"\"\n    if current is None:\n        current = {\"unit\": \"المحتوى\", \"lessons\": []}\n        units.append(current)\n    current[\"lessons\"].append(entry)\n    return current\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    import sys\n\n    for p in sys.argv[1:]:\n        r = parse_toc(p)\n        print(f\"\\n=== {p}  offset={r['offset']}  units={len(r['units'])} ===\")\n        for u in r[\"units\"]:\n            print(f\"  {u['unit']}\")\n            for l in u[\"lessons\"][:6]:\n                print(f\"     p{l['printedPage']:>4} (pdf {l['page']})  {l['title']}\")\n",

Two shapes:\n    a dot-leader list, or a contents heading with many bare numerals.\n    \"\"\"\n    hits = []\n    for i in range(min(20, doc.page_count)):\n        t = norm(doc[i].get_text())\n        if \"قائمة المحتوى\" in t or \"المحتويات\" in t or \"قائمة املحتوى\" in t:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        if len(ENTRY_RE.findall(t)) >= 3:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        # Layout B: several lines that are only a page number.\n        bare = sum(\n            1\n            for l in t.split(\"\\n\")\n            if digits(l).strip(\" .-|\").isdigit() and l.strip()\n        )\n        if bare >= 5 and (\"الدرس\" in t or \"الوحدة\" in t):\n            hits.append(i)\n    return hits\n\n\ndef _detect_offset(doc) -> int:\n    \"\"\"\n    Printed page number -> PDF page index offset.\n    Scan pages for a bare number and take the most common difference.\n    \"\"\"\n    diffs = Counter()\n    for i in range(min(60, doc.page_count)):\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\") if l.strip()]\n        # Page numbers usually sit in the first or last couple of lines.\n        for cand in (lines[:2] + lines[-2:]):\n            digits = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", cand).strip(\" .-|\")\n            if digits.isdigit():\n                n = int(digits)\n                if 1 <= n <= doc.page_count:\n                    diffs[i - n] += 1\n    return diffs.most_common(1)[0][0] if diffs else 0\n\n\ndef parse_toc(pdf_path: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    Return {\"offset\": int, \"units\": [...], \"confidence\": str}.\n    Two contents layouts occur and both are handled:\n      A) \"12. . . . . .  title\"          (dot leader — Science, Math)\n      B) \"title\" then \"12\" below it      (Social Studies)\n    These PDFs also emit each heading twice, the second copy word-reversed.\n    Layout B therefore skips echo lines, and a page is only accepted when\n    enough entries survive. A page that yields nothing usable is reported as\n    low confidence rather than guessed at.\n    \"\"\"\n    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)\n    try:\n        offset = _detect_offset(doc)\n        units: list[dict] = []\n        current: Optional[dict] = None\n        accepted = 0\n\n        for i in _toc_pages(doc):\n            lines = [norm(l) for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\")]\n            lines = [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip()]\n            page_entries: list[dict] = []\n            seen: set[tuple] = set()\n\n            for j, line in enumerate(lines):\n                # Layout A\n                m = ENTRY_RE.match(line)\n                if m:\n                    title = clean_title(m.group(2))\n                    if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n                        key = (int(m.group(1)), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(m.group(1)), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n                    continue\n\n                # Layout B: a bare number, title on a preceding line.\n                num = digits(line).strip(\" .-|\")\n                if num.isdigit() and len(num) <= 3:\n                    title = _preceding_title(lines, j)\n                    if title:\n                        key = (int(num), title)\n                        if key not in seen:\n                            seen.add(key)\n                            page_entries.append(_entry(int(num), title, offset, doc.page_count))\n\n            if len(page_entries) >= 4:\n                accepted += len(page_entries)\n                for e in page_entries:\n                    current = _attach(units, current, e)\n\n            # Unit / mahwar headings on any contents page.\n            for line in lines:\n                if UNIT_RE.search(line) and not ENTRY_RE.match(line):\n                    heading = clean_title(\n                        DOT_LEADER_RE.sub(\" \", dedupe_echo_line(line)), reverse=False\n                    )\n                    if 2 <= len(heading) <= 90:\n                        current = {\"unit\": heading, \"lessons\": []}\n                        units.append(current)\n\n        units = [u for u in units if u[\"lessons\"]]\n        return {\n            \"offset\": offset,\n            \"units\": units,\n            \"confidence\": \"high\" if accepted >= 8 else (\"low\" if accepted else \"none\"),\n        }\n    finally:\n        doc.close()\n\n\nLABEL_RE = re.compile(r\"^(الدرس|الوحدة|المحور|الظاهرة|المفهوم|املفهوم|تعلّم|شارك|تساءل|مشروع)\\b\")\n\n\ndef _wordbag(s: str) -> frozenset:\n    return frozenset(re.findall(r\"[\\u0600-\\u06FF]+\", s))\n\n\ndef _is_echo(cand: str, prev: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True when cand is a reversed duplicate of prev (a bidi artefact).\"\"\"\n    a, b = _wordbag(cand), _wordbag(prev)\n    if not a or not b:\n        return False\n    return a == b\n\n\ndef _preceding_title(lines: list[str], j: int) -> Optional[str]:\n    \"\"\"\n    The lesson title for the number at lines[j]. Walk back up to two lines,\n    skipping reversed-duplicate echoes and bare labels like \"الدرس الأوّل:\".\n    \"\"\"\n    for k in (j - 1, j - 2):\n        if k < 0:\n            break\n        cand = lines[k].strip()\n        if not cand or not ARABIC_RE.search(cand):\n            continue\n        if LABEL_RE.match(cand):\n            continue\n        if k - 1 >= 0 and _is_echo(cand, lines[k - 1]):\n            continue\n        title = clean_title(cand)\n        if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n            return title\n    return None\n\n\ndef _entry(printed: int, title: str, offset: int, page_count: int) -> dict:\n    resolved = printed + offset\n    return {\n        \"title\": title,\n        \"printedPage\": printed,\n        \"page\": resolved if 0 < resolved <= page_count else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef _attach(units: list, current: Optional[dict], entry: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Append an entry to the open unit, opening a default one if needed.\"\"\"\n    if current is None:\n        current = {\"unit\": \"المحتوى\", \"lessons\": []}\n        units.append(current)\n    current[\"lessons\"].append(entry)\n    return current\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    import sys\n\n    for p in sys.argv[1:]:\n        r = parse_toc(p)\n        print(f\"\\n=== {p}  offset={r['offset']}  units={len(r['units'])} ===\")\n        for u in r[\"units\"]:\n            print(f\"  {u['unit']}\")\n            for l in u[\"lessons\"][:6]:\n                print(f\"     p{l['printedPage']:>4} (pdf {l['page']})  {l['title']}\")\n",

Walk back up to two lines,\n    skipping reversed-duplicate echoes and bare labels like \"الدرس الأوّل:\".\n    \"\"\"\n    for k in (j - 1, j - 2):\n        if k < 0:\n            break\n        cand = lines[k].strip()\n        if not cand or not ARABIC_RE.search(cand):\n            continue\n        if LABEL_RE.match(cand):\n            continue\n        if k - 1 >= 0 and _is_echo(cand, lines[k - 1]):\n            continue\n        title = clean_title(dedupe_echo_line(cand), reverse=False)\n        if title and re.search(r\"[\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]\", title):\n            return title\n    return None\n\n\ndef _entry(printed: int, title: str, offset: int, page_count: int) -> dict:\n    resolved = printed + offset\n    return {\n        \"title\": title,\n        \"printedPage\": printed,\n        \"page\": resolved if 0 < resolved <= page_count else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef _attach(units: list, current: Optional[dict], entry: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Append an entry to the open unit, opening a default one if needed.\"\"\"\n    if current is None:\n        current = {\"unit\": \"المحتوى\", \"lessons\": []}\n        units.append(current)\n    current[\"lessons\"].append(entry)\n    return current\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    import sys\n\n    for p in sys.argv[1:]:\n        r = parse_toc(p)\n        print(f\"\\n=== {p}  offset={r['offset']}  units={len(r['units'])} ===\")\n        for u in r[\"units\"]:\n            print(f\"  {u['unit']}\")\n            for l in u[\"lessons\"][:6]:\n                print(f\"     p{l['printedPage']:>4} (pdf {l['page']})  {l['title']}\")\n",

A mid-word\n# \"ال\" after one of these is a real article and must be left alone.\nPREFIX_LETTERS = set(\"وفبكلأ\")\n\n\ndef fix_lam_alef(word: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"\n    The lam-alef ligature is stored reversed as \"ال\" instead of \"لا\".\n    Repair only mid-word occurrences, and never a prefixed article\n    (بالمدرسة, والكتاب stay intact).\n    \"\"\"\n    if len(word) < 3 or ARABIC_RE.search(word) is None:\n        return word\n    # Protect a leading definite article, including after a prefix letter.\n    protected = 0\n    if word.startswith(\"ال\"):\n        protected = 2\n    elif len(word) > 2 and word[0] in PREFIX_LETTERS and word[1:3] == \"ال\":\n        protected = 3\n    head, tail = word[:protected], word[protected:]\n    return head + tail.replace(\"ال\", \"لا\")\n\n\ndef clean_title(raw: str, reverse: bool = True) -> str:\n    \"\"\"\n    Reverse defaults to True for dot-leader books, whose lines are stored in\n    visual order. Social Studies' primary lines are already logical, so its\n    caller passes reverse=False.\n    \"\"\"\n    raw = raw.replace(\"\\x03\", \" \").strip()\n    if reverse:\n        raw = fix_visual_order(raw)\n    # A colon that ended up attached to the wrong side after reversal.\n    raw = re.sub(r\"\\s+:\", \":\", raw)\n    raw = re.sub(r\":(\\S)\", r\": \\1\", raw)\n    # Unit headings read \"الوحدة: الأولى …\" once reversed; the colon belongs\n    # after the ordinal: \"الوحدة الأولى: …\".\n    m = re.match(r\"^(الوحدة|المحور)\\s*:\\s*(\\S+)\\s*(.*)$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        rest = f\" {m.group(3)}\" if m.group(3) else \"\"\n        raw = f\"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}:{rest}\"\n    return re.sub(r\"\\s{2,}\", \" \", raw).strip(\" .\")\n\n\ndef _toks(s: str) -> list[str]:\n    return [w.strip(\":\") for w in s.split()]\n\n\ndef dedupe_echo_line(line: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"\n    Some heading lines carry the title twice: once correct and once reversed,\n    run together. When the halves are reverses of each other, keep the one that\n    starts with a unit label.\n    \"\"\"\n    words = line.split()\n    if len(words) < 4 or len(words) % 2:\n        return line\n    h = len(words) // 2\n    if _toks(\" \".join(words[h:])) == list(reversed(_toks(\" \".join(words[:h])))):\n        first, second = \" \".join(words[:h]), \" \".join(words[h:])\n        for cand in (second, first):\n            if re.match(r\"^(الوحدة|المحور|مراجعة)\", cand):\n                return cand\n        return first\n    return line\n\n\n# Arabic letters only — excludes the Arabic-Indic digits, which share the block.\nARABIC_LETTER_RE = re.compile(r\"[\\u0621-\\u064A]\")\n\n\ndef has_title_text(s: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A real title has at least two Arabic letters, not just numerals.\"\"\"\n    return len(ARABIC_LETTER_RE.findall(s)) >= 2\n\n\ndef _toc_pages(doc) -> list[int]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Pages near the front that look like a table of contents. Two shapes:\n    a dot-leader list, or a contents heading with many bare numerals.\n    \"\"\"\n    hits = []\n    for i in range(min(20, doc.page_count)):\n        t = norm(doc[i].get_text())\n        if \"قائمة المحتوى\" in t or \"المحتويات\" in t or \"قائمة املحتوى\" in t:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        if len(ENTRY_RE.findall(t)) >= 3:\n            hits.append(i)\n            continue\n        # Layout B: several lines that are only a page number.\n        bare = sum(\n            1\n            for l in t.split(\"\\n\")\n            if digits(l).strip(\" .-|\").isdigit() and l.strip()\n        )\n        if bare >= 5 and (\"الدرس\" in t or \"الوحدة\" in t):\n            hits.append(i)\n    return hits\n\n\ndef _detect_offset(doc) -> int:\n    \"\"\"\n    Printed page number -> PDF page index offset.\n    Scan pages for a bare number and take the most common difference.\n    \"\"\"\n    diffs = Counter()\n    for i in range(min(60, doc.page_count)):\n        lines = [l.strip() for l in doc[i].get_text().split(\"\\n\") if l.strip()]\n        # Page numbers usually sit in the first or last couple of lines.\n        for cand in (lines[:2] + lines[-2:]):\n            digits = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKC\", cand).strip(\" .-|\")\n            if digits.isdigit():\n                n = int(digits)\n                if 1 <= n <= doc.page_count:\n                    diffs[i - n] += 1\n    return diffs.most_common(1)[0][0] if diffs else 0\n\n\ndef parse_toc(pdf_path: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    Return {\"offset\": int, \"units\": [...], \"confidence\": str}.\n    Two contents layouts occur and both are handled:\n      A) \"12. . . . . .  title\"          (dot leader — Science, Math)\n      B) \"title\" then \"12\" below it      (Social Studies)\n    These PDFs also emit each heading twice, the second copy word-reversed.\n    Layout B therefore skips echo lines, and a page is only accepted when\n    enough entries survive.  "new_content": "\"\"\"Amina curriculum pipeline: ministry PDFs -> light hostable books + real structure.\"\"\"\nimport fitz, io, os, re, json, unicodedata, warnings, base64, urllib.request, time\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageChops\nwarnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n\nWIDTH, QUALITY = 1500, 82\nOUT = 'books'\nENV = '/workspace/project/Amina/.env'\nKEY = re.search(r'GEMINI_API_KEY=(\\S+)', open(ENV).read()).group(1)\n\n# (pdf file, book id, subject, language, term)\nSTUDENT_BOOKS = [\n ('Arabic_G5_-_SB_-_T1.pdf',                     'arabic-g5-t1',      'arabic',       'ar', 1),\n ('Arabic_G5-_SB-T2.pdf',                        'arabic-g5-t2',      'arabic',       'ar', 2),\n ('P5T1_STB_SE_AR_5.8.22.pdf',                   'science-g5-t1-ar',  'science',      'ar', 1),\n ('P5T2_STB_SE_AR.pdf',                          'science-g5-t2-ar',  'science',      'ar', 2),\n ('P5T1_STB_SE_EN_4.8.22.pdf',                   'science-g5-t1-en',  'science',      'en', 1),\n ('P5T2_STB_SE_EN.pdf',                          'science-g5-t2-en',  'science',      'en', 2),\n ('P5T1_MTB_SE_AR_4.8.22.pdf',                   'math-g5-t1-ar',     'math',         'ar', 1),\n ('P5T1_MTB_SE_EN_4.8.22.pdf',                   'math-g5-t1-en',     'math',         'en', 1),\n ('drasat_5prim_T1.pdf',                         'social-g5-t1',      'social',       'ar', 1),\n ('Egypt-York-NGL-CS-Ar-TB-Gr.5-Term_2_Low_Secured.pdf','social-g5-t2','social',      'ar', 2),\n ('Connect_5Prim.pdf',                           'english-g5-t1',     'english',      'en', 1),\n ('Egy-Connect-Prim-En-G5-SB-T2-Low-secured.pdf','english-g5-t2',     'english',      'en', 2),\n ('Egypt-York-NGL-ICT-AR-SB-Gr.5-Term_1.pdf',    'ict-g5-t1-ar',      'ict',          'ar', 1),\n ('Egypt-York-NGL-ICT-AR-SB-Gr.5-T2.pdf',        'ict-g5-t2-ar',      'ict',          'ar', 2),\n ('Egypt-York-NGL-ICT-EN-SB-Gr.5-T2.pdf',        'ict-g5-t2-en',      'ict',          'en', 2),\n ('computer_prim5_t1_E.pdf',                     'ict-g5-t1-en',      'ict',          'en', 1),\n ('Islamy_G5_-_SB_-_T1.pdf',                     'islamic-g5-t1',     'islamic',      'ar', 1),\n ('Islamic_G5-T2-SB.pdf',                        'islamic-g5-t2',     'islamic',      'ar', 2),\n ('Christian_G5_-_SB_-_T1.pdf',                  'christian-g5-t1',   'christian',    'ar', 1),\n ('cristian_G5-sb-T2.pdf',                       'christian-g5-t2',   'christian',    'ar', 2),\n ('moral_5prim_t1__SB.pdf',                      'morals-g5-t1',      'morals',       'ar', 1),\n ('moral_5prim_t2__SB.pdf',                      'morals-g5-t2',      'morals',       'ar', 2),\n ('professional_skills_5prime_t1.pdf',           'profskills-g5-t1',  'profskills',   'ar', 1),\n ('Arabic_Calligraphy_G5_FINAL.pdf',             'calligraphy-g5',    'calligraphy',  'ar', 1),\n]\n\ndef clean(t):\n    t = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', t)\n    t = re.sub(r'[\\x00-\\x08\\x0b\\x0c\\x0e-\\x1f]', ' ', t)\n    t = re.sub(r'[\\u064B-\\u065F\\u0670\\u06D6-\\u06ED]', '', t)\n    return re.sub(r'\\u0640', '', t)\n\ndef crop_white(im, tol=248):\n    bg = Image.new('RGB', im.size, (255, 255, 255))\n    diff = ImageChops.difference(im, bg).convert('L').point(lambda p: 255 if p < tol else 0)\n    bbox = diff.getbbox()\n    if not bbox: return im\n    l, t, r, b = bbox; pad = 8\n    return im.crop((max(0,l-pad), max(0,t-pad), min(im.width,r+pad), min(im.height,b+pad)))\n\ndef render(page, width=WIDTH):\n    z = width / page.rect.width\n    pm = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(z, z), colorspace=fitz.csRGB)\n    im = Image.frombytes('RGB', (pm.width, pm.height), pm.samples)\n    try: im = crop_white(im)\n    except Exception: pass\n    return im\n\ndef vision(img_b64, prompt, model='gemini-2.5-flash', tries=4):\n    \"\"\"Vision call with real retry/backoff. Returns (text, err).\"\"\"\n    payload = {\"contents\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"parts\":[{\"text\":prompt},\n        {\"inlineData\":{\"mimeType\":\"image/jpeg\",\"data\":img_b64}}]}],\n        \"generationConfig\":{\"temperature\":0,\"responseMimeType\":\"application/json\"}}\n    delay = 8\n    for a in range(tries):\n        try:\n            req = urllib.request.Request(\n                f\"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent\",\n                data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),\n                headers={\"x-goog-api-key\":KEY,\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\"})\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:\n                j = json.loads(r.read())\n            if 'error' in j:\n                raise RuntimeError(j['error'].get('message', str(j['error']))[:150])\n            return j['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'], None\n        except Exception as e:\n            msg = str(e)\n            if a == tries - 1:\n                return None, msg[:200]\n            time.sleep(delay)\n            delay = min(delay * 2, 60)\n    return None, 'exhausted'\n\nTOC_PROMPT = ('This is a page from an Egyptian Grade 5 school book. If it is a table of '\n  'contents (or contains unit/lesson lists), extract it as JSON: '\n  '{\"units\":[{\"unit\":\"...\",\"lessons\":[{\"title\":\"...\",\"page\":N}]}]}. '\n  'Use the exact printed titles in the book language. Use null for a missing page. '\n  'If this page has no table of contents, return {\"units\":[]}. Return JSON only.')\n\ndef extract_structure(pdf, lang, scan=(2, 3, 4, 5)):\n    \"\"\"\n    Structure comes from the book's own text layer, which is deterministic and\n    costs nothing. The vision model is only a last resort, because the API is\n    quota-limited and a quota failure must never block a book.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        from toc import parse_toc\n        r = parse_toc(pdf)\n        if r[\"units\"] and r[\"confidence\"] in (\"high\", \"low\"):\n            return r[\"units\"], 0, None\n    except Exception as e:\n        pass\n\n    # Fallback: vision, only if the text layer yielded nothing.\n    d = fitz.open(pdf)\n    found, scanned, last_err = [], 0, None\n    for pi in scan:\n        if pi >= d.page_count or found: continue\n        z = 1300 / d[pi].rect.width\n        pm = d[pi].get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(z, z), colorspace=fitz.csRGB)\n        im = Image.frombytes('RGB', (pm.width, pm.height), pm.samples)\n        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=85)\n        scanned += 1\n        out, err = vision(base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode(), TOC_PROMPT)\n        if err:\n            last_err = err\n            if '429' in err or 'Too Many' in err:\n                break          # rate limited: stop scanning, report it\n            continue\n        try:\n            j = json.loads(out)\n            if j.get('units'):\n                found = j['units']\n                break\n        except Exception as e:\n            last_err = str(e)[:150]\n    d.close()\n    return found, scanned, last_err\n\ndef convert(pdf, bid, subject, lang, term, do_structure=False):\n    doc = fitz.open(pdf)\n    bdir = os.path.join(OUT, bid); pdir = os.path.join(bdir, 'pages')\n    os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)\n    m = {'id': bid, 'subject': subject, 'language': lang, 'term': term,\n         'source': os.path.basename(pdf), 'pages': doc.page_count,\n         'width': WIDTH, 'quality': QUALITY, 'index': []}\n    total = 0\n    for i in range(doc.page_count):\n        im = render(doc[i])\n        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, 'WEBP', quality=QUALITY, method=6)\n        data = b.getvalue(); total += len(data)\n        fn = f'{i+1:04d}.webp'\n        open(os.path.join(pdir, fn), 'wb').write(data)\n        m['index'].append({'p': i+1, 'f': fn, 'w': im.width, 'h': im.height,\n                           'kb': round(len(data)/1024)})\n    m['bytes'] = total\n    if do_structure:\n        units, scanned, err = extract_structure(pdf, lang)\n        m['units'] = units; m['tocScanned'] = scanned\n        m['structureStatus'] = 'ok' if units else ('failed' if err else 'not_found')\n        if err: m['structureError'] = err\n    doc.close()\n    json.dump(m, open(os.path.join(bdir,'manifest.json'),'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n    return m\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    import sys\n    only = sys.argv[1:] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    for pdf, bid, subj, lang, term in STUDENT_BOOKS:\n        if only and bid not in only: continue\n        if not os.path.exists(f'pdfs/{pdf}'):\n            print(f'MISSING {pdf}', flush=True); continue\n        try:\n            m = convert(f'pdfs/{pdf}', bid, subj, lang, term)\n            print(f\"{bid:22s} {m['pages']:4d}p {m['bytes']/1024/1024:6.1f}MB \"\n                  f\"units={len(m.get('units',[]))} {m.get('structureStatus')}\"\n                  f\"{' ' + str(m.get('structureError'))[:60] if m.get('structureError') else ''}\",\n                  flush=True)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f'{bid} FAILED {e}', flush=True)\n    print('PIPELINE DONE', flush=True)\n",
 "kind": "FileEditorObservation"
}

l.titleAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.titleEn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.titleFr && l.titleFr.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||\n          l.subjectNameAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.sourceRef.bookAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.readingText && l.readingText.toLowerCase().includes(q))\n      );\n    }\n 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                  : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? `جميع المواد (${officialLessons.length} درساً)` : `All Subjects (${officialLessons.length})`}\n            </button>\n\n            {officialSubjectsSummary.map((s) => {\n              const isSelected = selectedSubjectId === s.subjectId;\n\n              return (\n                <button\n                  key={s.subjectId}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => setSelectedSubjectId(s.subjectId)}\n                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${\n                    isSelected\n                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{s.icon}</span>\n                  <span>{isAr ? s.badgeAr : s.badgeEn}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Lessons List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {filteredOfficialLessons.map((lesson) => (\n              <div\n                key={lesson.id}\n                className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                        {isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                  />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveStudyLesson(lesson)}\n                    className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ? 'عرض تفاصيل الدرس' : 'View Lesson'}</span>\n                    <span>←</span>\n                  </button>\n\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveTeachingLessonId(lesson.id)}\n                    className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>👩‍🏫 {isAr ? (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <HomeworkRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onClose={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <QuizRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onExplainDifferently={() => {\n                  setActivePracticeMission(null);\n                  if (activePracticeMission.lessonId) setActiveTeachingLessonId(activePracticeMission.lessonId);\n                }}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport { OfficialCurriculumLesson } from Clock,\n  Check,\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\nimport { BookReader } from './BookReader';\nimport { listBooks, downloadedBookIds, type BookSummary } from 'off_mathfr_u1_l1_decimaux': true,\n    'off_sci_u1_l1_plant_needs': true,\n    'off_scifr_u1_l1_plantes': true,\n  });\n\n  const [activeTeachingLessonId, setActiveTeachingLessonId] = useState<string l.titleAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.titleEn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.titleFr && l.titleFr.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||\n          l.subjectNameAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          l.sourceRef.bookAr.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n          (l.readingText && l.readingText.toLowerCase().includes(q))\n      );\n    }\n    return list;\n  }, [officialLessons, selectedSubjectId, searchQuery]);\n\n  // Group lessons of current selected subject by unit\n  const activeSubjectUnits = useMemo(() => {\n    if ({officialSubjectsSummary.length} كتب معتمدة)\n              </span>\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Book Cards Grid */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3\">\n            {officialSubjectsSummary.map((b) => (\n              <div\n                key={b.subjectId}\n                onClick={() => {\n           >\n                {/* Book Spine / Cover Header */}\n                <div className={`p-3 bg-linear-to-br ${b.bgGradient} text-white space-y-1 relative`}>\n                  <div </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs\">\n                      {b.termLabel}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black leading-tight pt-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.subjectNameAr : isFr && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : 'كتاب رسمي معتمد' : 'Official Ministry Book'}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 pt-1\">\n              <span className=\"text-3xl\">{selectedBookForDetail.icon}</span>\n              <div>\n                <h3 className=\"text-base font-black\">\n                  {isAr ? selectedBookForDetail.subjectNameAr : isFr && selectedBookForDetail.subjectNameFr ? selectedBookForDetail.subjectNameFr : selectedBookForDetail.subjectNameEn}\n                </h3>\n                <p className=\"text-xs text-white/90\">\n                  {isAr ? selectedBookForDetail.bookTitleAr : selectedBookForDetail.bookTitleEn}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Real source link: open the official book/portal, not a fabricated in-app copy */}\n            <a\n              href={curriculumService.getLessonResourceUrl(\n                curriculumService.getLessonsBySubject(selectedBookForDetail.subjectId)[0]?.id || ''\n              ) || CurriculumService.RESOURCE_PORTALS.ministryOfEducation}\n              target=\"_blank\"\n              rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\n              className=\"mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white text-[11px] font-bold transition-all\"\n            >\n              <ExternalLink className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n              <span>{isAr ? 'المصدر الرسمي للكتاب (بنك المعرفة المصري)' : 'Official book source (Egyptian Knowledge Bank)'}</span>\n            </a>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Units Navigation for this book */}\n          {activeSubjectUnits && (\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n              {activeSubjectUnits.map((u) => (\n                <div\n                  key={u.unitNumber}\n                  className=\"rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs overflow-hidden\"\n                >\n                  {/* Unit Title Header */}\n                  <div className=\"p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-750 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <span className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center\">\n                        {u.unitNumber}\n                      </span>\n                      <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                        {isAr ? u.unitNameAr : isFr && u.unitNameFr ? u.unitNameFr : u.unitNameEn}\n                      </h4>\n                    </div>\n                    <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold\">\n                      {u.lessons.length} {isAr ? 'دروس' : 'lessons'}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Lessons list inside unit */}\n                  <div className=\"p-2.5 space-y-2\">\n                    {u.lessons.map((lesson) => {\n                      const isExpanded = Boolean(expandedLessons[lesson.id]);\n\n                      return (\n                        <div\n                          key={lesson.id}\n                          className=\"rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-3 space-y-2\"\n                        >\n                          {/* Lesson Head */}\n                          <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                            <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                                <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                                  {isAr ? `الدرس ${lesson.lessonNumber}` : `Lesson ${lesson.lessonNumber}`}\n                                </span>\n                                {lesson.contentStatus === 'pending_materials' ? (\n                                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200\">\n                                    ⏳ {isAr ? 'قيد رفع مواد الوزارة' : 'Materials Pending'}\n                                  </span>\n                                ) : (\n                                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200\">\n                                    ✓ {isAr ? 'كامل التمارين والأهداف' : 'Complete'}\n                                  </span>\n                                )}\n                              </div>\n\n                              <h5 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                                {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : isFr && lesson.titleFr ? lesson.titleFr : lesson.titleEn}\n                              </h5>\n                              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                                {isAr ? lesson.sourceRef.bookAr : lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}\n                              </p>\n                            </div>\n\n                            {/* Save/Like & Toggle */}\n                            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n                              <SaveLikeButton\n                                sourceId={lesson.id}\n                                type=\"lesson\"\n                                title={isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                                subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                                snippet={lesson.readingText?.slice(0, 100) || undefined}\n                              />\n                              <button\n                                type=\"button\"\n                                onClick={() => toggleLesson(lesson.id)}\n                                className=\"p-1 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600\"\n                              >\n                                {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n                              </button>\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n\n                          {/* Expanded Lesson View */}\n                          {isExpanded && (\n                            <div className=\"pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60 space-y-3\">\n                              {/* Learning Objectives */}\n                              {lesson.objectives && lesson.objectives.length > 0 && (\n                                <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-750 text-[11px] space-y-1\">\n                                  <span className=\"font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 block text-[10px]\">\n                                    🎯 {isAr ? 'أهداف التعلم الوزارية:' : 'Learning Objectives:'}\n                                  </span>\n                                  <ul className=\"list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px]\">\n                                    {lesson.objectives.map((obj, oIdx) => (\n                                      <li key={oIdx}>{obj}</li>\n                                    ))}\n                                  </ul>\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n\n                              {/* Reading Text Preview if available */}\n                              {lesson.readingText && (\n                                <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50/50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40 text-[11px] space-y-1 text-right rtl:text-right\">\n                                  <span className=\"font-bold text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 block text-[10px]\">\n                                    📖 {isAr ? 'نص الدرس من كتاب الوزارة:' : 'Textbook Passage:'}\n                                  </span>\n                                  <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3\">\n                                    {lesson.readingText}\n                                  </p>\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n\n                              {/* Supplementary Learning Resources (Clearly marked as supplementary, NOT official) */}\n                              {lesson.supplementaryResources && lesson.supplementaryResources.length > 0 && (\n                                <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-900/40 space-y-1.5\">\n                                  <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1\">\n                                    <span>📘</span>\n                                    <span>{isAr ? 'مصادر خارجية داعمة (تمارين وإثراء):' : 'Supplementary Learning Resources:'}</span>\n                                  </span>\n                                  <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                                    {lesson.supplementaryResources.map((supp) => (\n                                      <div\n                                        key={supp.id}\n                                        className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900\"\n                                      >\n                                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                                          <Badge variant=\"demo\">{supp.sourceType === 'al_adwaa' ? 'الأضواء' : 'سلاح التلميذ'}</Badge>\n                                          <span className=\"font-semibold\">{isAr ? supp.sourceNameAr : supp.sourceNameEn}</span>\n                                        </div>\n                                        {supp.page && <span className=\"text-slate-400\">صـ {supp.page}</span>}\n                                      </div>\n                                    ))}\n                                  </div>\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n\n                              {/* 4 Interactive Modalities for this Lesson */}\n                              <div className=\"grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 pt-1\">\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => {\n                                    setSelectedCurriculumLessonId(lesson.id);\n                                    setCompanionContext({\n                                      source: 'lesson',\n                                      lessonId: lesson.id,\n                                      topic: isAr ? lesson.titleAr : isFr && lesson.titleFr ? lesson.titleFr : lesson.titleEn,\n                                    });\n                                    setActiveTab('companion');\n                                  }}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-[10px] shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>👩‍🏫</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'اشرحي لي يا مس نور' : 'Learn with Nour'}</span>\n                                </button>\n\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => handleLaunchPracticeQuiz(lesson)}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black text-[10px] shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>🎯</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'تدريبات واختبار' : 'Practice Quiz'}</span>\n                                </button>\n\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => handleLaunchHomework(lesson)}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-black text-[10px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>✍️</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'حل الواجب' : 'Homework'}</span>\n                                </button>\n                              </div>\n                            </div>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      );\n                    })}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* 5. UNITS & LESSONS FLAT VIEW (When user clicks \"Units & Lessons\" tab or searches) */}\n      {(activeViewMode === 'units' || searchQuery) && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {/* Subject Filter Pills */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setSelectedSubjectId('all')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer ${\n                selectedSubjectId === 'all'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                  : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? `جميع المواد (${officialLessons.length} درساً)` : `All Subjects (${officialLessons.length})`}\n            </button>\n\n            {officialSubjectsSummary.map((s) => {\n              const isSelected = selectedSubjectId === s.subjectId;\n\n              return (\n                <button\n                  key={s.subjectId}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => setSelectedSubjectId(s.subjectId)}\n                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${\n                    isSelected\n                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{s.icon}</span>\n                  <span>{isAr ? s.badgeAr : s.badgeEn}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Lessons List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {filteredOfficialLessons.map((lesson) => (\n              <div\n                key={lesson.id}\n                className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                        {isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.titleAr : isFr && lesson.titleFr ? lesson.titleFr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    </h4>\n                    <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                      {isAr ? lesson.sourceRef.bookAr : lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}\n                    </p>\n                  </div>\n\n                  <SaveLikeButton\n                    sourceId={lesson.id}\n                    type=\"lesson\"\n                    title={isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn}\n                    subject={isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                  />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60\">\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveStudyLesson(lesson)}\n                    className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>{isAr ? 'عرض تفاصيل الدرس' : 'View Lesson'}</span>\n                    <span>←</span>\n                  </button>\n\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => setActiveTeachingLessonId(lesson.id)}\n                    className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1\"\n                  >\n                    <span>👩‍🏫 {isAr ? 'اشرحي يا مس نور' : 'Teach with Nour'}</span>\n                  </button>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Full Modal Runners */}\n      {activeTeachingLessonId && (\n        <TeachingSessionModal\n          lessonId={activeTeachingLessonId}\n          onClose={() => setActiveTeachingLessonId(null)}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {activeStudyLesson && (\n        <LessonStudyModal\n          lesson={activeStudyLesson}\n          onClose={() => setActiveStudyLesson(null)}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {activePracticeMission && (\n        activePracticeMission.type === 'homework' ? (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <HomeworkRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onClose={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-3\">\n            <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl h-[88vh] overflow-hidden\">\n              <QuizRunner\n                mission={activePracticeMission}\n                onComplete={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onSkip={() => setActivePracticeMission(null)}\n                onExplainDifferently={() => {\n                  setActivePracticeMission(null);\n                  if (activePracticeMission.lessonId) setActiveTeachingLessonId(activePracticeMission.lessonId);\n                }}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",

'تدريبات واختبار' : 'Practice Quiz'}</span>\n                                </button>\n\n                                <button\n                                  type=\"button\"\n                                  onClick={() => handleLaunchHomework(lesson)}\n                                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-black text-[10px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                                >\n                                  <span>✍️</span>\n                                  <span>{isAr ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{s.icon}</span>\n                  <span>{isAr ? s.badgeAr : s.badgeEn}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Lessons List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {filteredOfficialLessons.map((lesson) => (\n              <div\n                key={lesson.id}\n                className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                        {isAr ? lesson.subjectNameAr : lesson.subjectNameEn}\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                        {isAr ? `الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}` : `Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}`}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                      {isAr ? 'off_mathfr_u1_l1_decimaux': true,\n    'off_sci_u1_l1_plant_needs': true,\n    'off_scifr_u1_l1_plantes': true,\n  });\n\n  const [activeTeachingLessonId, setActiveTeachingLessonId] = useState<string ({officialSubjectsSummary.length} كتب معتمدة)\n              </span>\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Book Cards Grid */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3\">\n            {officialSubjectsSummary.map((b) => (\n              <div\n                key={b.subjectId}\n                onClick={() => {\n           >\n                {/* Book Spine / Cover Header */}\n                <div className={`p-3 bg-linear-to-br ${b.bgGradient} text-white space-y-1 relative`}>\n                  <div </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs\">\n                      {b.termLabel}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black leading-tight pt-1\">\n                    {isAr ? b.subjectNameAr : isFr && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : </p>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Book Meta & Action */}\n                <div className=\"p-2.5 text-xs space-y-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center 'دروس' : 'lessons'}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Lessons list inside unit */}\n                  <div className=\"p-2.5 space-y-2\">\n                    {u.lessons.map((lesson) => {\n                      const isExpanded = Boolean(expandedLessons[lesson.id]);\n\n                      return (\n                        <div\n                          key={lesson.id}\n                          className=\"rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-3 space-y-2\"\n                        >\n                          {/* Lesson Head */}\n                          <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                            <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-0.5\">\n                              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                                <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                                  {isAr ? `الدرس ${lesson.lessonNumber}` : `Lesson ${lesson.lessonNumber}`}\n                                </span>\n                                {lesson.contentStatus === 'pending_materials' ? (\n                                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200\">\n                                    ⏳ {isAr ? 'قيد رفع مواد الوزارة' : 'Materials Pending'}\n                                  </span>\n                                ) : (\n                                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200\">\n                                    ✓ {isAr ? 'كامل التمارين والأهداف' : 'Complete'}\n                                  </span>\n                                )}\n                              </div>\n\n                              <h5 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                                {isAr ?
