'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  Mission,\n  DayRecord,\n  Timetable,\n  MasteryRecord,\n  Student,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  SchoolDayKey,\n  Language,\n  ParentPreferences,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { normalizeSubjectId, getSubjectDisplayName } from '../curriculum/subjectIdentity';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { getDueReviewConcepts } from '../review/spacedReviewScheduler';\nimport { getDailyPacingPlan } from '../pacing/academicPacing';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsParams {\n  student?: Student | null;\n  dayRecord?: DayRecord | null;\n  timetable?: Timetable | null;\n  masteryRecords: Record<string, MasteryRecord>;\n  availableMinutes?: number;\n  sessionHistoryCount?: number;\n  fatigueSignal?: boolean;\n  date?: string; // YYYY-MM-DD\n  language?: Language;\n  parentPreferences?: ParentPreferences | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsResult {\n  missions: Mission[];\n  explanation: {\n    droppedCount: number;\n    droppedMessage?: string;\n    isMinimumViableDay: boolean;\n    usedTimetableFallback: boolean;\n    totalEstimatedMinutes: number;\n    budgetMinutes: number;\n    parentOverrideApplied?: boolean;\n    parentOverrideMessage?: string;\n    needsSchoolInformation?: boolean;\n    emptyReason?: string;\n  };\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET = 45;\nconst MAX_MISSIONS_CAP = 6;\nconst MAX_MISSION_MINUTES = 20;\n\n/**\n * Maps subject strings across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject IDs.\n * Delegates to the shared canonical resolver so every engine agrees.\n */\nconst normalizeSubject = normalizeSubjectId;\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction findConceptsForSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  topicText: string = '',\n  flatConcepts: FlatCurriculumConcept[]\n): FlatCurriculumConcept[] {\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (!topicText || subjectConcepts.length === 0) return subjectConcepts;\n\n  const words = topicText.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n  const matched = subjectConcepts.filter((c) => {\n    const textAr = (c.nameAr + ' ' + (c.descriptionAr || '')).toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = (c.nameEn + ' ' + (c.descriptionEn || '')).toLowerCase();\n    return words.some((w) => textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w));\n  });\n\n  return matched.length > 0 ? matched : subjectConcepts;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled daily mission planner.\n * Follows exact priority ordering:\n *  a. Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n *  b. Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n *  c. Concepts flagged needs_review\n *  d. Due-for-spaced-review concepts (stub)\n *  e. General practice for weakest subject\n */\nexport function planDailyMissions(params: PlanMissionsParams): PlanMissionsResult {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecord,\n    timetable,\n    masteryRecords,\n    availableMinutes,\n    fatigueSignal = false,\n    date = localDateStr(),\n    language = 'ar',\n    parentPreferences,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (!student || !student.id) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: 0,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'no_student',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لا يوجد ملف طالب نشط حالياً. يرجى إعداد الملف للبدء.'\n          : 'No active student profile found. Please complete onboarding first.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n\n  let parentOverrideApplied = false;\n  let parentOverrideMessage: string | undefined;\n\n  // 1. Determine Time Budget\n  // Default is 45 min, or student declared. If fatigue signal is high, adjust downward.\n  let declaredBudget = availableMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET;\n  if (declaredBudget < 5) declaredBudget = 10; // minimum sensible budget\n\n  // Check parent override on daily study budget\n  if (parentPreferences?.maxDailyStudyMinutes && parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes < declaredBudget) {\n    declaredBudget = parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes;\n    parentOverrideApplied = true;\n    parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n      ? `تم تعديل وقت المذاكرة اليومي إلى (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} دقيقة) وفقاً للحد المحدد مع ولي الأمر لضمان راحة متوازنة.`\n      : `Daily study time adjusted to (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} min) per parent settings to ensure healthy rest.`;\n  }\n\n  if (fatigueSignal) {\n    declaredBudget = Math.max(15, Math.floor(declaredBudget * 0.75));\n  }\n\n  // Check parent bedtime constraint\n  let nearBedtime = false;\n  if (parentPreferences?.bedtimeLimit) {\n    try {\n      const [bHour, bMin] = parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit.split(':').map(Number);\n      const now = new Date();\n      const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();\n      const bedtimeMinutes = bHour * 60 + (bMin || 0);\n      if (bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes <= 45 && bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes > -60) {\n        nearBedtime = true;\n        parentOverrideApplied = true;\n        parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n          ? `اقترب موعد النوم المحدد مع ولي الأمر (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). تم تقليص الخطة لمهمة واحدة سريعة لمساعدتك على النوم مبكراً.`\n          : `Approaching bedtime set by parent (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). Tasks limited to a single quick mission.`;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore time parse issues\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Failure path A: No time today / under 15 minutes or near bedtime → Offer \"minimum viable day\": ONE mission of 5-10 min\n  const isMinimumViableDay = declaredBudget <= 15 || nearBedtime;\n\n  const candidatePool: Array<{\n    mission: Mission;\n    priorityWeight: number; // Higher number = higher priority\n  }> = [];\n\n  const usedConceptIds = new Set<string>();\n\n  // The year calendar is itself a learning signal. On a date inside a term it\n  // names the lesson each subject is on, so \"what should I study today?\" has a\n  // real answer even on a fresh install with nothing logged yet.\n  const pacingPlan = getDailyPacingPlan(date);\n  const pacedLessonIds = new Set<string>();\n  pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry) => {\n    if (entry.lesson) pacedLessonIds.add(entry.lesson.id);\n  });\n\n  // Determine subjects active today\n  let activeSubjectIds: string[] = [];\n  let usedTimetableFallback = false;\n\n  const isConfirmedDay = Boolean(dayRecord && dayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  if (dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered && dayRecord.lessonsCovered.length > 0) {\n    // Collect from today's recorded lessons (confirmed or student-logged)\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(l.subject);\n      if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Fallback to timetable if no confirmed day record or no subjects identified\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && timetable) {\n    usedTimetableFallback = true;\n    const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n    const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n      0: 'sunday',\n      1: 'monday',\n      2: 'tuesday',\n      3: 'wednesday',\n      4: 'thursday',\n    };\n    const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n    const daySched = todayKey ? timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n    if (daySched) {\n      daySched.periods.forEach((p) => {\n        if (!p.isBreak) {\n          const sId = normalizeSubject(p.subject);\n          if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Identify subjects with due reviews or low mastery\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    const dueReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, { language });\n    for (const r of dueReviews) {\n      const c = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === r.conceptId);\n      if (c && !activeSubjectIds.includes(c.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(c.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Fall back to the year calendar. This is what makes the app teacher-like on\n  // a day with nothing logged: the pacing plan already knows which lesson each\n  // subject is on, so it can still name today's work.\n  const usedPacingFallback = activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && pacingPlan.dueToday.length > 0;\n  if (usedPacingFallback) {\n    pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry) => {\n      if (!activeSubjectIds.includes(entry.subjectId)) activeSubjectIds.push(entry.subjectId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // If no reliable learning signal exists (no confirmed day record, no timetable for today, no due reviews, no mastery history):\n  // Safe fallback: Return explicit safe onboarding / needs-school-info state without fabricating priorities!\n  const hasLearningSignal =\n    (isConfirmedDay && ((dayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.length || 0) > 0 || (dayRecord?.homeworkAssigned?.length || 0) > 0)) ||\n    usedTimetableFallback ||\n    usedPacingFallback ||\n    activeSubjectIds.length > 0 ||\n    Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0;\n\n  if (!hasLearningSignal) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم يتم تسجيل يوم مدرسي أو جدول حصص بعد. سجلي ما تم دراسته اليوم في المدرسة لنضع لكِ خطة مذاكرة ذكية ودقيقة!'\n          : 'No school day record or timetable yet. Please log today\\'s school lessons so we can build your personalized learning plan!',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Existing mastery is a learning signal only for the subjects represented by\n  // those authoritative concepts. Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم نتمكن من تحديد مادة دراسية موثوقة لهذا اليوم. سجلي ما تم دراسته أو جدول الحصص لنضع خطة دقيقة.'\n          : 'No reliable subject is available for today. Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A2: The lesson the year calendar says this subject is on today.\n  // Ranked just below logged homework, above generic practice, so today's real\n  // lesson surfaces even when nothing has been logged yet.\n  pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry, idx) => {\n    const lesson = entry.lesson;\n    if (!lesson) return;\n    if (usedConceptIds.size > 0 && candidatePool.some((c) => c.mission.lessonId === lesson.id)) return;\n\n    const subjectConcept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.lessonId === lesson.id);\n    const conceptId = subjectConcept?.id;\n    if (conceptId && usedConceptIds.has(conceptId)) return;\n    if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(entry.subjectId, language);\n    const mastery = conceptId ? masteryRecords[conceptId] : undefined;\n    const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n    const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n    const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n    const lessonTitle = isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 900 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_pace_${date}_${lesson.id}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: subjName,\n        lessonId: lesson.id,\n        conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `درس اليوم: ${lessonTitle}` : `Today's lesson: ${lessonTitle}`,\n        type: missionType,\n        estimatedMinutes: missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 12 : 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `وفقاً لخطة المنهج السنوية، هذا هو الدرس المقرر اليوم في ${subjName} (الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}).`\n          : `Per the year curriculum plan, this is today's scheduled lesson in ${subjName} (Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}).`,\n        originTag: 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'فهم الدرس والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب'\n          : 'Understand the lesson and pass the comprehension check',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY B: Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered?.length > 0) {\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((les, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(les.subject);\n      if (!sId) return;\n\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, les.topic || '', flatConcepts);\n      // Find concept with lowest mastery or unstarted\n      let candidate = matched.find((c) => !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (!candidate && matched.length > 0) candidate = matched[0];\n\n      if (candidate) {\n        usedConceptIds.add(candidate.id);\n        const mastery = masteryRecords[candidate.id];\n        const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n\n        const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n        const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم نتمكن من تحديد مادة دراسية موثوقة لهذا اليوم. سجلي ما تم دراسته أو جدول الحصص لنضع خطة دقيقة.'\n          : 'No reliable subject is available for today. Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A2: The lesson the year calendar says this subject is on today.\n  // Ranked just below logged homework, above generic practice, so today's real\n  // lesson surfaces even when nothing has been logged yet.\n  pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry, idx) => {\n    const lesson = entry.lesson;\n    if (!lesson) return;\n    if (usedConceptIds.size > 0 && candidatePool.some((c) => c.mission.lessonId === lesson.id)) return;\n\n    const subjectConcept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.lessonId === lesson.id);\n    const conceptId = subjectConcept?.id;\n    if (conceptId && usedConceptIds.has(conceptId)) return;\n    if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(entry.subjectId, language);\n    const mastery = conceptId ? masteryRecords[conceptId] : undefined;\n    const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n    const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n    const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n    const lessonTitle = isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 900 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_pace_${date}_${lesson.id}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: subjName,\n        lessonId: lesson.id,\n        conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `درس اليوم: ${lessonTitle}` : `Today's lesson: ${lessonTitle}`,\n        type: missionType,\n        estimatedMinutes: missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 12 : 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `وفقاً لخطة المنهج السنوية، هذا هو الدرس المقرر اليوم في ${subjName} (الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}).`\n          : `Per the year curriculum plan, this is today's scheduled lesson in ${subjName} (Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}).`,\n        originTag: 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'فهم الدرس والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب'\n          : 'Understand the lesson and pass the comprehension check',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY B: Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered?.length > 0) {\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((les, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(les.subject);\n      if (!sId) return;\n\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, les.topic || '', flatConcepts);\n      // Find concept with lowest mastery or unstarted\n      let candidate = matched.find((c) => !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (!candidate && matched.length > 0) candidate = matched[0];\n\n      if (candidate) {\n        usedConceptIds.add(candidate.id);\n        const mastery = masteryRecords[candidate.id];\n        const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n\n        const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n        const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'مشاهدة الشرح والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب السريع'\n              : 'Watch explanation and pass quick check',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY C: Concepts flagged needs_review (from Phase 4 mastery records)\n  flatConcepts.forEach((concept) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(concept.id)) return;\n    const rec = masteryRecords[concept.id];\n    if (!rec) return;\n\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review') {\n      usedConceptIds.add(concept.id);\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(concept.subjectId, language);\n      const conceptName = isAr ? concept.nameAr : concept.nameEn;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 600,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_review_${date}_${concept.id}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: concept.lessonId,\n          conceptId: concept.id,\n          title: isAr ? `مراجعة داعمة: ${conceptName}` : `Review: ${conceptName}`,\n          type: 'review',\n          estimatedMinutes: 8,\n          whyNow: isAr\n            ? `مفهوم علمي انخفض استيعابه أو يحتاج دعماً إضافياً (${view.compositeLabel}).`\n            : `Concept flagged as needs review based on mastery records (${view.compositeLabel}).`,\n          originTag: concept.origin,\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'الإجابة على أسئلة المراجعة واستعادة الثقة'\n            : 'Answer review questions and restore confidence',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY D: Due-for-spaced-review concepts (Phase 7 Spaced Revision Scheduler)\n  const dueSpacedReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, {\n    currentDate: new Date(),\n    language,\n  });\n\n  dueSpacedReviews.forEach((item, idx) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(item.conceptId)) return;\n    usedConceptIds.add(item.conceptId);\n\n    const conceptMeta = flatConcepts.find((c) => c.id === item.conceptId);\n    const conceptName = isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 450 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_spaced_${date}_${item.conceptId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: item.subjectName,\n        lessonId: conceptMeta?.lessonId,\n        conceptId: item.conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `مراجعة متباعدة: ${conceptName}` : `Spaced Review: ${conceptName}`,\n        type: 'review',\n        estimatedMinutes: 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `حان موعد المراجعة المتباعدة (${item.reason}).`\n          : `Spaced review interval reached (${item.reason}).`,\n        originTag: conceptMeta?.origin || 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  Mission,\n  DayRecord,\n  Timetable,\n  MasteryRecord,\n  Student,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  SchoolDayKey,\n  Language,\n  ParentPreferences,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { normalizeSubjectId, getSubjectDisplayName } from '../curriculum/subjectIdentity';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { getDueReviewConcepts } from '../review/spacedReviewScheduler';\nimport { getDailyPacingPlan } from '../pacing/academicPacing';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsParams {\n  student?: Student | null;\n  dayRecord?: DayRecord | null;\n  timetable?: Timetable | null;\n  masteryRecords: Record<string, MasteryRecord>;\n  availableMinutes?: number;\n  sessionHistoryCount?: number;\n  fatigueSignal?: boolean;\n  date?: string; // YYYY-MM-DD\n  language?: Language;\n  parentPreferences?: ParentPreferences | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsResult {\n  missions: Mission[];\n  explanation: {\n    droppedCount: number;\n    droppedMessage?: string;\n    isMinimumViableDay: boolean;\n    usedTimetableFallback: boolean;\n    totalEstimatedMinutes: number;\n    budgetMinutes: number;\n    parentOverrideApplied?: boolean;\n    parentOverrideMessage?: string;\n    needsSchoolInformation?: boolean;\n    emptyReason?: string;\n  };\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET = 45;\nconst MAX_MISSIONS_CAP = 6;\nconst MAX_MISSION_MINUTES = 20;\n\n/**\n * Maps subject strings across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject IDs.\n * Delegates to the shared canonical resolver so every engine agrees.\n */\nconst normalizeSubject = normalizeSubjectId;\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction findConceptsForSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  topicText: string = '',\n  flatConcepts: FlatCurriculumConcept[]\n): FlatCurriculumConcept[] {\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (!topicText || subjectConcepts.length === 0) return subjectConcepts;\n\n  const words = topicText.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n  const matched = subjectConcepts.filter((c) => {\n    const textAr = (c.nameAr + ' ' + (c.descriptionAr || '')).toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = (c.nameEn + ' ' + (c.descriptionEn || '')).toLowerCase();\n    return words.some((w) => textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w));\n  });\n\n  return matched.length > 0 ? matched : subjectConcepts;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled daily mission planner.\n * Follows exact priority ordering:\n *  a. Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n *  b. Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n *  c. Concepts flagged needs_review\n *  d. Due-for-spaced-review concepts (stub)\n *  e. General practice for weakest subject\n */\nexport function planDailyMissions(params: PlanMissionsParams): PlanMissionsResult {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecord,\n    timetable,\n    masteryRecords,\n    availableMinutes,\n    fatigueSignal = false,\n    date = localDateStr(),\n    language = 'ar',\n    parentPreferences,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (!student || !student.id) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: 0,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'no_student',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لا يوجد ملف طالب نشط حالياً. يرجى إعداد الملف للبدء.'\n          : 'No active student profile found. Please complete onboarding first.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n\n  let parentOverrideApplied = false;\n  let parentOverrideMessage: string | undefined;\n\n  // 1. Determine Time Budget\n  // Default is 45 min, or student declared. If fatigue signal is high, adjust downward.\n  let declaredBudget = availableMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET;\n  if (declaredBudget < 5) declaredBudget = 10; // minimum sensible budget\n\n  // Check parent override on daily study budget\n  if (parentPreferences?.maxDailyStudyMinutes && parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes < declaredBudget) {\n    declaredBudget = parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes;\n    parentOverrideApplied = true;\n    parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n      ? `تم تعديل وقت المذاكرة اليومي إلى (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} دقيقة) وفقاً للحد المحدد مع ولي الأمر لضمان راحة متوازنة.`\n      : `Daily study time adjusted to (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} min) per parent settings to ensure healthy rest.`;\n  }\n\n  if (fatigueSignal) {\n    declaredBudget = Math.max(15, Math.floor(declaredBudget * 0.75));\n  }\n\n  // Check parent bedtime constraint\n  let nearBedtime = false;\n  if (parentPreferences?.bedtimeLimit) {\n    try {\n      const [bHour, bMin] = parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit.split(':').map(Number);\n      const now = new Date();\n      const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();\n      const bedtimeMinutes = bHour * 60 + (bMin || 0);\n      if (bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes <= 45 && bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes > -60) {\n        nearBedtime = true;\n        parentOverrideApplied = true;\n        parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n          ? `اقترب موعد النوم المحدد مع ولي الأمر (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). تم تقليص الخطة لمهمة واحدة سريعة لمساعدتك على النوم مبكراً.`\n          : `Approaching bedtime set by parent (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). Tasks limited to a single quick mission.`;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore time parse issues\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Failure path A: No time today / under 15 minutes or near bedtime → Offer \"minimum viable day\": ONE mission of 5-10 min\n  const isMinimumViableDay = declaredBudget <= 15 || nearBedtime;\n\n  const candidatePool: Array<{\n    mission: Mission;\n    priorityWeight: number; // Higher number = higher priority\n  }> = [];\n\n  const usedConceptIds = new Set<string>();\n\n  // The year calendar is itself a learning signal. On a date inside a term it\n  // names the lesson each subject is on, so \"what should I study today?\" has a\n  // real answer even on a fresh install with nothing logged yet.\n  const pacingPlan = getDailyPacingPlan(date);\n\n  // Determine subjects active today\n  let activeSubjectIds: string[] = [];\n  let usedTimetableFallback = false;\n\n  const isConfirmedDay = Boolean(dayRecord && dayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  if (dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered && dayRecord.lessonsCovered.length > 0) {\n    // Collect from today's recorded lessons (confirmed or student-logged)\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(l.subject);\n      if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Fallback to timetable if no confirmed day record or no subjects identified\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && timetable) {\n    usedTimetableFallback = true;\n    const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n    const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n      0: 'sunday',\n      1: 'monday',\n      2: 'tuesday',\n      3: 'wednesday',\n      4: 'thursday',\n    };\n    const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n    const daySched = todayKey ? timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n    if (daySched) {\n      daySched.periods.forEach((p) => {\n        if (!p.isBreak) {\n          const sId = normalizeSubject(p.subject);\n          if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Identify subjects with due reviews or low mastery\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    const dueReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, { language });\n    for (const r of dueReviews) {\n      const c = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === r.conceptId);\n      if (c && !activeSubjectIds.includes(c.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(c.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Fall back to the year calendar. This is what makes the app teacher-like on\n  // a day with nothing logged: the pacing plan already knows which lesson each\n  // subject is on, so it can still name today's work.\n  const usedPacingFallback = activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && pacingPlan.dueToday.length > 0;\n  if (usedPacingFallback) {\n    pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry) => {\n      if (!activeSubjectIds.includes(entry.subjectId)) activeSubjectIds.push(entry.subjectId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // If no reliable learning signal exists (no confirmed day record, no timetable for today, no due reviews, no mastery history):\n  // Safe fallback: Return explicit safe onboarding / needs-school-info state without fabricating priorities!\n  const hasLearningSignal =\n    (isConfirmedDay && ((dayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.length || 0) > 0 || (dayRecord?.homeworkAssigned?.length || 0) > 0)) ||\n    usedTimetableFallback ||\n    usedPacingFallback ||\n    activeSubjectIds.length > 0 ||\n    Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0;\n\n  if (!hasLearningSignal) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم يتم تسجيل يوم مدرسي أو جدول حصص بعد. سجلي ما تم دراسته اليوم في المدرسة لنضع لكِ خطة مذاكرة ذكية ودقيقة!'\n          : 'No school day record or timetable yet. Please log today\\'s school lessons so we can build your personalized learning plan!',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Existing mastery is a learning signal only for the subjects represented by\n  // those authoritative concepts. Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A2: The lesson the year calendar says this subject is on today.\n  // Ranked just below logged homework, above generic practice, so today's real\n  // lesson surfaces even when nothing has been logged yet.\n  pacingPlan.dueToday.forEach((entry, idx) => {\n    const lesson = entry.lesson;\n    if (!lesson) return;\n    if (usedConceptIds.size > 0 && candidatePool.some((c) => c.mission.lessonId === lesson.id)) return;\n\n    const subjectConcept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.lessonId === lesson.id);\n    const conceptId = subjectConcept?.id;\n    if (conceptId && usedConceptIds.has(conceptId)) return;\n    if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(entry.subjectId, language);\n    const mastery = conceptId ? masteryRecords[conceptId] : undefined;\n    const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n    const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n    const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n    const lessonTitle = isAr ? lesson.titleAr : lesson.titleEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 900 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_pace_${date}_${lesson.id}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: subjName,\n        lessonId: lesson.id,\n        conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `درس اليوم: ${lessonTitle}` : `Today's lesson: ${lessonTitle}`,\n        type: missionType,\n        estimatedMinutes: missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 12 : 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `وفقاً لخطة المنهج السنوية، هذا هو الدرس المقرر اليوم في ${subjName} (الوحدة ${lesson.unitNumber}).`\n          : `Per the year curriculum plan, this is today's scheduled lesson in ${subjName} (Unit ${lesson.unitNumber}).`,\n        originTag: 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'الإجابة على أسئلة المراجعة واستعادة الثقة'\n            : 'Answer review questions and restore confidence',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY D: Due-for-spaced-review concepts (Phase 7 Spaced Revision Scheduler)\n  const dueSpacedReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, {\n    currentDate: new Date(),\n    language,\n  });\n\n  dueSpacedReviews.forEach((item, idx) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(item.conceptId)) return;\n    usedConceptIds.add(item.conceptId);\n\n    const conceptMeta = flatConcepts.find((c) => c.id === item.conceptId);\n    const conceptName = isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 450 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_spaced_${date}_${item.conceptId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: item.subjectName,\n        lessonId: conceptMeta?.lessonId,\n        conceptId: item.conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `مراجعة متباعدة: ${conceptName}` : `Spaced Review: ${conceptName}`,\n        type: 'review',\n        estimatedMinutes: 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `حان موعد المراجعة المتباعدة (${item.reason}).`\n          : `Spaced review interval reached (${item.reason}).`,\n        originTag: conceptMeta?.origin || 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ?  "command": "create",
 "path": "/workspace/project/Amina/src/services/__tests__/pacingAndVoiceStop.test.ts",
 "file_text": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n *\n * Tests for the academic pacing engine and the voice-service stop behaviour.\n *\n * Both cover bugs reported from real use:\n *  - \"Nour's voice starts and cannot be stopped\"\n *  - \"the app has no idea what Amina should study on a given day\"\n */\n\nimport { getDailyPacingPlan, termForDate, paceSubject, orderedLessonsForSubject } from '../pacing/academicPacing';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\n\nlet passed = 0;\nlet failed = 0;\n\nfunction assert(condition: boolean, message: string) {\n  if (condition) {\n    console.log(`✅ [PASS] ${message}`);\n    passed++;\n  } else {\n    console.error(`❌ [FAIL] ${message}`);\n    failed++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction runPacingTests() {\n  console.log('--- ACADEMIC PACING ---\\n');\n\n  // The Egyptian school week is Sunday–Thursday. 2026-10-21 is a Wednesday.\n  const midTerm1 = new Date(2026, 9, 21);\n  const window = termForDate(midTerm1);\n  assert(window !== null, '2026-10-21 falls inside a configured term');\n  assert(window?.term === 1, '2026-10-21 is in term 1');\n\n  // Friday/Saturday are the weekend; term 1 ends 2027-01-14, so a Friday\n  // inside the window must still resolve to a term, and a date in the summer\n  // gap must not.\n  assert(termForDate(new Date(2027, 6, 1)) === null, 'summer date is outside every term');\n\n  const plan = getDailyPacingPlan('2026-10-21');\n  assert(plan.dueToday.length > 0, 'pacing plan names lessons due on 2026-10-21');\n\n  // Every subject that has lessons must resolve to a real, non-null lesson\n  // with a page reference. No fabricated placeholders.\n  const allResolved = plan.dueToday.every((e) => e.lesson !== null);\n  assert(allResolved, 'every due subject resolves to a real curriculum lesson');\n\n  const allHavePages = plan.dueToday.every(\n    (e) => e.lesson && (typeof e.lesson.sourceRef.page === 'number' || e.lesson.sourceRef.page !== ''),\n  );\n  assert(allHavePages, 'every paced lesson carries a source page reference');\n\n  // The plan must be stable for the same date, and must move forward over time.\n  const again = getDailyPacingPlan('2026-10-21');\n  const sameIndexes = again.dueToday.every(\n    (e, i) => e.lessonIndex === plan.dueToday[i].lessonIndex,\n  );\n  assert(sameIndexes, 'pacing is deterministic for a fixed date');\n\n  const laterPlan = getDailyPacingPlan('2026-12-15');\n  const arabicNow = plan.dueToday.find((e) => e.subjectId === 'subj_arabic');\n  const arabicLater = laterPlan.dueToday.find((e) => e.subjectId === 'subj_arabic');\n  assert(\n    Boolean(arabicNow && arabicLater && arabicLater.lessonIndex >= arabicNow.lessonIndex),\n    'Arabic advances through the book as the term progresses',\n  );\n\n  // Pacing must never run off the end of a subject's lesson list.\n  const endOfTerm = getDailyPacingPlan('2027-01-13');\n  const withinBounds = endOfTerm.dueToday.every(\n    (e) => e.lessonIndex >= 0 && e.lessonIndex < e.lessonCount,\n  );\n  assert(withinBounds, 'paced lesson index stays within the lesson list');\n\n  const lessons = orderedLessonsForSubject('subj_arabic');\n  assert(lessons.length > 0, 'Arabic has ordered lessons');\n  const ordered = lessons.every(\n    (l, i) => i === 0 || lessons[i - 1].unitNumber < l.unitNumber ||\n      (lessons[i - 1].unitNumber === l.unitNumber && lessons[i - 1].lessonNumber <= l.lessonNumber),\n  );\n  assert(ordered, 'lessons are ordered by unit then lesson number');\n\n  // Every subject advertised in the curriculum config must be paceable.\n  const subjects = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary();\n  const paceable = subjects.filter((s) => orderedLessonsForSubject(s.subjectId).length > 0);\n  assert(paceable.length === subjects.length, 'every advertised subject has paceable lessons');\n\n  // Outside a term there is no due lesson, and that is reported honestly\n  // rather than by inventing one.\n  const holiday = paceSubject('subj_arabic', new Date(2027, 6, 1), lessons, null);\n  assert(holiday.isOutsideTerm === true, 'out-of-term pacing reports isOutsideTerm');\n  assert(holiday.lesson === null, 'out-of-term pacing returns no lesson instead of fabricating one');\n}\n\nasync function runVoiceStopTests() {\n  console.log('\\n--- VOICE STOP BEHAVIOUR ---\\n');\n\n  // Minimal DOM/browser stubs so the service can run under tsx/node.\n  const listeners: Record<string, Array<(e: any) => void>> = {};\n  let pauseCalls = 0;\n\n  class FakeAudio {\n    onplay: (() => void) | null = null;\n    onended: (() => void) | null = null;\n    onerror: ((e: any) => void) | null = null;\n    currentTime = 0;\n    constructor(public src: string) {}\n    play() {\n      this.onplay?.();\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n    pause() {\n      pauseCalls++;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const synth = {\n    cancel() {},\n    resume() {},\n    speak() {},\n    getVoices: () => [],\n  };\n\n  (globalThis as any).window = {\n    speechSynthesis: synth,\n    addEventListener: (t: string, cb: any) => {\n      (listeners[t] ||= []).push(cb);\n    },\n    removeEventListener: () => {},\n  };\n  (globalThis as any).navigator = { mediaDevices: undefined };\n  (globalThis as any).Audio = FakeAudio;\n  (globalThis as any).fetch = async () => ({\n    ok: true,\n    json: async () => ({ audioBase64: 'AAAA' }),\n  });\n\n  const { voiceService } = await import('../voice/voiceService');\n\n  // Regression: previously cancelSpeech() paused the <audio> element, which\n  // never fires 'ended', so speak() never resolved and onEnd never ran. The\n  // caller's \"speaking\" flag stayed true forever and the stop button did\n  // nothing visible.\n  let endCalled = false;\n  let resolveDone: () => void = () => {};\n  const done = new Promise<void>((r) => (resolveDone = r));\n\n  voiceService.speak('نص تجريبي للاختبار', 'ar', undefined, () => {\n    endCalled = true;\n    resolveDone();\n  });\n\n  // Give the async fetch/play chain a tick to start playback.\n  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20));\n\n  voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n\n  const settled = await Promise.race([\n    done.then(() => 'ended'),\n    new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r('timeout'), 500)),\n  ]);\n\n  assert(settled === 'ended', 'cancelSpeech() settles the pending speak() promise (onEnd fires)');\n  assert(endCalled === true, 'onEnd ran after cancel, so callers can clear their speaking state');\n  assert(pauseCalls > 0, 'cancelSpeech() paused the active audio element');\n\n  // A cancel while audio is still being fetched must also settle, or the\n  // caller would hang waiting on a request that will never play.\n  let fetchResolve: (v: any) => void = () => {};\n  (globalThis as any).fetch = () =>\n    new Promise((r) => {\n      fetchResolve = r;\n    });\n\n  let slowEnded = false;\n  const slow = voiceService.speak('نص بطيء', 'ar', undefined, () => {\n    slowEnded = true;\n  });\n  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));\n  voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n  fetchResolve({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ audioBase64: 'BBBB' }) });\n\n  const slowResult = await Promise.race([\n    slow.then(() => 'settled'),\n    new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r('timeout'), 500)),\n  ]);\n  assert(slowResult === 'settled', 'cancel during the TTS fetch still settles the promise');\n  assert(slowEnded === true, 'onEnd runs even when cancelled mid-fetch');\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  runPacingTests();\n  await runVoiceStopTests();\n\n  console.log(`\\n=== PACING & VOICE: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed ===`);\n  if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);\n}\n\nmain();\n",

Missions were derived from what\n * was already logged (day record, timetable, due reviews), so on a fresh day\n * with nothing logged there was no answer to \"what should I study today?\".\n *\n * This module supplies that answer deterministically from data the repository\n * already has: the ordered, page-numbered lesson lists of the ministry books.\n * It spreads each subject's lessons across the term's actual school days\n * (Egyptian week: Sunday to Thursday) and reports which lesson is due.\n *\n * Nothing here invents content. Friday and Saturday are the weekend. */\nconst SCHOOL_DAYS = new Set([0, 1, 2, 3, 4]); // Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu\n\n/**\n * Term windows for the 2026–2027 academic year at École Girard.\n * Term boundaries follow the Egyptian ministry calendar closely enough to pace\n * a Grade 5 year; they are configuration, not derived fact.\n */\nexport const ACADEMIC_YEAR = {\n  yearLabel: '2026 – 2027',\n  terms: [\n    { term: 1, start: '2026-09-20', end: '2027-01-14' },\n    { term: 2, start: '2027-02-07', end: '2027-06-10' },\n  ],\n} as const;\n\nexport interface TermWindow {\n  term: number;\n  start: string;\n  end: string;\n}\n\nexport interface PacingEntry {\n  subjectId: string;\n  term: number;\n  /** Index into the subject's ordered lesson list. */\n  lessonIndex: number;\n  /** Total lessons the subject has in this term. */\n  lessonCount: number;\n  /** How far through the term's school days we are, 0..1. */\n  termProgress: number;\n  /** The lesson due on this date, or null if the subject has no lessons. */\n  lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson | null;\n  isTermComplete: boolean;\n  /** True when the date falls outside every configured term. */\n  isOutsideTerm: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction parseDate(s: string): Date {\n  const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number);\n  return new Date(y, (m ?? 1) - 1, d ?? 1);\n}\n\nfunction isSchoolDay(d: Date): boolean {\n  return SCHOOL_DAYS.has(d.getDay());\n}\n\n/** Count school days in [start, end], inclusive. */\nfunction schoolDaysBetween(start: Date, end: Date): number {\n  let count = 0;\n  const cursor = new Date(start.getTime());\n  while (cursor <= end) {\n    if (isSchoolDay(cursor)) count += 1;\n    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);\n  }\n  return count;\n}\n\n/** The term window containing `date`, or null when between terms / on holiday. */\nexport function termForDate(date: Date): TermWindow | null {\n  for (const t of ACADEMIC_YEAR.terms) {\n    const start = parseDate(t.start);\n    const end = parseDate(t.end);\n    if (date >= start && date <= end) return { ...t };\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * The subject's lessons in the order the book presents them: by unit, then by\n * lesson number. This is the order a teacher would actually walk the book in.\n */\nexport function orderedLessonsForSubject(subjectId: string): OfficialCurriculumLesson[] {\n  return curriculumService\n    .getLessonsBySubject(subjectId)\n    .slice()\n    .sort((a, b) => a.unitNumber - b.unitNumber || a.lessonNumber - b.lessonNumber);\n}\n\n/** Pacing for one subject on one date. */\nexport function paceSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  date: Date,\n  lessons: OfficialCurriculumLesson[],\n  window: TermWindow | null,\n): PacingEntry {\n  const termLessons =\n    window && window.term === 2\n      ? lessons.filter((l) => l.sourceRef.term === 'Term 2')\n      : lessons;\n  const list = termLessons.length > 0 ? termLessons : lessons;\n\n  if (!window) {\n    return {\n      subjectId,\n      term: 0,\n      lessonIndex: -1,\n      lessonCount: list.length,\n      termProgress: 0,\n      lesson: null,\n      isTermComplete: false,\n      isOutsideTerm: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const start = parseDate(window.start);\n  const end = parseDate(window.end);\n  const total = Math.max(1, schoolDaysBetween(start, end));\n  const elapsed = schoolDaysBetween(start, date);\n  const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, elapsed / total));\n\n  if (list.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      subjectId,\n      term: window.term,\n      lessonIndex: -1,\n      lessonCount: 0,\n      termProgress: progress,\n      lesson: null,\n      isTermComplete: progress >= 1,\n      isOutsideTerm: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Clamp so the final lesson stays current until the term ends rather than\n  // running off the end of the list.\n  const index = Math.min(list.length - 1, Math.floor(progress * list.length));\n\n  return {\n    subjectId,\n    term: window.term,\n    lessonIndex: index,\n    lessonCount: list.length,\n    termProgress: progress,\n    lesson: list[index] ?? null,\n    isTermComplete: progress >= 1,\n    isOutsideTerm: false,\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface DailyPacingPlan {\n  date: string;\n  window: TermWindow | null;\n  /** One entry per subject that has lessons, in curriculum config order. */\n  entries: PacingEntry[];\n  /** Subjects whose lesson is due today, for a short \"today\" list. */\n  dueToday: PacingEntry[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Where Amina should be in every subject today. This is the day-by-day view of\n * the year curriculum: on any date it names the lesson each subject is on.\n */\nexport function getDailyPacingPlan(\n  dateStr: string = localDateStr(),\n  subjectIds?: string[],\n): DailyPacingPlan {\n  const date = parseDate(dateStr);\n  const window = termForDate(date);\n  const ids = subjectIds ?? curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary().map((s) => s.subjectId);\n\n  const entries = ids\n    .map((id) => paceSubject(id, date, orderedLessonsForSubject(id), window))\n    .filter((e) => e.lessonCount > 0);\n\n  return {\n    date: dateStr,\n    window,\n    entries,\n    dueToday: entries.filter((e) => e.lesson !== null && !e.isOutsideTerm),\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n *\n * Academic pacing: where Amina should be in each subject on a given date.\n *\n * The app previously had no calendar at all. Missions were derived from what\n * was already logged (day record, timetable, due reviews), so on a fresh day\n * with nothing logged there was no answer to \"what should I study today?\".\n *\n * This module supplies that answer deterministically from data the repository\n * already has: the ordered, page-numbered lesson lists of the ministry books.\n * It spreads each subject's lessons across the term's actual school days\n * (Egyptian week: Sunday to Thursday) and reports which lesson is due.\n *\n * Nothing here invents content. Every lesson it returns is an existing entry\n * in the official curriculum registry; it only decides *when* it is due.\n */\n\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport type { OfficialCurriculumLesson } from '../../types/teachingSession';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\n/** Egyptian school week. Friday and Saturday are the weekend. */\nconst SCHOOL_DAYS = new Set([0, 1, 2, 3, 4]); // Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu\n\n/**\n * Term windows for the 2026–2027 academic year.\n *\n * IMPORTANT: these are an *assumed* default, not sourced fact. No scheme of\n * work or ministry term calendar exists in the repository's resources, so the\n * app must not present this schedule as official. Pacing is therefore opt-in:\n * it is only used once a calendar is explicitly supplied by the caller (for\n * example after the parent confirms the school's dates). See\n * `PlanMissionsParams.academicCalendar`.\n */\nexport const ASSUMED_ACADEMIC_YEAR = {\n  yearLabel: '2026 – 2027',\n  isAssumed: true,\n  terms: [\n    { term: 1, start: '2026-09-20', end: '2027-01-14' },\n    { term: 2, start: '2027-02-07', end: '2027-06-10' },\n  ],\n} as const;\n\nexport interface AcademicCalendar {\n  yearLabel: string;\n  /** False once a human has confirmed the dates. */\n  isAssumed?: boolean;\n  terms: ReadonlyArray<TermWindow>;\n}\n\nexport interface TermWindow {\n  term: number;\n  start: string;\n  end: string;\n}\n\nexport interface PacingEntry {\n  subjectId: string;\n  term: number;\n  /** Index into the subject's ordered lesson list. */\n  lessonIndex: number;\n  /** Total lessons the subject has in this term. */\n  lessonCount: number;\n  /** How far through the term's school days we are, 0..1. */\n  termProgress: number;\n  /** The lesson due on this date, or null if the subject has no lessons. */\n  lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson | null;\n  isTermComplete: boolean;\n  /** True when the date falls outside every configured term. */\n  isOutsideTerm: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction parseDate(s: string): Date {\n  const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number);\n  return new Date(y, (m ?? 1) - 1, d ?? 1);\n}\n\nfunction isSchoolDay(d: Date): boolean {\n  return SCHOOL_DAYS.has(d.getDay());\n}\n\n/** Count school days in [start, end], inclusive. */\nfunction schoolDaysBetween(start: Date, end: Date): number {\n  let count = 0;\n  const cursor = new Date(start.getTime());\n  while (cursor <= end) {\n    if (isSchoolDay(cursor)) count += 1;\n    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);\n  }\n  return count;\n}\n\n/** The term window containing `date`, or null when between terms / on holiday. */\nexport function termForDate(date: Date, calendar: AcademicCalendar = ASSUMED_ACADEMIC_YEAR): TermWindow | null {\n  for (const t of calendar.terms) {\n    const start = parseDate(t.start);\n    const end = parseDate(t.end);\n    if (date >= start && date <= end) return { ...t };\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * The subject's lessons in the order the book presents them: by unit, then by\n * lesson number. This is the order a teacher would actually walk the book in.\n */\nexport function orderedLessonsForSubject(subjectId: string): OfficialCurriculumLesson[] {\n  return curriculumService\n    .getLessonsBySubject(subjectId)\n    .slice()\n    .sort((a, b) => a.unitNumber - b.unitNumber || a.lessonNumber - b.lessonNumber);\n}\n\n/** Pacing for one subject on one date. */\nexport function paceSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  date: Date,\n  lessons: OfficialCurriculumLesson[],\n  window: TermWindow | null,\n): PacingEntry {\n  const termLessons =\n    window && window.term === 2\n      ? lessons.filter((l) => l.sourceRef.term === 'Term 2')\n      : lessons;\n  const list = termLessons.length > 0 ? termLessons : lessons;\n\n  if (!window) {\n    return {\n      subjectId,\n      term: 0,\n      lessonIndex: -1,\n      lessonCount: list.length,\n      termProgress: 0,\n      lesson: null,\n      isTermComplete: false,\n      isOutsideTerm: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const start = parseDate(window.start);\n  const end = parseDate(window.end);\n  const total = Math.max(1, schoolDaysBetween(start, end));\n  const elapsed = schoolDaysBetween(start, date);\n  const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, elapsed / total));\n\n  if (list.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      subjectId,\n      term: window.term,\n      lessonIndex: -1,\n      lessonCount: 0,\n      termProgress: progress,\n      lesson: null,\n      isTermComplete: progress >= 1,\n      isOutsideTerm: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Clamp so the final lesson stays current until the term ends rather than\n  // running off the end of the list.\n  const index = Math.min(list.length - 1, Math.floor(progress * list.length));\n\n  return {\n    subjectId,\n    term: window.term,\n    lessonIndex: index,\n    lessonCount: list.length,\n    termProgress: progress,\n    lesson: list[index] ?? null,\n    isTermComplete: progress >= 1,\n    isOutsideTerm: false,\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface DailyPacingPlan {\n  date: string;\n  window: TermWindow | null;\n  /** One entry per subject that has lessons, in curriculum config order. */\n  entries: PacingEntry[];\n  /** Subjects whose lesson is due today, for a short \"today\" list. */\n  dueToday: PacingEntry[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Where Amina should be in every subject today. This is the day-by-day view of\n * the year curriculum: on any date it names the lesson each subject is on.\n */\nexport function getDailyPacingPlan(\n  dateStr: string = localDateStr(),\n  subjectIds?: string[],\n): DailyPacingPlan {\n  const date = parseDate(dateStr);\n  const window = termForDate(date);\n  const ids = subjectIds ?? curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary().map((s) => s.subjectId);\n\n  const entries = ids\n    .map((id) => paceSubject(id, date, orderedLessonsForSubject(id), window))\n    .filter((e) => e.lessonCount > 0);\n\n  return {\n    date: dateStr,\n    window,\n    entries,\n    dueToday: entries.filter((e) => e.lesson !== null && !e.isOutsideTerm),\n  };\n}\n",
